background:1252a86e-9baa-4ccb-b8ce-2378a.description: You are trained in battlefield tactics and combat, having served in a militia, mercenary company, or officer corps. Show smart tactics and bravery on the battlefield to enhance your prowess.
background:1252a86e-9baa-4ccb-b8ce-2378a.name: Soldier

background:1441d9c8-c117-47c9-858d-588cd.description: Veteran to a host of world-threatening conflicts, you have shrugged off the very idea of retirement. Peppermints and rocking chairs are for the infirm, and your muscle and mind are still as hard and strong as steel. Besides, young adventurers are headstrong - they need a little wisdom now and then.
background:1441d9c8-c117-47c9-858d-588cd.name: World-Wise Heroine

background:20d865ea-03bd-47bf-97d3-777e1.description: A wicked moment, person, or thing that cannot be slain by sword or spell haunts your mind and flickers in your peripheral vision. You carry it wherever your adventure takes you - or perhaps it carries you.
background:20d865ea-03bd-47bf-97d3-777e1.name: Haunted One

background:229775c9-3044-4779-a3bb-532c3.description: You live to sway and subvert your audience, engaging common crowds and high society alike. Preserving art and bringing joy to the hapless and downtrodden heightens your charismatic aura.
background:229775c9-3044-4779-a3bb-532c3.name: Entertainer

background:30a9679f-be5b-4484-9c8e-e5edc.description: Sleek as a leopard and bold as a bear with an empty belly, you have developed a reputation that grows and shifts along the Sword Coast. However, a discontent has settled in you, tangling your present in the cruel and complicated details of your past.
background:30a9679f-be5b-4484-9c8e-e5edc.name: Blade of Frontiers

background:38a3fe7a-59f4-4dbf-88e1-6e9b6.description: An apostate who has renounced not one, but two faiths, you find yourself adrift in a world where the Gods are real, certainly, but untrustworthy. What does it mean to live outside of church doctrine, outside cultist dogma? It is up to you to find that out for yourself.
background:38a3fe7a-59f4-4dbf-88e1-6e9b6.name: Underdark Exile

background:38c7c859-c284-4df2-b17f-6199e.description: Looking at you, people see someone eloquent, experienced, and a little dangerous. There's a sensuality to you that people admire, and you've made use of that fact, oh yes. If ever there was an emblem for night and all its dark promise, surely that is you.
background:38c7c859-c284-4df2-b17f-6199e.name: Trickster Hedonist

background:5426bad7-d02e-4884-aa2c-382d4.description: Bookish and ambitious, you rose to prominence among the upper crust of spellcasters in the thriving metropolis of Waterdeep. Displaced from that comfortable refined life, you find yourself adapting to a new one on the adventurers' road.
background:5426bad7-d02e-4884-aa2c-382d4.name: Wizard of Waterdeep

background:5b1e726f-52bf-4e93-a798-9f93c.description: You grew up in the wilds, learning to survive far from the comforts of civilisation. Surviving unusual hazards of the wild will enhance your prowess and understanding.
background:5b1e726f-52bf-4e93-a798-9f93c.name: Outlander

background:633aa4be-365f-4358-ba56-e2b85.description: You have spent your life in service to a temple, learning sacred rites and providing sacrifices to the god or gods you worship. Serving the gods and discovering their sacred works will guide you to greatness.
background:633aa4be-365f-4358-ba56-e2b85.name: Acolyte

background:76925f0b-3ec8-4f42-86a9-cd4f7.description: You're an expert in manipulation, prone to exaggeration and more than happy to profit from it. Bending the truth and turning allies against each other will lead to greater success down the road.
background:76925f0b-3ec8-4f42-86a9-cd4f7.name: Charlatan

background:7e820dee-a8fc-43b2-8661-2b404.description: You were raised in a family among the social elite, accustomed to power and privilege. Accumulating renown, power, and loyalty will raise your status.
background:7e820dee-a8fc-43b2-8661-2b404.name: Noble

background:7e9fc515-6c03-47d0-952f-f3461.description: Conscripted by an archdevil to fight in the Blood War against insane and horrifying demons, you emerged fiery and hardened as the core of a furnace. Escaping to the Material Plane, you have left the madness of war behind. But its burning, squalling spectre still haunts your waking dreams.
background:7e9fc515-6c03-47d0-952f-f3461.name: Blood War Veteran

background:8807a6c6-d8cf-494b-aec2-cc01d.description: You are curious and well-read, with an unending thirst for knowledge. Learning about rare lore of the world will inspire you to put this knowledge to greater purpose.
background:8807a6c6-d8cf-494b-aec2-cc01d.name: Sage

background:a16099db-2d25-4d02-bf66-47630.description: Drafted from your crèche into a military life, a taste for violence and a love for the githyanki ruler, Vlaakith, were seeded and nurtured within you. Now you are an agent for Vlaakith on the Material Plane, working toward the advancement of your species.
background:a16099db-2d25-4d02-bf66-47630.name: Astral Zealot

background:aa8ee193-973a-4d2b-906f-3f848.description: Adopted into a religious convent as a child, you grew up in the warm yet rigorous embrace of the faithful. Their tutelage was rigorous, too. Not much room for warmth, though, and you have found your heart yearning for fulfillment beyond the cloister, your boots for cobbles new.
background:aa8ee193-973a-4d2b-906f-3f848.name: Cloistered Stray

background:ac38525a-222b-4280-9c8e-60d55.description: After surviving a poor and bleak childhood, you know how to make the most out of very little. Using your street smarts bolsters your spirit for the journey ahead.
background:ac38525a-222b-4280-9c8e-60d55.name: Urchin

background:da427b49-2732-43a0-808c-c8987.description: Master over a verdant grove that was home to life of all varieties, you have lived a life of peace-making and pain-mending. Forsaking the grove was difficult, but necessary, for the safety of the natural world is in jeopardy, and it is the duty of those with green thumbs and greener souls to aid it.
background:da427b49-2732-43a0-808c-c8987.name: Grove Tender

background:dba0a9d1-15bd-4061-99f2-f1ec0.description: If evil is a nose you are fist squashing it flat. Such is the legend surrounding you in Baldur's Gate: a hero of the most boisterous variety, armed to the teeth, and packing a tiny space hamster.
background:dba0a9d1-15bd-4061-99f2-f1ec0.name: Legend of Baldur's Gate

background:e8c84134-5e91-4ecc-881a-efc47.description: You have a history of breaking the law and survive by leveraging less-than-legal connections. Profiting from criminal enterprise will lead to greater opportunities in the future.
background:e8c84134-5e91-4ecc-881a-efc47.name: Criminal

background:e9aeac40-6c4e-4d81-9a24-e9eeb.description: Your skill in a particular craft has earned you membership in a mercantile guild, offering privileges and protection while engaging in your art. Repairing and discovering rare crafts will bring new inspiration.
background:e9aeac40-6c4e-4d81-9a24-e9eeb.name: Guild Artisan

background:efcb0b57-5d5a-4a54-a7b3-a6188.description: You're a champion of the common people, challenging tyrants and monsters to protect the helpless. Saving innocents in imminent danger will make your legend grow.
background:efcb0b57-5d5a-4a54-a7b3-a6188.name: Folk Hero

class:AbjurationSchool.description: You twist and harden the Weave into arcane wards to protect yourself and others. Learning Abjuration spells from scrolls only costs you 25g per spell level, not 50.
class:AbjurationSchool.name: Abjuration

class:Ancients.description: You fight on the side of light in the cosmic struggle against darkness to preserve the sanctity of life and the beauty of nature.
class:Ancients.name: Oath of the Ancients

class:ArcaneArcher.description: You are capable of weaving magic into your attacks, giving your archery a supernatural quality - and your foes something to fear.
class:ArcaneArcher.name: Arcane Archer

class:ArcaneTrickster.description: As quick with a spell as you are with a lockpick, your illusions and enchantments keep opponents on the back foot.
class:ArcaneTrickster.name: Arcane Trickster

class:Archfey.description: Graced by a lady or lord of the fey, you are imbued with all the sumptuous and scary qualities of your patron's extraordinary realm.
class:Archfey.name: The Archfey

class:Assassin.description: You prefer to deal sublime punishment to a single foe at a time - not in a duel, mind, because a duel implies chivalry, and you're too busy getting the job done for honour.
class:Assassin.name: Assassin

class:Barbarian.description: The strong embrace the wild that hides inside - keen instincts, primal physicality, and most of all, an unbridled, unquenchable rage.
class:Barbarian.name: Barbarian

class:Bard.description: Bards know music is more than idle fancy - it is power. Through study and adventure, these travelling troubadours master song, speech, and the magic within.
class:Bard.name: Bard

class:BattleMaster.description: As a paragon of tactical superiority, you employ a wide array of combat manoeuvres to dominate every fight.
class:BattleMaster.name: Battle Master

class:BeastMaster.description: You foster an intelligent bond with a powerful beast that can aid you in and out of combat.
class:BeastMaster.name: Beast Master

class:BerserkerPath.description: Violence is both a means and an end. You follow a path of untrammelled fury, slick with blood, as you thrill in the chaos of battle, heedless of your own well-being.
class:BerserkerPath.name: Berserker

class:BladesingingSchool.description: A master of wizardry and swordplay, you combine the elegant manoeuvres of a warrior with the devastating magics of a mage.
class:BladesingingSchool.name: Bladesinging

class:Champion.description: You approach the complex problems posed by combat with one distinctly effective solution - you hit those problems, really quite hard.
class:Champion.name: Champion

class:CircleOfStars.description: You are guided by the infinite mysteries of the cosmos. It is through your understanding of the stars that your druidic magic gains its potency.
class:CircleOfStars.name: Circle of the Stars

class:CircleOfTheLand.description: You channel the natural arcana flowing through the earth and creatures atop it to cast powerful druidic magic.
class:CircleOfTheLand.name: Circle of the Land

class:CircleOfTheMoon.description: Your form is mutable as the mercurial moon, letting you shift your form into massive beasts and even primal elementals.
class:CircleOfTheMoon.name: Circle of the Moon

class:CircleOfTheSpores.description: Viewing death, necrosis, fungal growth, and sporulation as just another part of life, you can manipulate such spores to augment yourself and harm your foes.
class:CircleOfTheSpores.name: Circle of the Spores

class:Cleric.description: Clerics are representatives of the gods they worship, wielding potent divine magic for good or ill.
class:Cleric.name: Cleric

class:ConjurationSchool.description: Compelled by shape and motion, your favoured arcane style involves summoning creatures and objects, as well as displacing them in space. Learning Conjuration spells from scrolls only costs you 25g per spell level, not 50.
class:ConjurationSchool.name: Conjuration

class:Crown.description: You have sworn yourself to the ideals of civilisation, serving the laws that hold society together and preserving the order they command.
class:Crown.name: Oath of the Crown

class:DeathDomain.description: You nourish your faith on the forces that create the dead and give rise to the undead.
class:DeathDomain.name: Death Domain

class:Devotion.description: Following the ideal of the knight in shining armour, you act with honour and virtue to protect the weak and pursue the greater good.
class:Devotion.name: Oath of Devotion

class:DivinationSchool.description: You peer through time itself and can sculpt the future, like temporal clay, into a more favourable form. Learning Divination spells from scrolls only costs you 25g per spell level, not 50.
class:DivinationSchool.name: Divination

class:DraconicBloodline.description: Your veins carry draconic magic, the result of a powerful dragon ancestor.
class:DraconicBloodline.name: Draconic Bloodline

class:Druid.description: Druids channel the elemental forces of nature and share a deep kinship with animals. Mastery of Wild Shape allows them to transform into beasts from all over the Realms.
class:Druid.name: Druid

class:DrunkenMaster.description: With the unpredictable lurches of a tippler, you hiccup your way through battle, frustrating foes with carefully executed movements concealed beneath a façade of incompetence.
class:DrunkenMaster.name: Way of the Drunken Master

class:EldritchKnight.description: You are a warrior of spell and sword, weaving incantations that supplement your extensive martial expertise.
class:EldritchKnight.name: Eldritch Knight

class:EnchantmentSchool.description: Your magic influences, beguiles, and bends the will and conviction of those around you. Learning Enchantment spells from scrolls only costs you 25g per spell level, not 50.
class:EnchantmentSchool.name: Enchantment

class:EvocationSchool.description: You are known as an evoker - striding unharmed through the unfettered chaos you call. Learning Evocation spells from scrolls only costs you 25g per spell level, not 50.
class:EvocationSchool.name: Evocation

class:Fiend.description: You have pledged your soul to the Hells or Abyss in return for a deadly arsenal of fiendish arcana.
class:Fiend.name: The Fiend

class:Fighter.description: Fighters have mastered the art of combat, wielding weapons with unmatched skill and wearing armour like a second skin.
class:Fighter.name: Fighter

class:FourElements.description: You focus your ki to bend the elements to your will, using them as an extension of your own body.
class:FourElements.name: Way of the Four Elements

class:GiantPath.description: You walk the path of giants, invoking their elemental might and size by drawing strength from the same primal forces as them.
class:GiantPath.name: Giant

class:GlamourCollege.description: You mastered your craft under the tutelage of fey creatures, whose captivating magic swirls within you, ready to be released.
class:GlamourCollege.name: College of Glamour

class:GloomStalker.description: Emerging like a horrible gift from the envelope of darkness and shadow, you ambush and put down your foes before they can even scream.
class:GloomStalker.name: Gloom Stalker

class:GreatOldOne.description: You pledged something unthinkable to an unspeakably ancient entity - which in return furnished you with powers of cerebral entropy and control.
class:GreatOldOne.name: The Great Old One

class:Hexblade.description: You have made your pact with a mysterious entity from the Shadowfell - a force that manifests in sentient magic weapons carved from the stuff of shadow.
class:Hexblade.name: The Hexblade

class:Hunter.description: You seek the most dangerous prey in Faerûn, from ancient dragons to massive hordes of undead, and excel at slaying them all.
class:Hunter.name: Hunter

class:IllusionSchool.description: You specialise in unravelling and restitching the fabric of reality to fool the unwary, the gullible, and the monstrous. Learning Illusion spells from scrolls only costs you 25g per spell level, not 50.
class:IllusionSchool.name: Illusion

class:KnowledgeDomain.description: Adaptable and adroit in all manner of languages and skills, your mind is an intellectual cup brimming with exquisite knowing.
class:KnowledgeDomain.name: Knowledge Domain

class:LifeDomain.description: Tasked with the holy edict of preserving the body, mind, and soul, your god grants you a plethora of healing magics.
class:LifeDomain.name: Life Domain

class:LightDomain.description: Gods of primordial flame bathe you in resplendent light, providing magics to dispel darkness and immolate enemies.
class:LightDomain.name: Light Domain

class:LoreCollege.description: You pursue beauty and truth, collecting knowledge from scholarly tomes to peasants' tales, and use your gifts to hold both audiences and enemies spellbound.
class:LoreCollege.name: College of Lore

class:Monk.description: Some reach enlightenment by languid meditation - others do so in the heat of battle. Monks manipulate ki to empower their own strikes and debilitate their foes.
class:Monk.name: Monk

class:NatureDomain.description: You embody the vast viridian power of the natural world, an avatar of the subtle divinity of fruitfall, avian migration, woodland silence, and the landslide's roaring fury.
class:NatureDomain.name: Nature Domain

class:NecromancySchool.description: You walk through the valley of the shadow of death, and make lots of friends there. Learning Necromancy spells from scrolls only costs you 25g per spell level, not 50.
class:NecromancySchool.name: Necromancy

class:Oathbreaker.description: You have broken your sacred Oath in pursuit of power and ambition. Only darkness remains to fuel you now.
class:Oathbreaker.name: Oathbreaker

class:OpenHand.description: You specialise in unarmed combat, using your hands and your control of ki to heal or inflict grievous hurt.
class:OpenHand.name: Way of the Open Hand

class:Paladin.description: A promise made so deeply that it becomes divine in itself flows through a paladin, burning bright enough to inspire allies and smite foes.
class:Paladin.name: Paladin

class:Ranger.description: Rangers are unrivalled scouts and trackers, honing a deep connection with nature in order to hunt their favoured prey.
class:Ranger.name: Ranger

class:Rogue.description: With stealth, skill, and uncanny reflexes, rogues' versatility lets them get the upper hand in almost any situation.
class:Rogue.name: Rogue

class:Shadow.description: You value the arts of stealth and subterfuge, bending the shadows to your will to strike without warning.
class:Shadow.name: Way of Shadow

class:ShadowMagic.description: You siphon your powers from the Shadowfell itself, the light in your soul snuffed out by an unsettling darkness.
class:ShadowMagic.name: Shadow Magic

class:Sorcerer.description: Sorcerers are natural spellcasters, drawing on inherent magic from a gift or bloodline.
class:Sorcerer.name: Sorcerer

class:StormSorcery.description: Whether crackling with the energy of ancient deluges or pierced by gales and hurricanes, your lineage is a strange tapestry scrawled by a tempest.
class:StormSorcery.name: Storm Sorcery

class:Swarmkeeper.description: You have forged a deep connection with your natural surroundings and formed a magical bond with a swarm of nature spirits. This swarm serves as a helpful companion and a potent force in battle.
class:Swarmkeeper.name: Swarmkeeper

class:Swashbuckler.description: You live and breathe the art of the blade, excelling in single combat thanks to your quick feet and wits.
class:Swashbuckler.name: Swashbuckler

class:SwordsCollege.description: A highly trained and skilled warrior, you use your prowess with words and weapons to fight and entertain in equal measure.
class:SwordsCollege.name: College of Swords

class:TempestDomain.description: Your faith has made you the very thunder that quakes the black firmament, the lightning coursing through the veins of a terrible storm.
class:TempestDomain.name: Tempest Domain

class:Thief.description: Your quick hands and mastery of the larcenous arts make stealing second nature - be it from a third floor window or a forgotten ruin.
class:Thief.name: Thief

class:TotemWarriorPath.description: Your attunement with nature and its beasts inspires your rage, empowering you with supernatural might.
class:TotemWarriorPath.name: Wildheart

class:TransmutationSchool.description: Your innate fascination with the structure of things has granted you an incredible power over crude matter and its manipulation. Learning Transmutation spells from scrolls only costs you 25g per spell level, not 50.
class:TransmutationSchool.name: Transmutation

class:TrickeryDomain.description: You wield the unorthodox divine tools of deceit and illusion in worship of your chosen deity.
class:TrickeryDomain.name: Trickery Domain

class:ValorCollege.description: You wander the land to witness and relate the deeds of the mighty, keeping alive the memory of heroes of the past and inspiring heroes of the future.
class:ValorCollege.name: College of Valour

class:Vengeance.description: You have set aside even your own purity to right wrongs and deliver justice to those who have committed the most grievous sins.
class:Vengeance.name: Oath of Vengeance

class:WarDomain.description: Fortified by holy zeal, you brandish an arsenal of sacramental savagery to use against those you deem unrighteous.
class:WarDomain.name: War Domain

class:Warlock.description: Bound by a pact to an all-powerful patron, warlocks trade their loyalty for supernatural abilities and unique magic.
class:Warlock.name: Warlock

class:WildMagic.description: Your powers come from ancient forces of chaos. They churn within you - waiting to burst free at any time.
class:WildMagic.name: Wild Magic

class:WildMagicPath.description: The wild influence of magic has transformed you, suffusing you with an arcane power that churns within you, waiting to be released.
class:WildMagicPath.name: Wild Magic

class:Wizard.description: Wizards master the arcane by specialising in individual schools of magic, combining ancient spells with modern research.
class:Wizard.name: Wizard

feat:AbilityScoreIncrease.description: You increase one Ability by 2, or two Abilities by 1, to a maximum of 20.
feat:AbilityScoreIncrease.name: Ability Improvement

feat:Actor.description:
Your Charisma increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Your Proficiency Bonus is also doubled for Deception and Performance Checks.
feat:Actor.name: Actor

feat:Alert.description: You gain a +5 bonus to Initiative and can't be <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SURPRISED">Surprised</LSTag>.
feat:Alert.name: Alert

feat:Athlete.description:
Your Strength or Dexterity increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

When you are Prone, standing up uses significantly less movement. Your Jump distance also increases by 50%.
feat:Athlete.name: Athlete

feat:Charger.description: You gain <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Rush_Charger_Attack">Charger: Weapon Attack</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Rush_Charger_Push">Charger: Shove</LSTag>.
feat:Charger.name: Charger

feat:CrossbowExpert.description:
When you make crossbow attacks within melee range, the Attack Rolls do not have Disadvantage.

Your Piercing Shot also inflicts Gaping Wounds for twice as long.
feat:CrossbowExpert.name: Crossbow Expert

feat:DefensiveDuelist.description: When attacked while wielding a <LSTag Tooltip="Finesse">Finesse Weapon</LSTag> you're <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficient</LSTag> with, you can use a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">reaction</LSTag> to add your <LSTag Tooltip="ProficiencyBonus">Proficiency Bonus</LSTag> to your <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourClass">Armour Class</LSTag>, possibly causing the attack to miss.
feat:DefensiveDuelist.name: Defensive Duellist

feat:DualWielder.description: You can use Two-Weapon Fighting even if your weapons aren't <LSTag Tooltip="Light">Light</LSTag>, and you gain a +1 bonus to <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourClass">Armour Class</LSTag> while wielding a melee weapon in each hand. You cannot dual-wield <LSTag Tooltip="TwoHanded">Two-Handed</LSTag> weapons.
feat:DualWielder.name: Dual Wielder

feat:DungeonDelver.description:
You gain Advantage on Perception Checks made to detect hidden objects and on Saving Throws made to avoid or resist traps.

You gain Resistance to the damage dealt by traps.
feat:DungeonDelver.name: Dungeon Delver

feat:Durable.description:
Your Constitution increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You regain full hit points each time you take a Short Rest.
feat:Durable.name: Durable

feat:ElementalAdept.description: Your spells and attacks ignore <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistance</LSTag> to a damage type of your choice. When you cast spells of that type, you cannot roll a 1.
feat:ElementalAdept.name: Elemental Adept

feat:GreatWeaponMaster.description:
When you land a Critical Hit or kill a target with a melee weapon attack, you can make another melee weapon attack as a bonus action that turn.

Attacks with melee weapons you are Proficient with, and are wielding in both hands, can deal an additional 10 damage at the cost of a -5 Attack Roll penalty. (You can toggle this on and off.)
feat:GreatWeaponMaster.name: Great Weapon Master

feat:HeavilyArmored.description: You gain <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourProficiency">Armour Proficiency</LSTag> with Heavy Armour and your <LSTag Tooltip="Strength">Strength</LSTag> increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
feat:HeavilyArmored.name: Heavily Armoured

feat:HeavyArmorMaster.description:
Your Strength increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Incoming damage from non-magical attacks also decreases by 3 while you're wearing heavy armour.
feat:HeavyArmorMaster.name: Heavy Armour Master

feat:LightlyArmored.description: You gain <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourProficiency">Armour Proficiency</LSTag> with Light Armour and your <LSTag Tooltip="Strength">Strength</LSTag> or <LSTag Tooltip="Dexterity">Dexterity</LSTag> increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
feat:LightlyArmored.name: Lightly Armoured

feat:Lucky.description: You gain 3 <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="LuckPoint">Luck Points</LSTag>, which you can use to gain <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag>, <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Ability Checks</LSTag>, or <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag>, or to make an enemy reroll their Attack Rolls.
feat:Lucky.name: Lucky

feat:MageSlayer.description:
When a creature casts a spell within melee range of you, you have Advantage on any Saving Throw against it, and you can use a reaction to immediately make an attack against the caster.

Enemies you hit have Disadvantage on Concentration Saving Throws.
feat:MageSlayer.name: Mage Slayer

feat:MagicInitiateBard.description: You learn 2 <LSTag Tooltip="Cantrip">cantrips</LSTag> and a Level 1 spell from the bard spell list. You can cast the Level 1 spell once per <LSTag Tooltip="LongRest">Long Rest</LSTag>. Your <LSTag Tooltip="SpellcastingAbility">Spellcasting Ability</LSTag> for all 3 spells is Charisma.
feat:MagicInitiateBard.name: Magic Initiate: Bard

feat:MagicInitiateCleric.description: You learn 2 <LSTag Tooltip="Cantrip">cantrips</LSTag> and a Level 1 spell from the cleric spell list. You can cast the Level 1 spell once per <LSTag Tooltip="LongRest">Long Rest</LSTag>. Your <LSTag Tooltip="SpellcastingAbility">Spellcasting Ability</LSTag> for all 3 spells is Wisdom.
feat:MagicInitiateCleric.name: Magic Initiate: Cleric

feat:MagicInitiateDruid.description: You learn 2 <LSTag Tooltip="Cantrip">cantrips</LSTag> and a Level 1 spell from the druid spell list. You can cast the Level 1 spell once per <LSTag Tooltip="LongRest">Long Rest</LSTag>. Your <LSTag Tooltip="SpellcastingAbility">Spellcasting Ability</LSTag> for all 3 spells is Wisdom.
feat:MagicInitiateDruid.name: Magic Initiate: Druid

feat:MagicInitiateSorcerer.description: You learn 2 <LSTag Tooltip="Cantrip">cantrips</LSTag> and a Level 1 spell from the sorcerer spell list. You can cast the Level 1 spell once per <LSTag Tooltip="LongRest">Long Rest</LSTag>. Your <LSTag Tooltip="SpellcastingAbility">Spellcasting Ability</LSTag> for all 3 spells is Charisma.
feat:MagicInitiateSorcerer.name: Magic Initiate: Sorcerer

feat:MagicInitiateWarlock.description: You learn 2 <LSTag Tooltip="Cantrip">cantrips</LSTag> and a Level 1 spell from the warlock spell list. You can cast the Level 1 spell once per <LSTag Tooltip="LongRest">Long Rest</LSTag>. Your <LSTag Tooltip="SpellcastingAbility">Spellcasting Ability</LSTag> for all 3 spells is Charisma.
feat:MagicInitiateWarlock.name: Magic Initiate: Warlock

feat:MagicInitiateWizard.description: You learn 2 <LSTag Tooltip="Cantrip">cantrips</LSTag> and a Level 1 spell from the wizard spell list. You can cast the Level 1 spell once per <LSTag Tooltip="LongRest">Long Rest</LSTag>. Your <LSTag Tooltip="SpellcastingAbility">Spellcasting Ability</LSTag> for all 3 spells is Intelligence.
feat:MagicInitiateWizard.name: Magic Initiate: Wizard

feat:MartialAdept.description: You learn two manoeuvres from the Battle Master subclass and gain a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="SuperiorityDie">Superiority Die</LSTag> to fuel them. You regain expended Superiority Dice after a <LSTag Tooltip="ShortRest">Short</LSTag> or <LSTag Tooltip="LongRest">Long Rest</LSTag>.
feat:MartialAdept.name: Martial Adept

feat:MediumArmorMaster.description: When you wear Medium Armour, it doesn't impose <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag> on Stealth <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Checks</LSTag>. The bonus to <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourClass">Armour Class</LSTag> you can gain from your Dexterity <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">Modifier</LSTag> also becomes +3 instead of +2.
feat:MediumArmorMaster.name: Medium Armour Master

feat:Mobile.description:
Your movement speed increases, and difficult terrain doesn't slow you down when you Dash.

If you move after making a melee attack, you don't provoke Opportunity Attacks from your target.
feat:Mobile.name: Mobile

feat:ModeratelyArmored.description: You gain <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourProficiency">Armour Proficiency</LSTag> with Medium Armour and shields, and your <LSTag Tooltip="Strength">Strength</LSTag> or <LSTag Tooltip="Dexterity">Dexterity</LSTag> increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
feat:ModeratelyArmored.name: Moderately Armoured

feat:Performer.description: You gain <LSTag Tooltip="MusicalInstrumentProficiency">Musical Instrument Proficiency</LSTag>, and your <LSTag Tooltip="Charisma">Charisma</LSTag> increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
feat:Performer.name: Performer

feat:PolearmMaster.description:
When attacking with a glaive, halberd, quarterstaff, or spear, you can use a bonus action to attack with the butt of your weapon.

You can also make an Opportunity Attack when a target comes within range.
feat:PolearmMaster.name: Polearm Master

feat:Resilient.description: You increase an <LSTag Tooltip="Abilities">Ability</LSTag> by 1, to a maximum of 20, and gain <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> in that Ability's <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag>.
feat:Resilient.name: Resilient

feat:RitualCaster.description: You learn two <LSTag Tooltip="RitualSpell">ritual spells</LSTag> of your choice.
feat:RitualCaster.name: Ritual Caster

feat:SavageAttacker.description: When making melee weapon attacks, you roll your damage dice twice and use the highest result.
feat:SavageAttacker.name: Savage Attacker

feat:Sentinel.description:
When an enemy within melee range attacks an ally, you can use a reaction to make a weapon attack against that enemy. Target ally must not have the Sentinel Feat.

You gain Advantage on Opportunity Attacks, and when you hit a creature with an Opportunity Attack, it can no longer move for the rest of its turn.
feat:Sentinel.name: Sentinel

feat:Sharpshooter.description:
Your ranged weapon attacks do not receive penalties from High Ground Rules.

Ranged weapon attacks with weapons you are Proficient with have a -5 penalty to their Attack Roll, but deal an additional 10 damage. (You can toggle this on or off.)
feat:Sharpshooter.name: Sharpshooter

feat:ShieldMaster.description: You gain a +2 bonus to Dexterity <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag> while wielding a shield. If a spell forces you to make a Dexterity <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throw</LSTag>, you can use a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">reaction</LSTag> to shield yourself and diminish the effect's damage. On a failed Saving Throw, you only take half damage. On a successful Saving Throw, you don't take any damage.
feat:ShieldMaster.name: Shield Master

feat:Skilled.description: You gain <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> in 3 <LSTag Tooltip="Skill">Skills</LSTag> of your choice.
feat:Skilled.name: Skilled

feat:SpellSniper.description: You learn a <LSTag Tooltip="Cantrip">cantrip</LSTag>, and the number you need to <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">roll</LSTag> a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag> with spells is reduced by 1. This effect can stack.
feat:SpellSniper.name: Spell Sniper

feat:TavernBrawler.description: When you make an unarmed attack, use an improvised weapon, or throw something, your Strength <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">Modifier</LSTag> is added to the damage and <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> an additional time.
feat:TavernBrawler.name: Tavern Brawler

feat:Tough.description: Your hit point maximum increases by 2 for every level you have gained.
feat:Tough.name: Tough

feat:WarCaster.description:
You gain Advantage on Saving Throws to maintain Concentration on a spell.

You can also use a reaction to cast Shocking Grasp at a target moving out of melee range.
feat:WarCaster.name: War Caster

feat:WeaponMaster.description: You gain <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> with four weapons of your choice, and your <LSTag Tooltip="Strength">Strength</LSTag> or <LSTag Tooltip="Dexterity">Dexterity</LSTag> increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
feat:WeaponMaster.name: Weapon Master

item:ARM_Bandit_A.description: This lightweight armour appears to have been quickly produced, skipped stitches and fraying edges betraying the inattention of its maker.
item:ARM_Bandit_A.name: Bandit's Armour

item:ARM_Barbarian.description: A rough combination of furs, leathers, and supple fabrics, made for a life outside civilisation.
item:ARM_Barbarian.name: Barbarian Clothes

item:ARM_Bard_A.description: Dark, messy stains line the armholes of the well-used leather breastplate.
item:ARM_Bard_A.name: Simple Jerkin

item:ARM_BootsOfSpeed.description: Featherlaced and flexible of sole, these boots have been used to round up - and outrun - many a foe.
item:ARM_BootsOfSpeed.name: Boots of Speed

item:ARM_Boots_Hide.description: These boots are well-maintained and clean, though their soles are thin from wear.

item:ARM_Boots_Leather_Drow_1.description: Shallow, web-like lines have been tooled into these boiled leather boots.

item:ARM_Boots_Leather_Druid.description: These boots are well-maintained and clean, though their soles are thin from wear.

item:ARM_Boots_Leather_F.description: These boots are well-maintained and clean, though their soles are thin from wear.

item:ARM_Boots_Metal_A.name: Metallic Boots

item:ARM_Boots_Metal_Githyanki.description: Lavishly decorated boots, crafted on far-away planes from stolen metals and poached rubies.
item:ARM_Boots_Metal_Githyanki.name: Githyanki Boots

item:ARM_Boots_Monk.description: Made of tough, well-worn leather, these boots have survived years of use, and can survive many more.
item:ARM_Boots_Monk.name: Monastic Boots

item:ARM_BreastPlate_1.description: This breastplate is crafted in the specialty style of a mysterious armourer in Amn known only as 'The Tailor.'
item:ARM_BreastPlate_1.name: Breastplate +1

item:ARM_BreastPlate_2.description: This garment's previous owner left a few minor personal effects in its inner breast pocket: a scrap of sassafrass, a short bit of thread, and half a peppermint.
item:ARM_BreastPlate_2.name: Breastplate +2

item:ARM_Breastplate.description: This standard-sized breastplate is lined with thick padding meant to cushion the wearer and deflect blows from assailants. The uniform squares of the padding suggest a mathematically-minded crafter.
item:ARM_Breastplate.name: Breastplate

item:ARM_Camp_Aristocrat.description: Fashioned at the hands of someone deeply skilled... or, at the very least, someone who was having a good day at the loom and tailor shop.
item:ARM_Camp_Aristocrat.name: Sweetly Tailored Outfit

item:ARM_Camp_Aristocrat_Brown.description: This lovely ensemble is evocative of the apron of a master chocolatier - and just as scrumptious.
item:ARM_Camp_Aristocrat_Brown.name: Chocolatier Style Doublet

item:ARM_Camp_Aristocrat_White.description: Crisply white with snatches of blue, this garment would not be out of place at a winter festival gala celebrating the wearer's sense of style.
item:ARM_Camp_Aristocrat_White.name: Winter Gala Doublet

item:ARM_Camp_Body.description: Perfect for ambling around a campsite, enjoying the starlight and good conversation.
item:ARM_Camp_Body.name: Homely Clothes

item:ARM_Camp_Body_Astarion.description: A once-fine shirt that's seen years of cuts, tears, and careful repairs. Clearly someone cares about looking good.
item:ARM_Camp_Body_Astarion.name: Astarion's Eccentric Clothes

item:ARM_Camp_Body_Gale.description: Somehow Gale has managed to make his clothes smell like a library. To inhale their aroma is to feel a sudden urge to speak more quietly. Or pay a fine.
item:ARM_Camp_Body_Gale.name: Gale's Austere Clothes

item:ARM_Camp_Body_Halsin.description: Feeling the fabric, the strangest feeling occurs: your thumbs brush sun-dappled leaves, skim the water of a creek, tangle in the fur of some panting animal, heat and breath.
item:ARM_Camp_Body_Halsin.name: Halsin's Grove Garments

item:ARM_Camp_Body_Jaheira.description: Though humble in appearance, these clothes bear little hints at Jaheira's fashionability. Minimalism offset by the subtle hues shining brighter at night and softening in sunbeams.
item:ARM_Camp_Body_Jaheira.name: Jaheira's Respectable Clothes

item:ARM_Camp_Body_Karlach.description: Torn and hell-scented, these trousers have seen a good deal of action - though not perhaps the sort Karlach might prefer.
item:ARM_Camp_Body_Karlach.name: Karlach's Infernal Trousers

item:ARM_Camp_Body_Laezel.description: As exciting as a trade deposition and as functional as a brick.
item:ARM_Camp_Body_Laezel.name: Lae'zel's Clothes

item:ARM_Camp_Body_Minsc.description: To the metaphorical eye, an absolute fantasia of an outfit, declaiming Minsc as a style icon without equal. To the literal eye, this is a belt-buckle shirt/pants combo.
item:ARM_Camp_Body_Minsc.name: Minsc's Fantastical Relaxation Garb

item:ARM_Camp_Body_Minthara.description: While there is little of the spidery Goddess Lolth's influence in this outfit, there is something of spiney inflexible culture of the drow in it.
item:ARM_Camp_Body_Minthara.name: Minthara's At-Ease Clothes

item:ARM_Camp_Body_Shadowheart.description: A little bar of standard-issue cloister soap is tucked into this outfit. It smells like lime and religious fervour.
item:ARM_Camp_Body_Shadowheart.name: Shadowheart's Clothes

item:ARM_Camp_Body_Wyll.description: In his good-humoured performativity, Wyll could not resist a puff of perfume on these clothes. Possibly eau du Frontiers.
item:ARM_Camp_Body_Wyll.name: Wyll's Earthy Garb

item:ARM_Camp_Citizen.description: Stylish without being altogether noteworthy, though the embroidery is actually very fine in certain lights.
item:ARM_Camp_Citizen.name: Comfortable Blue-Red Outfit

item:ARM_Camp_Citizen_B.description: Accentuating all features, turning stockiness into slenderness, turning a beer-belly into... well, an ale gut, but even so! A win overall!
item:ARM_Camp_Citizen_B.name: Spring Slimfit Outfit

item:ARM_Camp_Citizen_B_Teal.description: Accentuating all features, turning stockiness into slenderness, turning a beer-belly into... well, an ale gut, but even so! A win overall!
item:ARM_Camp_Citizen_B_Teal.name: Teal Slimfit Outfit

item:ARM_Camp_Citizen_Black.description: Stylish without being altogether noteworthy, though the embroidery is actually very fine in certain lights.
item:ARM_Camp_Citizen_Black.name: Comfortable Ashmeadow Outfit

item:ARM_Camp_Citizen_C.description: A most adventuresome and spring-heeled variety of ensemble, perfect for journey-makers and risk-takers.
item:ARM_Camp_Citizen_C.name: Swarthy Wayfarer in Cream

item:ARM_Camp_Citizen_C_Blue.description: A most adventuresome and spring-heeled variety of ensemble, perfect for journey-makers and risk-takers.
item:ARM_Camp_Citizen_C_Blue.name: Swarthy Wayfarer in Blue

item:ARM_Camp_Citizen_C_Green.description: A most adventuresome and spring-heeled variety of ensemble, perfect for journey-makers and risk-takers.
item:ARM_Camp_Citizen_C_Green.name: Swarthy Wayfarer in Green

item:ARM_Camp_Citizen_C_Red.description: A most adventuresome and spring-heeled variety of ensemble, perfect for journey-makers and risk-takers.
item:ARM_Camp_Citizen_C_Red.name: Swarthy Wayfarer in Red

item:ARM_Camp_Citizen_Purple.description: Stylish without being altogether noteworthy, though the embroidery is actually very fine in certain lights.
item:ARM_Camp_Citizen_Purple.name: Comfortable Autumnal Outfit

item:ARM_Camp_Deva.description: Golden vambraces and arm rings surmount this divine set.
item:ARM_Camp_Deva.name: Angelic Scion Outfit

item:ARM_Camp_Drow.description: With its harsh, almost arachnid cut and shape, this outfit evokes the spiderlike denizens of the Underdark.
item:ARM_Camp_Drow.name: Drow Outfit

item:ARM_Camp_Leather_A_1_Blue.description: A minimalist leather binding get-up that clings to the skin and creaks just the slightest bit when you move.
item:ARM_Camp_Leather_A_1_Blue.name: Blue Flare Leather Outfit

item:ARM_Camp_Leather_A_1_Green.description: A minimalist leather binding get-up that clings to the skin and creaks just the slightest bit when you move.
item:ARM_Camp_Leather_A_1_Green.name: Green Flare Leather Outfit

item:ARM_Camp_Leather_A_Black.description: A minimalist leather binding get-up that clings to the skin and creaks just the slightest bit when you move.
item:ARM_Camp_Leather_A_Black.name: Black Flare Leather Outfit

item:ARM_Camp_Leather_A_Bright.description: A minimalist leather binding get-up that clings to the skin and creaks just the slightest bit when you move.
item:ARM_Camp_Leather_A_Bright.name: Bright Flare Leather Outfit

item:ARM_Camp_Pants_A.description: An ensemble very fitting for a relaxing sit by the campfire, whereupon stories are exchanged, generally over hipflasks.
item:ARM_Camp_Pants_A.name: Umber Trousers

item:ARM_Camp_Patriars_A.description: Some craftsperson of the highest calibre envisioned and created this, and anyone who wears it shall be the envy of not only their friends, but their enemies too.
item:ARM_Camp_Patriars_A.name: Magnificently Realised Ensemble

item:ARM_Camp_Patriars_A_Black.description: Black as volcanic glass and just as valuable, this ensemble would turn the eye of an entire court.
item:ARM_Camp_Patriars_A_Black.name: Eminent Obsidian Outfit

item:ARM_Camp_Patriars_A_Blue.description: When held out in the sun, the sleeves almost glitter, so richly woven is the fabric of this outfit.
item:ARM_Camp_Patriars_A_Blue.name: Opalescent Outfit

item:ARM_Camp_Patriars_A_Green.description: Each stitch not embellished with filigree and gold weave is gorgeous as the polished scales of a green dragon fully grown.
item:ARM_Camp_Patriars_A_Green.name: Eminent Emerald Outfit

item:ARM_Camp_Patriars_A_Red.description: Though the name is an exaggeration (the fabled city's heat would burn the fabric black stitch by stitch), the sheer magnificence of this ensemble's appeal is not.
item:ARM_Camp_Patriars_A_Red.name: City of Brass Outfit

item:ARM_Camp_Refugee.description: An ensemble very fitting for a relaxing sit by the campfire, whereupon stories are exchanged, generally over hipflasks.
item:ARM_Camp_Refugee.name: Rustic Dark Outfit

item:ARM_Camp_Refugee_Gray.description: Grey with accumulated road dust, these clothes are nothing special.
item:ARM_Camp_Refugee_Gray.name: Road-Dust Grey Clothes

item:ARM_Camp_Refugee_Green.description: Patchwork and threadbare, these clothes practically dangle off their wearer.
item:ARM_Camp_Refugee_Green.name: Scruffy Vagabond Clothes

item:ARM_Camp_Rich_A.description: Keenly administered to by the sort of fingers that were born stitching, crocheting, and generally making nice clothes.
item:ARM_Camp_Rich_A.name: Splendid Outfit

item:ARM_Camp_Rich_A_Gold.description: This outfit makes the wearer feel like a ray of sunlight swanning around camp.
item:ARM_Camp_Rich_A_Gold.name: Splendid Gold Outfit

item:ARM_Camp_Rich_A_Green.description: This outfit makes the wearer feel like a brilliant green turaco bird.
item:ARM_Camp_Rich_A_Green.name: Splendid Green Outfit

item:ARM_Camp_Rich_A_Teal.description: This outfit makes the wearer feel like a bouquet of puya flowers, except with legs, and great style.
item:ARM_Camp_Rich_A_Teal.name: Splendid Teal Outfit

item:ARM_Camp_Rich_B.description: Capably crafted, giving the impression of affirming wealth,
item:ARM_Camp_Rich_B.name: Delicately Constructed Outfit

item:ARM_Camp_Rich_B1.description: Nimble fingers designed and created this outfit.
item:ARM_Camp_Rich_B1.name: Fastidiously Perfect Outfit

item:ARM_Camp_Rich_B1_Beige.description: Tailored with immaculate skill, this outfit makes you feel like someone who has elevated beige. Beige is an atrocious colour, yet here it is, very impressive and pleasing on the eye.
item:ARM_Camp_Rich_B1_Beige.name: Splendid Beige Outfit

item:ARM_Camp_Rich_B_Purple.description: Tailored with immaculate skill, this outfit makes you feel like a Luskan noble walking their manor instead of a wilderland camp.
item:ARM_Camp_Rich_B_Purple.name: Splendid Purple Outfit

item:ARM_Camp_Rich_C.description: Modelled on the chandeliers in the Waterdhavian Sea Ward - aesthetically pleasing and most grand.
item:ARM_Camp_Rich_C.name: Chandelier-Style Embroidered Ensemble

item:ARM_Camp_Rich_C_Blue.description: This outfit makes you feel like a piece of the summer sky transmuted into silk.
item:ARM_Camp_Rich_C_Blue.name: Splendid Blue Outfit

item:ARM_Camp_Rich_C_Red.description: This outfit makes you feel like a red dragon's fiery breath, only the deadliness lies in sheer aesthetic beauty.
item:ARM_Camp_Rich_C_Red.name: Splendid Red Outfit

item:ARM_Camp_Rich_D.description: Backless so that people can pat you on the back and proclaim, 'I say, lovely outfit.'
item:ARM_Camp_Rich_D.name: Backless Extravaganza

item:ARM_Camp_Rich_D_Blue.description: There is something of the blue-blooded rebel in this outfit, of the bandit princess or prince stealing plunder and hearts.
item:ARM_Camp_Rich_D_Blue.name: Anarchic Blue Outfit

item:ARM_Camp_Rich_D_Green.description: There is something of the green-grinning rebel in this outfit, of the bandit princess or prince stealing plunder and hearts.
item:ARM_Camp_Rich_D_Green.name: Anarchic Green Outfit

item:ARM_Camp_Rich_D_Purple.description: There is something of the purple-peacock rebel in this outfit, of the bandit princess or prince stealing plunder and hearts.
item:ARM_Camp_Rich_D_Purple.name: Anarchic Purple Outfit

item:ARM_Camp_Rich_D_White.description: There is something of the pale-white-toothed rebel in this outfit, of the bandit princess or prince stealing plunder and hearts.
item:ARM_Camp_Rich_D_White.name: Anarchic White Outfit

item:ARM_Camp_Rich_E.description: Presumably named for a courageous person. Regardless, a marvellously decadent outfit.
item:ARM_Camp_Rich_E.name: Lionheart Outfit

item:ARM_Camp_Rich_E_GreenPink.description: Robust, sleek, and flattering, this ensemble presents a very fetching figure for the wearer.
item:ARM_Camp_Rich_E_GreenPink.name: Lionheart Green-Pink Outfit

item:ARM_Camp_Rich_E_Teal.description: Robust, sleek, and flattering, this ensemble presents a very fetching figure for the wearer.
item:ARM_Camp_Rich_E_Teal.name: Lionheart Teal Outfit

item:ARM_Camp_Rich_F.description: Diamonds are like the colour black - they simply go with everything.
item:ARM_Camp_Rich_F.name: Diamond Pattern Garb

item:ARM_Camp_Rich_F_Blue.description: Robust, sleek, and flattering, this ensemble presents a very fetching figure for the wearer.
item:ARM_Camp_Rich_F_Blue.name: Diamond Blue Doublet

item:ARM_Camp_Rich_G2.description: Austere and no-nonsense, this outfit betokens largesse and poise.
item:ARM_Camp_Rich_G2.name: Solemnity Outfit

item:ARM_Camp_Rich_G2_Blue.description: One of master Figaro's collection pieces, this outfit maintains the poise and grace of the wearer. Honestly, it elevates it considerably. Bad poise becomes competent poise. Competent becomes strong. Strong becomes spiffing.
item:ARM_Camp_Rich_G2_Blue.name: Solemnity Outfit in Blue

item:ARM_Camp_Rich_G2_Green.description: One of master Figaro's collection pieces, this outfit maintains the poise and grace of the wearer. Honestly, it elevates it considerably. Bad poise becomes competent poise. Competent becomes strong. Strong becomes spiffing.
item:ARM_Camp_Rich_G2_Green.name: Solemnity Outfit in Green

item:ARM_Camp_Rich_G2_Purple.description: One of master Figaro's collection pieces, this outfit maintains the poise and grace of the wearer. Honestly, it elevates it considerably. Bad poise becomes competent poise. Competent becomes strong. Strong becomes spiffing.
item:ARM_Camp_Rich_G2_Purple.name: Solemnity Outfit in Purple

item:ARM_Camp_Rich_G2_White.description: One of master Figaro's collection pieces, this outfit maintains the poise and grace of the wearer. Honestly, it elevates it considerably. Bad poise becomes competent poise. Competent becomes strong. Strong becomes spiffing.
item:ARM_Camp_Rich_G2_White.name: Solemnity Outfit in Gold Medallions

item:ARM_Camp_Rich_G_Black.description: Raffish (meaning sly and disreputable in an alluring way) comes from Raffish Buck Daederum, whose fashion this ensemble mimicks closely.
item:ARM_Camp_Rich_G_Black.name: Raffish Midnight Outfit

item:ARM_Camp_Rich_G_Bright.description: Raffish (meaning sly and disreputable in an alluring way) comes from Raffish Buck Daederum, whose fashion this ensemble mimicks closely.
item:ARM_Camp_Rich_G_Bright.name: Raffish Metallic-Shaded Outfit

item:ARM_Camp_Rich_G_Red.description: Raffish (meaning sly and disreputable in an alluring way) comes from Raffish Buck Daederum, whose fashion this ensemble mimicks closely.
item:ARM_Camp_Rich_G_Red.name: Raffish Bronze-Red Outift

item:ARM_Camp_Shirt_A_Blue.description: At camp, under the deep blue sky fading to indigo at the horizon, this shirt fits right in.
item:ARM_Camp_Shirt_A_Blue.name: Cosy Blue Shirt

item:ARM_Camp_Shirt_C_Purple.description: Purple as tasty plums shared by a camp tent.
item:ARM_Camp_Shirt_C_Purple.name: Snug Purple Shirt

item:ARM_Camp_Shirt_D_Green.description: Soft and green and ideal for a good sleep under the stars.
item:ARM_Camp_Shirt_D_Green.name: Snugglesome Green Shirt

item:ARM_Camp_Shirt_E_Black.description: Dark and inexpensive, yet with a very charming cosiness once worn.
item:ARM_Camp_Shirt_E_Black.name: Mellow Black Shirt

item:ARM_Camp_Shoes_Astarion.description: Made of tough, well-worn leather, these boots have survived years of use, and can survive many more.
item:ARM_Camp_Shoes_Astarion.name: Tasteful Boots

item:ARM_Camp_Shoes_B.description: These shoes make light, almost imperceptible clicking noises as they walk on stone, the wood nice and sculpted.
item:ARM_Camp_Shoes_B.name: Elfin Woodsoles

item:ARM_Camp_Shoes_C.description: The tanners had an excellent time producing this leather - they actually got to use real animal flesh. Usually they work with much grosser stuff.
item:ARM_Camp_Shoes_C.name: Tanner's Delight

item:ARM_Camp_Shoes_E.description: Patterned with twists of gold, lilac and sapphire, these delicate shoes are very reasonable for dancing, romancing, perhaps even prancing.
item:ARM_Camp_Shoes_E.name: Delicate Shoes

item:ARM_Camp_Shoes_F.description: The height of modern Sword Coastian fashion, provided you like being targetted by muggers and thugs and other interesting friendly people.
item:ARM_Camp_Shoes_F.name: Pointed-Toe Shoes

item:ARM_Camp_Shoes_Gale.description: Made of tough, well-worn leather, these boots have survived years of use, and can survive many more.

item:ARM_ChainMail.description: The tight weave of chains in this armour chimes like wind through leaves.
item:ARM_ChainMail.name: Chain Mail

item:ARM_ChainMail_1.description: Fine fabric obscures the bulk of this chain mail, allowing its wearer to mix in polite society while protecting them from unexpected assailants.
item:ARM_ChainMail_1.name: Chain Mail +1

item:ARM_ChainMail_2.description: Made from thick, strong chains loosely-fitted, this armour hangs more heavily than some but protects its wearer with an impenetrable weave of metal.
item:ARM_ChainMail_2.name: Chain Mail +2

item:ARM_ChainShirt.description: Tight chains protect the wearer from sharp weapons, while fabric padding protects the skin from cold metal.
item:ARM_ChainShirt.name: Chain Shirt

item:ARM_ChainShirt_1.description: The intricate embroidery on the linen panel of this armour indicates the nobility of its previous owner.
item:ARM_ChainShirt_1.name: Chain Shirt +1

item:ARM_ChainShirt_2.description: This mail's impossibly fine, close joining indicates the work of gnomish fingers.
item:ARM_ChainShirt_2.name: Chain Shirt +2

item:ARM_ChainShirt_Justiciar.description: Though time has tarnished this armour's metal and cracked its leather, the black sheen of Shar's symbol shines eternal from its chestpiece.
item:ARM_ChainShirt_Justiciar.name: Damaged Dark Justiciar Armour

item:ARM_ChainShirt_Justiciar_Magic.description: Though well-preserved, the armour's gleam is somewhat muted - as if half-shadowed, even in brightest day.
item:ARM_ChainShirt_Justiciar_Magic.name: Dark Justiciar Mail

item:ARM_ChainShirt_Shar.description: While the stitching on the shirt is rushed and uneven, the chain mail is sturdy, and the garment is decorated with an obsidian disk that seems to swallow all light.
item:ARM_ChainShirt_Shar.name: Chain Shirt

item:ARM_CircletOfBlasting.description: This delicate circlet grants its wearer the ability to cast the Scorching Ray spell.
item:ARM_CircletOfBlasting.name: Circlet of Blasting

item:ARM_Cloak.description: Woven of heavy wool, this cloak is solid of make if somewhat stiff to wear.
item:ARM_Cloak.name: Cloak

item:ARM_Cloak_Long_C_1.description: Woven of heavy wool, this cloak is solid of make if somewhat stiff to wear.
item:ARM_Cloak_Long_C_1.name: Cloak

item:ARM_Cloth_B_2.description: No sooner does blood speck the armour than it's absorbed, as if sustaining something within.
item:ARM_Cloth_B_2.name: Cloth Armour

item:ARM_Gloves_Barbarian_Magic.description: The snug fit of these gloves resist a balled fist - as if favouring the open hand of peace.
item:ARM_Gloves_Barbarian_Magic.name: Reason's Grasp

item:ARM_Gloves_Cloth_A.description: These padded vambraces balance light protection with a dextrous expression impossible in heftier gauntlets.
item:ARM_Gloves_Cloth_A.name: Gloves

item:ARM_Gloves_Hide.description: Treated animal hide is hammered taut into these gloves, offering protection against hostile climes but little else.

item:ARM_Gloves_Leather.description: These supple gloves provide both flexibility and protection.

item:ARM_Gloves_Metal_2.description: A sigil of Bane is etched on the inside of both gauntlets, but any blessing upon them is long gone.

item:ARM_HalfPlate.description: This heavy, resilient breastplate is reinforced by a padded gambeson to protect soldiers from hip to neck.
item:ARM_HalfPlate.name: Half Plate Armour

item:ARM_HalfPlate_1.description: Heraldic runes are sewn into the padding of this armour, offering a gift of protection to whoever dons it.
item:ARM_HalfPlate_1.name: Half Plate Armour +1

item:ARM_HalfPlate_2.description: This breastplate is far tougher than it appears, taking blows from common weapons without suffering so much as a scratch.
item:ARM_HalfPlate_2.name: Half Plate Armour +2

item:ARM_HalfPlate_EndGame.description: Heraldic runes are sewn into the padding of this armour, offering a gift of protection to whoever dons it.
item:ARM_HalfPlate_EndGame.name: Half Plate Armour +1

item:ARM_HalfPlate_FlamingFist_B.name: Half Plate Armour

item:ARM_HalfPlate_Githyanki.description: This armour was forged to Vlaakith's standards under the exacting eye of a githyanki smith.
item:ARM_HalfPlate_Githyanki.name: Githyanki Half Plate

item:ARM_Hat.description: There is something of the frumpy explorer who keeps lots of cats in the aesthetic of this hat.
item:ARM_Hat.name: Frumpy Hat

item:ARM_Hat_Circushat.description: 'What do you get when you cross a fiend with a rogue? A thiefling.' - nameless comedian moments before his (perhaps timely) murder.
item:ARM_Hat_Circushat.name: Hat Of Eminent Giggles

item:ARM_Hat_MuffinHat_A.description: Foppish and fluffy and built for just the right sort of dome accustomed to having it set upon the head by other people.
item:ARM_Hat_MuffinHat_A.name: Ignoble Hat

item:ARM_Hat_MuffinHat_B.description: For the discerning raconteur, spinner of stories, and peacockish personality.
item:ARM_Hat_MuffinHat_B.name: Rufflesome Blaggart Hat

item:ARM_Hat_Wizard_A.description: This wizardly hat has a little embroidered rabbit inside its lining - the rabbit is called Snowball, and once he was lost, never to be found.
item:ARM_Hat_Wizard_A.name: Wizard Hat

item:ARM_Hat_Wizard_B.description: Whacked around more often than a clown in a tragedy.
item:ARM_Hat_Wizard_B.name: Old Floppy Hat

item:ARM_Hat_Wizard_C.description: This wizardly hat has a little embroidered rabbit inside its lining - the rabbit is called Snowball, and once he was lost, never to be found.
item:ARM_Hat_Wizard_C.name: Bycocket

item:ARM_Hat_Wizard_D.description: This wizardly hat has a little embroidered rabbit inside its lining - the rabbit is called Snowball, and once he was lost, never to be found.
item:ARM_Hat_Wizard_D.name: Brimmed Hat

item:ARM_Hat_Wizard_E.description: Silvery wings spread over the stiff unyielding leather.
item:ARM_Hat_Wizard_E.name: Embroidered Hat

item:ARM_Hat_Wizard_F.description: Tapered to a precise point, such as the wizardly mind when focusing on a nice big dinner, instead of all these complicated spells.
item:ARM_Hat_Wizard_F.name: Embroidered Bycocket

item:ARM_Hat_Wizard_G.description: Very wide brimmed, really. Almost a kind of grinning sombrero.
item:ARM_Hat_Wizard_G.name: Wide-Brimmed Hat

item:ARM_Hat_Wizard_H.description: As classic a design as one can hope for. It even has the frumpy wrinkles.
item:ARM_Hat_Wizard_H.name: Snakeskin Hat

item:ARM_Helmet_BG_Watch_Metal_B.description: Any padding that once lined this helmet has long since worn away.
item:ARM_Helmet_BG_Watch_Metal_B.name: Watch's Helmet

item:ARM_Helmet_Barbarian_Magic.description: With every blow the skullcap seems to compress, narrowing the vision of the wearer.
item:ARM_Helmet_Barbarian_Magic.name: Cap of Wrath

item:ARM_Helmet_Leather.description: Layers of leather were boiled and moulded to create this rugged cap. It still smells a bit of tannins.
item:ARM_Helmet_Leather.name: Leather Helmet

item:ARM_Helmet_Leather_1.description: Years of sweat and use have slowly darkened the leather of this cap.
item:ARM_Helmet_Leather_1.name: Rich Arcanist Helmet

item:ARM_Helmet_Leather_A.description: The red dye infusing this helmet comes from Crimson Lake beetles, often found in the deserts of Anauroch.
item:ARM_Helmet_Leather_A.name: Scorpion Helmet

item:ARM_Helmet_Leather_B.description: The red dye infusing this helmet comes from Crimson Lake beetles, often found in the deserts of Anauroch.
item:ARM_Helmet_Leather_B.name: Leatherstring Helmet

item:ARM_Helmet_Leather_E.description: Fanned out in two angelic-broad wings.
item:ARM_Helmet_Leather_E.name: Angelic Plume Helmet

item:ARM_Helmet_Leather_F.description: Dyed as red as gladiatorial blood.
item:ARM_Helmet_Leather_F.name: Red Carmine Mask

item:ARM_Helmet_Metal.description: Any padding that once lined this helmet has long since worn away.
item:ARM_Helmet_Metal.name: Helmet

item:ARM_Helmet_Metal_A.description: Equipped with a tall spike jutting up toward the sky.
item:ARM_Helmet_Metal_A.name: Scalpspike Helm

item:ARM_Helmet_Metal_B.description: Grated and fixable, so the wearer might gulp cool air during a fight.
item:ARM_Helmet_Metal_B.name: Adjustable Steel Helm

item:ARM_Helmet_Metal_C.description: Hammered into a fine shape by competent smiths.
item:ARM_Helmet_Metal_C.name: Well Crated Helm

item:ARM_Helmet_Metal_D.description: Flowing like a horsetail, black as night.
item:ARM_Helmet_Metal_D.name: Blackplume Helm

item:ARM_Helmet_Metal_Dark_Justiciar_C.description: Round-topped and fashioned to protect from errant arrows.
item:ARM_Helmet_Metal_Dark_Justiciar_C.name: Justiciar Helmet

item:ARM_Helmet_Metal_E.description: Aureate twists in the metal give a sheen like polluted sunlight.
item:ARM_Helmet_Metal_E.name: Fierce Golden Helm

item:ARM_Helmet_Metal_FlamingFist_A.description: Unadorned yet intimidating for that factor, this helm speaks to the quiet nobility and equally quiet dread the Fist inspire.
item:ARM_Helmet_Metal_FlamingFist_A.name: Flaming Fist Helmet

item:ARM_Helmet_Metal_FlamingFist_B.description: Unadorned yet intimidating for that factor, this helm speaks to the quiet nobility and equally quiet dread the Fist inspire.
item:ARM_Helmet_Metal_FlamingFist_B.name: Flaming Fist Helmet

item:ARM_Helmet_Metal_FlamingFist_C.description: The brutish thuggery of the Enforcer's position is summarised in this helmet's design.
item:ARM_Helmet_Metal_FlamingFist_C.name: Flaming Fist Helmet

item:ARM_Helmet_Metal_G.description: Worn ceremonially by commanders and general at the head of parades.
item:ARM_Helmet_Metal_G.name: Triumphal Helm

item:ARM_Helmet_Metal_H.description: Donned by the aristocracy during festivals involving a militaristic component.
item:ARM_Helmet_Metal_H.name: Opulent Helm

item:ARM_Helmet_Metal_J.description: Hammered from an alloy of strong mountain metals.
item:ARM_Helmet_Metal_J.name: Formidable Helmet

item:ARM_Hide_1.name: Hide Armour +1

item:ARM_Hide_2.description: This hide armour, soft to the touch but hard as a zaratan's hide, is stitched together of narrow panels allowing for the wearer's ease of movement and comfort.
item:ARM_Hide_2.name: Hide Armour +2

item:ARM_Jester_Hat.description: Tinkling, ringing, jangling, and about as festive as a terminal diagnosis.
item:ARM_Jester_Hat.name: Cap and Bells

item:ARM_Leather_1.name: Leather Armour +1

item:ARM_Leather_1_Red.description: This well-tailored leather tunic is reinforced by geometric quilting.
item:ARM_Leather_1_Red.name: Scarlet Leather Armour

item:ARM_Padded.name: Padded Armour

item:ARM_Padded_1.description: The quilting threads running through this padded vest seem to gleam in the rising sun.
item:ARM_Padded_1.name: Padded Armour +1

item:ARM_Robe.description: Crafted with care, this robe will protect you from the elements. It won't do much against a sword's thrust, though.
item:ARM_Robe.name: Simple Robe

item:ARM_Robe_Selunite.description: Crafted with care, this robe will protect you from the elements. It won't do much against a sword's thrust, though.
item:ARM_Robe_Selunite.name: Selûnite Robe

item:ARM_Robe_Sorcerer.description: Neat leather bands keep the trailing cloth secure. Singed sleeves are a liability for any spellcaster.

item:ARM_ScaleMail.description: A hefty shirt of scale, offering some protection against the slings and arrows of the world.
item:ARM_ScaleMail.name: Scale Mail

item:ARM_ScaleMail_1.description: The work of a skilled craftsman, this scale shirt offers better protection than most.
item:ARM_ScaleMail_1.name: Scale Mail +1

item:ARM_ScaleMail_2.description: Crafted by an artist's hands, this exquisite scale shirt feels like it could turn aside any blade.
item:ARM_ScaleMail_2.name: Scale Mail +2

item:ARM_ScaleMail_Paladin_Ancients.description: Four embroidered sentences decorate the tabard - the tenets of the ancients: 'Kindle the Light. Shelter the Light. Preserve your own Light. Be the Light.'
item:ARM_ScaleMail_Paladin_Ancients.name: Scale Mail of the Ancients

item:ARM_ScaleMail_Paladin_Crown.description: Embroidered on the tabard are the tenets of devotion: Honesty, Courage, Compassion, Honour, and Duty.
item:ARM_ScaleMail_Paladin_Crown.name: Scale Mail of the Crown

item:ARM_ScaleMail_Paladin_Devotion.description: Embroidered on the tabard are the tenets of devotion: Honesty, Courage, Compassion, Honour, and Duty.
item:ARM_ScaleMail_Paladin_Devotion.name: Scale Mail of Devotion

item:ARM_ScaleMail_Paladin_Vengeance.description: Gold embroidery covers the inside of the tabard, right over the heart: 'By any means necessary, I will fight the Greater Evil, showing no mercy for the wicked.'
item:ARM_ScaleMail_Paladin_Vengeance.name: Scale Mail of Vengeance

item:ARM_Scalemail_Adamantine_A.description: The adamantine scales hug your body like a second skin - a heavy, near-impregnable skin.
item:ARM_Scalemail_Adamantine_A.name: Adamantine Scale Mail

item:ARM_Shar_Crown_A.description: Shar's endless fervour seems to seep blackly from the pieces of this helm.
item:ARM_Shar_Crown_A.name: Shar Headwear

item:ARM_Shar_Crown_A_Broken.description: Battered by age and use, this once-fine helmet feels like a ghost of a bygone time.
item:ARM_Shar_Crown_A_Broken.name: Cracked Helm of Shar

item:ARM_Shar_Crown_B_Broken.description: Eaten by time, this rusted helmet once bore a prominent sigil. Alas, it's long since faded to nothing.
item:ARM_Shar_Crown_B_Broken.name: Helmet

item:ARM_Shar_Crown_B_Broken_Magic.description: Stamped with Shar's own sigil, this helm was worn by the Nightsinger's own crusaders. The darkness within seems deeper than night, somehow.
item:ARM_Shar_Crown_B_Broken_Magic.name: Dark Justiciar Helm

item:ARM_Splint.description: Combining sturdy metal plates with flexible cloth, this armour promises protection and mobility.
item:ARM_Splint.name: Splint Armour

item:ARM_Splint_1.description: Skilled hands crafted this armour, reinforcing the metal plates while sacrificing none of the flexibility.
item:ARM_Splint_1.name: Splint Armour +1

item:ARM_Splint_2.description: Wrought of an artisan's skill and passion, this armour will turn aside all but the fiercest of blades.
item:ARM_Splint_2.name: Splint Armour +2

item:ARM_Splint_Body_Dwarven.description: Skilled hands crafted this armour, reinforcing the metal plates while sacrificing none of the flexibility.
item:ARM_Splint_Body_Dwarven.name: Dwarven Splintmail

item:ARM_StuddedLeather.description: Shaped, hardened, and reinforced with metal studs, leather is the armour of choice for those who value agility as much as protection.
item:ARM_StuddedLeather.name: Studded Leather Armour

item:ARM_StuddedLeather_1.description: This armour is strong enough to stop a dagger and light enough to escape whatever weapon follows it.
item:ARM_StuddedLeather_1.name: Studded Leather Armour +1

item:ARM_StuddedLeather_2.description: Superbly shaped, elegantly designed, and tough as ring mail with none of the weight.
item:ARM_StuddedLeather_2.name: Studded Leather Armour +2

item:ARM_StuddedLeather_Body_Drow.description: Tracings of glossy black spider-web mark this drow-made armour. It is supple, but strong - and made to blend in with the dark caves and crevices of the Underdark.
item:ARM_StuddedLeather_Body_Drow.name: Drow Studded Leather Armour

item:ARM_StuddedLeather_Drow_Faded.description: The sun's harsh light has dulled this armour's dark lustre.
item:ARM_StuddedLeather_Drow_Faded.name: Faded Drow Leather Armour

item:ARM_Underwear_Minsc.description: Tight, aerodynamic, and built for maximum breathability. Humidity is no friend to hamsters.
item:ARM_Underwear_Minsc.name: Minsc's Underwear

item:ARM_Vanity_Circus_Body_A.description: Designed for fun rather than function.
item:ARM_Vanity_Circus_Body_A.name: Circus Ensemble

item:ARM_Vanity_Circus_Body_B.description: A burst of fun and colour, this outfit completely avoids the general sensation of damp misery inherent to the standard circus clown.
item:ARM_Vanity_Circus_Body_B.name: Mesmerising Circus Outfit

item:ARM_Vanity_Circus_Shoes_A.description: Made of tough, well-worn leather, these boots have survived years of use, and can survive many more.
item:ARM_Vanity_Circus_Shoes_A.name: Reliably Built Boots

item:ARM_Vanity_Deva_Shoes.description: Not only do these sandals allow your feet to breathe on warm summer-scented evenings and leaf-crunchy autumn afternoons, but come the turning of clocks toward colder seasons, the sandal straps emit a faintly magical heat as cosy as any pair of wooly socks.
item:ARM_Vanity_Deva_Shoes.name: Celestial Sandals

item:ARM_Vanity_ElegantRobe.description: A draped robe made with lightweight fabric. Made for seduction rather than battle.
item:ARM_Vanity_ElegantRobe.name: Elegant Robe

item:ARM_Vanity_Prison_EternalDebtors.description: This attire disguises you as a poor soul indebted to Raphael - other debtors in his thrall will not be hostile to you.
item:ARM_Vanity_Prison_EternalDebtors.name: Debtor's Attire

item:ARM_Vanity_Prison_Poor.description: Lowly and poorly fitting on any physique, this garb is of the worst quality.
item:ARM_Vanity_Prison_Poor.name: Destitute Clothes

item:BASE_Vanity_Body_Epilogues.description: Perhaps once pretty, now musty and worn.
item:BASE_Vanity_Body_Epilogues.name: Grubby Ochre Clothes

item:BASE_Vanity_Shoes_Camp.description: Made of tough, well-worn leather, these boots have survived years of use, and can survive many more.
item:BASE_Vanity_Shoes_Camp.name: Tasteful Boots

item:BASE_Vanity_Shoes_Epilogues.description: Made of tough, well-worn leather, these boots have survived years of use, and can survive many more.
item:BASE_Vanity_Shoes_Epilogues.name: Tasteful Boots

item:BASE_WEAPON_Longbows.description: During the Crown Wars, the demand for longbows was such that adult yew trees were almost driven to extinction.
item:BASE_WEAPON_Longbows.name: Longbow

item:CHA_CompassSpear.description: Time has dampened this spear's sheen, but the centre glows a faint blue. The magic it exudes feels old, terrible... and divine. The spear was given to its previous owner for his unerring loyalty - even after death.
item:CHA_CompassSpear.name: The Watcher's Guide

item:CHA_OutpostJewelry.description: Grime covers this necklace, but you can vaguely discern delicate engravings of a moon and harp.
item:CHA_OutpostJewelry.name: Silver Pendant

item:CINE_TOOL_Hospital_Surgery_Scalpel_.description: This dagger's handle is smooth and light, its jagged blade sharpened into a thin, cruel edge.
item:CINE_TOOL_Hospital_Surgery_Scalpel_.name: Scalpel

item:CRA_Corpse_Commoner_Locket.description: A finely crafted silver locket, engraved with the words 'For Papa.'
item:CRA_Corpse_Commoner_Locket.name: Silver Locket

item:CRE_MAG_Githborn_Amulet.description: Many a githyanki hunter has worn this amulet before you. The strange stones set in swirling silver reverberate with echoes of their magic.
item:CRE_MAG_Githborn_Amulet.name: Aberration Hunters' Amulet

item:CRE_MAG_Psychic_Githborn_Circlet.description: You get the eerie feeling that the jewelsmith used more than alien metals to forge this circlet - something like ancient magic, or shards of a soul.
item:CRE_MAG_Psychic_Githborn_Circlet.name: Circlet of Psionic Revenge

item:DEC_HAG_Mask_A.description: Soft, unintelligible whispers seep from the dark wood, ringing in your ears and resounding in your skull.
item:DEC_HAG_Mask_A.name: Whispering Mask

item:DEC_Ketheric_Armor_Mask_Scrap_A_Mag.description: Worn by Shar's most loyal zealots, the mere sight of it strikes fear in the heart of even the bravest of souls.
item:DEC_Ketheric_Armor_Mask_Scrap_A_Mag.name: Dark Justiciar Mask

item:DEN_BearReward_Amulet.description: This amulet, engraved with a small waterfall, imparts a feeling of calm serenity when worn.
item:DEN_BearReward_Amulet.name: Amulet of Silvanus

item:DEN_CapturedGoblin_MurderDagger.description: This long, slender blade fits perfectly between the ribs of any unsuspecting victim.
item:DEN_CapturedGoblin_MurderDagger.name: Assassin's Touch

item:DEN_DruidHelmet_Circlet.description: The branches of this circlet are half-fossilised, passed down through generations of druids. Fabricated during the founding of the grove, the wreath is forever linked to its lands, the tiny rubies connected to its stones and structures, bidding them to do their bidding.
item:DEN_DruidHelmet_Circlet.name: Key of the Ancients

item:DEN_FaithwardenStaff.description: Infused with Silvanus' strength, these staves are gifted to Faithwardens who act in defence of nature.
item:DEN_FaithwardenStaff.name: Pale Oak

item:DEN_HellridersPride.description: A waft of sulphur emanates from these proudly-kept gauntlets.
item:DEN_HellridersPride.name: Hellrider's Pride

item:DEN_Thiefling_Ring1.description: This ring is missing its gem - or perhaps it's just very invisible.
item:DEN_Thiefling_Ring1.name: Ring of Being Really Invisible

item:DEN_Thiefling_Ring3.description: The exterior of this ring is roughly carved with nonsensical runes.
item:DEN_Thiefling_Ring3.name: Ring of Infinite Wishes

item:DEN_Thiefling_Ring5.description: The runes encircling this ring appear to have been scratched into the metal with a rock.
item:DEN_Thiefling_Ring5.name: 'Magic' Ring

item:DEN_TunnelStaff.description: Thread-like vines wriggle along this wooden staff.
item:DEN_TunnelStaff.name: Nature's Snare

item:DEN_UNI_Thieflings_StolenLocket.description: Slightly tarnished, and opened with a mere flick of the thumb.
item:DEN_UNI_Thieflings_StolenLocket.name: Brass Locket

item:DLC_DD_ARM_Beasts_Tricorn.description: A battered two-point hat that's seen the wear and tear of rebellion.
item:DLC_DD_ARM_Beasts_Tricorn.name: Bicorne of the Sea Beast

item:DLC_DD_ARM_Red_Prince_Cloak.description: A noble warrior's cloak, woven in the heart of an ancient empire.
item:DLC_DD_ARM_Red_Prince_Cloak.name: Cape of the Red Prince

item:DLC_DD_Music_Lohses_Lute.description: An old lute that hums with the voices of numerous sprites and spirits.
item:DLC_DD_Music_Lohses_Lute.name: Lute of the Merryweather Bard

item:DLC_DD_WPN_Sebilles_Needle.description: A dagger that thrums with desire - a longing for vengeance.
item:DLC_DD_WPN_Sebilles_Needle.name: Needle of the Outlaw Rogue

item:DLC_TWITCH_Camp_Body.description: Indigo cloth manipulated into elaborate patterns mark this outfit's wearer as a gregarious observer, listener, and conversationalist.
item:DLC_TWITCH_Camp_Body.name: Chatterbox's Tabard

item:DLC_TWITCH_Camp_Shoes.description: Traversing fast-paced bodies of water is a chore for all - apart from the fashionable folk clad in this footwear.
item:DLC_TWITCH_Camp_Shoes.name: Streamhopper Loafers

item:DLC_TWITCH_Underwear_A.description: This charming piece's hue reminds of the flower often sprouting from anonymous graves.
item:DLC_TWITCH_Underwear_A.name: Periwinkle Undergarments

item:DLC_TWITCH_Underwear_B.description: Underwear of this type was commonly worn by mages powerful enough to broadcast their likeness across the many planes of existence.
item:DLC_TWITCH_Underwear_B.name: Channeler's Trunks

item:END_Emperor_Staff.description:
Ceremorphosis eradicates great swathes of the consciousness that came before... but not everything. Touching the staff, a fragment of the Emperor's memory slithers into your brain - you see sea waves foaming into spume, and feel the explorer's exultant joy.

Then the image is gone, like so much silken night under a cut-shade sun.
item:END_Emperor_Staff.name: Staff of the Emperor

item:EPI_Camp_Ascendant.description: Spun from gold and inlaid with real rubies, this outfit costs more than the contents of most patriars Counting House vaults.
item:EPI_Camp_Ascendant.name: Decadent Ensemble

item:EPI_Camp_Avernus.description: Hewn with rough style, these trousers are fire-resistant, blood-proof, and tough to pull off unless you're a big barbarian lady.
item:EPI_Camp_Avernus.name: Hot Pants

item:EPI_Camp_DU_Rags.description: Perhaps once pretty, now musty and worn.
item:EPI_Camp_DU_Rags.name: Grubby Ochre Clothes

item:EPI_Camp_Gale.description: A delicately-embroidered outfit inspired by the decorative spine of Sharro's 'A Sommelier's Guide to the Forgotten Realms.'
item:EPI_Camp_Gale.name: Embroidered Ensemble

item:EPI_Camp_Gale_God.description: A beautiful robe crafted with the Weave itself. It thrums with power.
item:EPI_Camp_Gale_God.name: Weave-Touched Robe

item:EPI_Camp_Halsin.description: Whoever crafted this outfit designed it to be both practical and stylish - an excellent combination.
item:EPI_Camp_Halsin.name: Finely Crafted Ensemble

item:EPI_Camp_Jaheira.description: Do not be fooled by this ensemble. While delicately made, it will not impede you in a fight - should the need arise.
item:EPI_Camp_Jaheira.name: Lacey Garb

item:EPI_Camp_Jaheira_Harper.description: Scrubbed to an inch of its life, the barely visible bloodstains on this Harper garb suggest it has seen more than a few 'parties'.
item:EPI_Camp_Jaheira_Harper.name: Harper Finery

item:EPI_Camp_Laezel_Faerun.description: Form-fitting and highly functional, warming the wearer in chilled deepwinter air, but cooling at summertide's zenith.
item:EPI_Camp_Laezel_Faerun.name: Nomad's Garb

item:EPI_Camp_Laezel_Gith.description: Formal garments typically worn by githyanki seers, repurposed as ceremonial attire.
item:EPI_Camp_Laezel_Gith.name: Senja'si Finery

item:EPI_Camp_Minsc.description: Whichever rodent chose this outfit must have thought its wearer looked very handsome in it.
item:EPI_Camp_Minsc.name: Very Handsome Shirt

item:EPI_Camp_Minthara.description: Embroidered with pure silver, this garment fits the body like a glove, while allowing complete ease of movement.
item:EPI_Camp_Minthara.name: Moonlit Ensemble

item:EPI_Camp_Minthara_Drow.description: With sharpened edges, this ensemble is not to be worn by the fainthearted... or by those who bleed easily.
item:EPI_Camp_Minthara_Drow.name: Cut-Throat Leather Ensemble

item:EPI_Camp_PartyTav_1.description: The rich detail on this ornate garb suggest the work of the finest craftspeople Waterdeep's fashion district have to offer.
item:EPI_Camp_PartyTav_1.name: Brocade Ensemble

item:EPI_Camp_PartyTav_2.description: Restrained but finely-made, this simply elegant suit appeals to a variety of tastes.
item:EPI_Camp_PartyTav_2.name: Tasteful Suit

item:EPI_Camp_PartyTav_3.description: For the wearer who likes every ruffle and pleat just so.
item:EPI_Camp_PartyTav_3.name: Frilly Outfit

item:EPI_Camp_PartyTav_4.description: Gold, gold, gold, from sternum to thigh - that's how you make an entrance.
item:EPI_Camp_PartyTav_4.name: Glittering Garb

item:EPI_Camp_Prison.description: Infested with vermin and stiff with dirt, this garb - if you can call it such - reeks to high heaven.
item:EPI_Camp_Prison.name: Prison Tatters

item:EPI_Camp_Selune.description: Humble materials crafted with a light touch. This outfit is strong enough to withstand the elements but delicate as a sliver of moon.
item:EPI_Camp_Selune.name: Dusky Ensemble

item:EPI_Camp_Shar.description: These Sharran robes emphasise authority and austerity over comfort - a negative, like the black hole of the new moon.
item:EPI_Camp_Shar.name: Robes of the New Moon

item:EPI_Camp_Shoes_Ascendant.description: These slippers are as expensive as they are impractical.
item:EPI_Camp_Shoes_Ascendant.name: Decadent Slippers

item:EPI_Camp_Shoes_Avernus.description: Stained with imp guts and warmed from within by hot, sweaty toes.
item:EPI_Camp_Shoes_Avernus.name: The Devil-Crushers

item:EPI_Camp_Shoes_Gale.description: These bejewelled slippers were made for sipping good wine among even better company.
item:EPI_Camp_Shoes_Gale.name: Elegant Slippers

item:EPI_Camp_Shoes_Halsin.description: All the polish in the world can't hide the grass stains on these shoes.
