item:EPI_Camp_Shoes_Halsin.name: Well-Worn Dress Shoes

item:EPI_Camp_Shoes_Jaheira.description: Sturdy shoes that, with a bit of polish, clean up nicely.
item:EPI_Camp_Shoes_Jaheira.name: Thick Soled Shoes

item:EPI_Camp_Shoes_Jaheira_Harper.description: Standard issue boots that may or may be modified depending on the wearer's needs. Examples include hidden knives, poison darts, and so on.
item:EPI_Camp_Shoes_Jaheira_Harper.name: Harper Boots

item:EPI_Camp_Shoes_Laezel_Faerun.description: Unusually plain, unusually versatile. Only slightly stained by the blood of the wearer's unfortunate prey.
item:EPI_Camp_Shoes_Laezel_Faerun.name: Nomad's Sandals

item:EPI_Camp_Shoes_Laezel_Gith.description: Lavishly decorated by M'Lar of the Comet with stolen metal filigree and pilfered rubies.
item:EPI_Camp_Shoes_Laezel_Gith.name: Senja'si Boots

item:EPI_Camp_Shoes_Minsc.description: These shoes were made for stomping villainy wherever it rears its evil head.
item:EPI_Camp_Shoes_Minsc.name: Boots of Butt-Kicking

item:EPI_Camp_Shoes_Minthara.description: Embroidered with pure silver, these slippers are as striking as they are comfortable.
item:EPI_Camp_Shoes_Minthara.name: Moonlit Slippers

item:EPI_Camp_Shoes_Minthara_Drow.description: The vivid purple design of these shoes was inspired by the dissolving effect certain poisons have on the body.
item:EPI_Camp_Shoes_Minthara_Drow.name: Deadly Dress Shoes

item:EPI_Camp_Shoes_PartyTav_1.description: Intricately embroidered to the highest standards, these booties are the height of current Sword Coast fashion.
item:EPI_Camp_Shoes_PartyTav_1.name: Brocade Booties

item:EPI_Camp_Shoes_PartyTav_2.description: Made with medium-grade leather but finely wrought, these sandals will last several seasons without going out of fashion.
item:EPI_Camp_Shoes_PartyTav_2.name: Simple Sandals

item:EPI_Camp_Shoes_PartyTav_3.description: This shoe sacrifices style for sturdiness, for the wearer who may wish to beat a hasty retreat from a fancy party.
item:EPI_Camp_Shoes_PartyTav_3.name: Basket Shoe

item:EPI_Camp_Shoes_PartyTav_4.description: Gold on your toes. The very height of luxury.
item:EPI_Camp_Shoes_PartyTav_4.name: Glittering Slippers

item:EPI_Camp_Shoes_Selune.description: Made of locally-sourced wool and leather, these shoes were designed to survive hard work while still making an impression.
item:EPI_Camp_Shoes_Selune.name: Selûnite Slippers

item:EPI_Camp_Shoes_Shar.description: Cold and cruel, these boots would inflict serious damage if used in violence.
item:EPI_Camp_Shoes_Shar.name: Metallic Boots

item:EPI_Camp_Shoes_Spawn.description: Newly repaired soles and a lick of polish can't hide the fact that these shoes have been nearly worn through.
item:EPI_Camp_Shoes_Spawn.name: Worn Shoes

item:EPI_Camp_Shoes_Wyll_Blade.description: Crafted from tough, reinforced leather, these oft-oiled boots are sure to survive many years of use.
item:EPI_Camp_Shoes_Wyll_Blade.name: Well-Cobbled Boots

item:EPI_Camp_Shoes_Wyll_Duke.description: Patterned with twists of gold, lilac, and sapphire, these ornate shoes suggest ducal decorum.
item:EPI_Camp_Shoes_Wyll_Duke.name: Duke's Formal Footwear

item:EPI_Camp_Spawn.description: While the leather is cheap and the silver is simply paint, this outfit is clearly loved and well looked after.
item:EPI_Camp_Spawn.name: Dandy's Dream Ensemble

item:EPI_Camp_Wyll_Blade.description: A standard gambeson of quilted cloth. Good for catching blows, though unbearably warm against the skin.
item:EPI_Camp_Wyll_Blade.name: The Blade's Padded Armour

item:EPI_Camp_Wyll_Duke.description: Envisioned and created by a tailor of considerable talents. To wear it is to make one the envy of both friend and enemy.
item:EPI_Camp_Wyll_Duke.name: Duke's Magnificent Raiments

item:EQ_HAG_Phylactery.description: A menacing cackle emanates from this twisted charm. It whispers to bite, to maim, to kill...
item:EQ_HAG_Phylactery.name: Tarnished Charm

item:FOR_OwlbearCubs_Armor.description: Embroidered with a simple maxim - 'Nature is the True State of the World' - these hides radiate a faint divine power.
item:FOR_OwlbearCubs_Armor.name: The Oak Father's Embrace

item:FOR_Spear_TrueSoul.description: The tip of this spear strikes unerringly towards its target's eyes.
item:FOR_Spear_TrueSoul.name: Vision of the Absolute

item:GOB_DrowCommander_Armor_Leather.description: Tracings of glossy black spider-web mark this drow-made armour. It is supple, but strong - and made to blend in with the dark caves and crevices of the Underdark.
item:GOB_DrowCommander_Armor_Leather.name: Spidersilk Armour

item:GOB_DrowCommander_Gloves_Leather.description: Fabricated from lizard hides in the depths of the Underdark, these gloves were never meant to see the light of day.
item:GOB_DrowCommander_Gloves_Leather.name: Drow Leather Gloves

item:GOB_DrowCommander_Mace.description: Cast deep in the Underdark by duergar slaves, the head of this mace is engraved with spiderwebs. It is ice-cold to the touch.
item:GOB_DrowCommander_Mace.name: Xyanyde

item:GOB_GoblinKing_Warhammer.description: A hand-like brand stamped into the leather handle obscures the notches that would normally signify a hobgoblin's rank.
item:GOB_GoblinKing_Warhammer.name: Faithbreaker

item:GOB_Torturer_Spear.description: The point of this spear is blackened and melted - the uneven metal is designed to catch deep in the wounds it creates.
item:GOB_Torturer_Spear.name: Jagged Spear

item:HAG_HagLair_EyeballNecklace.description: A pale green eye, pierced by the twisting branches of a dead tree - the result of a foolhardy woman begging Auntie for a favour.
item:HAG_HagLair_EyeballNecklace.name: The Ever-Seeing Eye

item:HAG_SwampedHero_OldFancyGreatsword.description: This cumbersome blade looks strong enough to survive journey through all nine Hells.
item:HAG_SwampedHero_OldFancyGreatsword.name: Reinforced Greatsword

item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Absolute_A.description: These grisly trinkets started popping up with the rise of the Cult of the Absolute. While the skull and triangle are made from cheap pewter, rumours suggest the red handprint is made exclusively with blood from ritual sacrifice.
item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Absolute_A.name: Amulet of the Absolute

item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_A_Bronze_A.description: Spots of crumbling green patina are slowly eating away at this once-bronze pendant.
item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_A_Bronze_A.name: Tarnished Pendant

item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_A_Bronze_A.description: Spots of crumbling green patina are slowly eating away at this once-bronze pendant.
item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_A_Bronze_A.name: Tarnished Pendant

item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_A_Gold_A.description: Though this necklace looks simple in design, the tiny filigreed triangles holding the gemstone in place demonstrate the jeweller's skill.
item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_A_Gold_A.name: Gold Pendant

item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_A_Gold_A_1.description: Though this necklace looks simple in design, the tiny filigreed triangles holding the gemstone in place demonstrate the jeweller's skill.
item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_A_Gold_A_1.name: Gold Pendant

item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_A_Silver_A.description: Chunky and a little dated, but made entirely of hammered silver.
item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_A_Silver_A.name: Silver Amulet

item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_A_Silver_A.description: Chunky and a little dated, but made entirely of hammered silver.
item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_A_Silver_A.name: Silver Amulet

item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_B_Bronze_A.description: Though shining brightly, this necklace smells distinctively of rust.
item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_B_Bronze_A.name: Bronze Necklace

item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_B_Gold_A.description: Tiny, ageless flower petals fill the amber stones of this necklace.
item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_B_Gold_A.name: Gold Necklace

item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_B_Gold_A_1.description: Tiny, ageless flower petals fill the amber stones of this necklace.
item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_B_Gold_A_1.name: Gold Necklace

item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_B_Silver_A.description: Sapphire necklaces are popular among Baldur's Gate's patriars as mourning garb - the heavy teardrop-shaped stones represent the weight of their loss.
item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_B_Silver_A.name: Silver Necklace

item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_B_Silver_A.description: Sapphire necklaces are popular among Baldur's Gate's patriars as mourning garb - the heavy teardrop-shaped stones represent the weight of their loss.
item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_B_Silver_A.name: Silver Necklace

item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_C_Bronze_A.description: Bright and polished, this necklace was clearly cherished by its previous owner.
item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_C_Bronze_A.name: Burnished Necklace

item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_D_Bronze_A.description: The interlocked bronze links of this necklace tinkle softly every time you move.
item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_D_Bronze_A.name: Bronze Pendant

item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_D_Gold_A.description: Heavily embossed with filigree, this necklace reflects light in all directions.
item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_D_Gold_A.name: Gold Pendant

item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_D_Gold_A_1.description: Heavily embossed with filigree, this necklace reflects light in all directions.
item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_D_Gold_A_1.name: Gold Pendant

item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_E_Pearl_A.description: Tiny rainbows reflect in the pearls' iridescent shine.
item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_E_Pearl_A.name: Pearl Necklace

item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_E_Pearl_A_.description: Tiny rainbows reflect in the pearls' iridescent shine.
item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_E_Pearl_A_.name: Pearl Necklace

item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_E_Pearl_B.description: Dozens of tiny pearls adorn this necklace, knotted in place by clever gnomish hands.
item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_E_Pearl_B.name: Pearl Necklace

item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_E_Pearl_C.description: Well-to-do households sometimes let their maids wear pearls, believing that the servants' body heat will increase the pearls' lustre.
item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_E_Pearl_C.name: Pearl Necklace

item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_F_Bronze_A.description: Heavily set with gemstones, this necklace weighs more than expected.
item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_F_Bronze_A.name: Polished Necklace

item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_F_Bronze_A.description: Heavily set with gemstones, this necklace weighs more than expected.
item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_F_Bronze_A.name: Polished Necklace

item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_F_Gold_A.description: It is said that wearing a ruby near the heart will increase a lover's courage.
item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_F_Gold_A.name: Polished Necklace

item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_F_Gold_A_1.description: It is said that wearing a ruby near the heart will increase a lover's courage.
item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_F_Gold_A_1.name: Polished Necklace

item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_F_Silver_A.description: Fine strips of silver snake around the emeralds in this necklace, holding them firmly in place.
item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_F_Silver_A.name: Polished Necklace

item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_F_Silver_A.description: Fine strips of silver snake around the emeralds in this necklace, holding them firmly in place.
item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Necklace_F_Silver_A.name: Polished Necklace

item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Selune_A.description: A small, silvered necklace, worn by Selûne worshippers. It is adorned with seven pieces of iolite, a blue gemstone used for navigation at sea.
item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Selune_A.name: Selûnite Amulet

item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Wulbren_A_Blood_Spe.description: Tiny specks of blood cover this amulet. They have pooled into the engravings on the back, spelling out the name 'Wulbren' in a grisly brown hue.
item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_Wulbren_A_Blood_Spe.name: Bloody Amulet

item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_of_Bhaal_A.description: A silver amulet depicting the symbol of Bhaal.
item:LOOT_GEN_Amulet_of_Bhaal_A.name: Amulet of Bhaal

item:LOOT_GEN_Dog_Collar_A.description: Smells a bit rusty, but looks stylish nonetheless.
item:LOOT_GEN_Dog_Collar_A.name: Dog Collar

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_A_Gem_A_Gold.description: A date was once engraved on the inside of this ring, but most of it has long since been worn away by time.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_A_Gem_A_Gold.name: Gold Ring

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_A_Gem_A_Gold_1.description: A date was once engraved on the inside of this ring, but most of it has long since been worn away by time.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_A_Gem_A_Gold_1.name: Gold Ring

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_B.description: Imported in bulk from Calimshan, the gemstone set in this ring is roughly finished and marred with visible flaws.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_B.name: Emerald Ring

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_B_1.description: Imported in bulk from Calimshan, the gemstone set in this ring is roughly finished and marred with visible flaws.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_B_1.name: Emerald Ring

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_B_Gem_B_Gold.description: A mythical creature, depicted in full flight, has been delicately carved into this ring.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_B_Gem_B_Gold.name: Gold Ring

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_B_Gem_B_Gold_1.description: A mythical creature, depicted in full flight, has been delicately carved into this ring.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_B_Gem_B_Gold_1.name: Gold Ring

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_B_Gold_A.description: Encased in delicately twisted gold, this seafoam green stone is of the tourmaline variety.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_B_Gold_A.name: Verdelite Ring

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_B_Gold_A_1.description: Encased in delicately twisted gold, this seafoam green stone is of the tourmaline variety.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_B_Gold_A_1.name: Verdelite Ring

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_B_Silver_A.description: Considered sacred by some gnomes and halflings, the gem set in this ring sparkles brilliantly.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_B_Silver_A.name: Peridot Ring

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_B_Silver_A_1.description: Considered sacred by some gnomes and halflings, the gem set in this ring sparkles brilliantly.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_B_Silver_A_1.name: Peridot Ring

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_C.description: Considered a token of good fortune, this ring's stones are perfectly smooth.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_C.name: Carnelian Ring

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_C_1.description: Considered a token of good fortune, this ring's stones are perfectly smooth.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_C_1.name: Carnelian Ring

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_C_Gold_A.description: Expertly formed and finished, this ring catches the attention of admirers and thieves alike.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_C_Gold_A.name: Gold Ring

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_C_Silver_A.description: The setting around the ruby is chipped and scratched, as if somebody had tried to lever the gem free.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_C_Silver_A.name: Ruby Ring

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_C_Silver_A_1.description: The setting around the ruby is chipped and scratched, as if somebody had tried to lever the gem free.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_C_Silver_A_1.name: Ruby Ring

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_D.description: A purple gemstone set in bronze, this ring has been crafted by a steady and practised hand.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_D.name: Bronze Ring

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_D_Gold_A.description: An unusual piece, this gold-studded amethyst caused a stir at the Wide plaza in Baldur's Gate.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_D_Gold_A.name: Amethyst Ring

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_D_Gold_A_1.description: An unusual piece, this gold-studded amethyst caused a stir at the Wide plaza in Baldur's Gate.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_D_Gold_A_1.name: Amethyst Ring

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_D_Silver_A.description: The silver band's cool undertones highlight this ring's vivid purple gemstone.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_D_Silver_A.name: Amethyst Ring

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_D_Silver_A_1.description: The silver band's cool undertones highlight this ring's vivid purple gemstone.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_D_Silver_A_1.name: Amethyst Ring

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_E.description: Inlaid with semi precious stones, this ring looks expensive - at first glance.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_E.name: Copper Ring

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_E_1.description: Inlaid with semi precious stones, this ring looks expensive - at first glance.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_E_1.name: Copper Ring

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_E_Gold_A.description: Multiple amethysts fresh off the boat from Chult line this ring's band.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_E_Gold_A.name: Gold Ring

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_E_Gold_A_1.description: Multiple amethysts fresh off the boat from Chult line this ring's band.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_E_Gold_A_1.name: Gold Ring

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_E_Silver_A.description: Each purple gemstone set in this thin silver band has been polished until it gleams.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_E_Silver_A.name: Polished Ring

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_E_Silver_A_1.description: Each purple gemstone set in this thin silver band has been polished until it gleams.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_E_Silver_A_1.name: Polished Ring

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_F.description: A cheap ring, decorated only with a sizeable green agate.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_F.name: Bronze Ring

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_F_Gold_A.description: The warm tones of the gold band pair beautifully with this mint-green tourmaline.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_F_Gold_A.name: Tourmaline Ring

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_F_Gold_A_1.description: The warm tones of the gold band pair beautifully with this mint-green tourmaline.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_F_Gold_A_1.name: Tourmaline Ring

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_F_Silver_A.description: A slim-fitting silver band, decorated with a mint green gemstone.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_F_Silver_A.name: Tourmaline Ring

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_F_Silver_A_1.description: A slim-fitting silver band, decorated with a mint green gemstone.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_F_Silver_A_1.name: Tourmaline Ring

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_G.description: This chunky copper ring is embedded with dark green stones.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_G.name: Copper Band

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_G_1.description: This chunky copper ring is embedded with dark green stones.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_G_1.name: Copper Band

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_G_Gold_A.description: A weighted gold ring embellished with emeralds of varying sizes. Simple, but elegant.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_G_Gold_A.name: Gold Band

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_G_Gold_A_1.description: A weighted gold ring embellished with emeralds of varying sizes. Simple, but elegant.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_G_Gold_A_1.name: Gold Band

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_G_Silver_A.description: Calishite emeralds are embedded in this heavy silver ring.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_G_Silver_A.name: Silver Band

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_G_Silver_A_1.description: Calishite emeralds are embedded in this heavy silver ring.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_G_Silver_A_1.name: Silver Band

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_H.description: The garnet at the centrepiece of this ring is like an unblinking, malevolent eye.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_H.name: Garnet Ring

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_H_1.description: The garnet at the centrepiece of this ring is like an unblinking, malevolent eye.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_H_1.name: Garnet Ring

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_H_Gold_A.description: When the light catches, this ring shines like a smouldering flame.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_H_Gold_A.name: Garnet Ring

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_H_Gold_A_1.description: When the light catches, this ring shines like a smouldering flame.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_H_Gold_A_1.name: Garnet Ring

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_H_Silver_A.description: A ruby like a drop of blood sits at the centre of this ring.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_H_Silver_A.name: Ruby Ring

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_H_Silver_A_1.description: A ruby like a drop of blood sits at the centre of this ring.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_H_Silver_A_1.name: Ruby Ring

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_I.description: With a sharpened gemstone at its centre, this ring is capable of cutting the very flesh it decorates.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_I.name: Dark Ring

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_I_Silver_A.description: This silver band is inlaid with onyx and tempered to a sharpened point. Beautiful, but dangerous.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_I_Silver_A.name: Onyx Ring

item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_I_Silver_A_1.description: This silver band is inlaid with onyx and tempered to a sharpened point. Beautiful, but dangerous.
item:LOOT_GEN_Ring_I_Silver_A_1.name: Onyx Ring

item:LOOT_MAG_LegendaryEvasion_Amulet_A.description: Touching this amulet's centrepiece, you are imbued with a vision of woven strands, and the strands coming apart and holding true and firm over your friends, like shields banded in a haze of golden light.
item:LOOT_MAG_LegendaryEvasion_Amulet_A.name: Unflinching Protector Amulet

item:LOW_Elfsong_EmperorSword_LongSword.description: There's a graceful swarthiness to this sword. The inscription in the steel reads - 'My eye wanders far from home / To shores of distant Anchorome.'
item:LOW_Elfsong_EmperorSword_LongSword.name: Sword of the Emperor

item:LOW_JannathRing_Ring.description: Love is the sweetest bird that might migrate to the charming country of your heart.
item:LOW_JannathRing_Ring.name: Till Death Do Us Part

item:LOW_KerriRing_Ring.description: Love is the last cruel leaf to fall in an autumn wide with sorrow.
item:LOW_KerriRing_Ring.name: After Death Do Us Part

item:LOW_MephistosVault_OrphicHammer.description: Every contract a devil makes has some form of insurance - this one is cast in infernal iron and was forged in deep, ruinous hellfire.
item:LOW_MephistosVault_OrphicHammer.name: Orphic Hammer

item:LOW_OfWindrider_Amulet.description: Heavily embossed with filigree, this necklace reflects light in all directions.
item:LOW_OfWindrider_Amulet.name: Amulet of Windrider

item:MAG_Absolute_Protecter_Shield.description: The Absolute's power radiates from this shield, invisible waves of energy beckoning to the Branded.
item:MAG_Absolute_Protecter_Shield.name: Absolute's Protector

item:MAG_Acid_AcidDamageOnWeaponAttack_R.description: Adjusting this unassuming ring on your finger, you hear a faint sizzle, as of pressure being released.
item:MAG_Acid_AcidDamageOnWeaponAttack_R.name: Caustic Band

item:MAG_Acid_AcidMeleeCounter_Cloak.description: Droplets of foul acid drip from the tails of this cloak, as if from the stinger of a demonic scorpion.
item:MAG_Acid_AcidMeleeCounter_Cloak.name: Fleshmelter Cloak

item:MAG_Acid_NoxiousFumes_Gloves.description: These gloves smell like beef mince left to rot in a privy pail.
item:MAG_Acid_NoxiousFumes_Gloves.name: Ichorous Gloves

item:MAG_Acrobat_Shoes.description: These flexible shoes were once owned by Audreyne Willoughs, who, in a somewhat ironic twist of fate, ran away from the circus to join her parents back home.
item:MAG_Acrobat_Shoes.name: Acrobat Shoes

item:MAG_ArcaneTrickster_Ring.description: What better way to disguise one's transgressions than a quickly positioned phantasm after the deed is done?
item:MAG_ArcaneTrickster_Ring.name: Band of the Mystic Scoundrel

item:MAG_Arcanist_Gloves.description: Designed for the jobbing spellcaster, these gloves are well-insulated to prevent digit immolation for the somatically inept.
item:MAG_Arcanist_Gloves.name: Spellmight Gloves

item:MAG_BG_BlightBringer_Shortbow.description: Conducting a series of increasingly sick rituals - involving the ashes of a gnome and silkworms fed fat on the corpse of a dwarven cleric - the goblin shaman Kirruk Redrats created this deadly bow.
item:MAG_BG_BlightBringer_Shortbow.name: Blightbringer

item:MAG_BG_Darkfire_Shortbow.description: This length of yew was polished in a lacquer made from the mingled, cooled, and refined breath of a gold and silver dragon.
item:MAG_BG_Darkfire_Shortbow.name: Darkfire Shortbow

item:MAG_BG_DragonsBreath_Glaive.description: Kereska, the draconic goddess of arcane knowledge, gifted this glaive to a dragonborn when facing off against a group of carbuncular spiders. How their arachnid legs curled and blackened before that night's dark business was done!
item:MAG_BG_DragonsBreath_Glaive.name: Drakethroat Glaive

item:MAG_BG_Harmonium_Halberd.description: The platinum inlays of this halberd hum an otherworldly harmony in the key of C, heightening the wielder's vigour but diminishing their mental faculties. The sound it makes is pining, as if far from its rightful home.
item:MAG_BG_Harmonium_Halberd.name: Harmonium Halberd

item:MAG_BG_Harold_HeavyCrossbow.description: Named after Harold Butterbisk, who owned the Butterbisk Inn in Waterdeep before it was renamed by new owners. The stock of the crossbow reads: Quaffing is a shootable offence.
item:MAG_BG_Harold_HeavyCrossbow.name: Harold

item:MAG_BG_Nimblefinger_Gloves.description: For the right wearer, these supple doeskin gloves offer both comfort and protection - alongside a perfectly attuned sense of where one's fingers are, and what pocket they're picking.
item:MAG_BG_Nimblefinger_Gloves.name: Nimblefinger Gloves

item:MAG_BG_OfAges_Flail.description: Created by a warmongering rakshasa and kept for a time under the careful watch of an astute noble named Lord de'Arnise, this flail is a tool of absolute destruction, and a versatile one at that.
item:MAG_BG_OfAges_Flail.name: Flail of Ages

item:MAG_BG_OfCrushing_Gloves.description: Stitched into the fabric of these gloves are the words: Largest and Largesse, For The Discerning Murderer.
item:MAG_BG_OfCrushing_Gloves.name: Gloves of Crushing

item:MAG_BG_OfDevotion_Shield.description: Any tales about the Paladins of Velen are so ancient as to be almost certainly hearsay. Irrefutable, however, is the powerful blessing they left on this ancient shield, which inspires heart-fluttering bravery to this day.
item:MAG_BG_OfDevotion_Shield.name: Shield of Devotion

item:MAG_BG_OfDexterity_Gloves.description: The point at which the gloves meet the wrist is form-fitting and very snug; almost a hint at the supple quickness and skill these gloves permit the wearer.
item:MAG_BG_OfDexterity_Gloves.name: Gloves of Dexterity

item:MAG_BG_OfEasthaven_Defender_Flail.description: This flail was created to commemorate victory over the devil Belhifet. It has since made its way so far from Easthaven that the locals have long forgotten that chapter of their town's past.
item:MAG_BG_OfEasthaven_Defender_Flail.name: Defender Flail

item:MAG_BG_OfTheBanshee_Bow.description: The impression of an elven face screams silently from the finely curved bow - the image becomes even more disturbing when the bowstring snaps forward on release, emitting a blood-curdling wail.
item:MAG_BG_OfTheBanshee_Bow.name: Bow of the Banshee

item:MAG_BG_OfTheMasters_Legacy_Gauntlet.description: Formerly the property of the royalty of Threskel, these gauntlets impart some of the prince of Threskel's legendary skill with weapons.
item:MAG_BG_OfTheMasters_Legacy_Gauntlet.name: Legacy of the Masters

item:MAG_BG_Sarevok_OfChaos_Greatsword.description: The sword of Sarevok, brother of Gorion's Ward and child of the evil god Bhaal. Though much of its power died with him, the sword is still formidable, and glows with a malevolent light.
item:MAG_BG_Sarevok_OfChaos_Greatsword.name: Sword of Chaos

item:MAG_BG_Wondrous_Gloves.description: A series of motivational quotes have been enthusiastically removed from the embroidery of these gloves, as if in protest.
item:MAG_BG_Wondrous_Gloves.name: Wondrous Gloves

item:MAG_Banites_Gloves.description: Covetous of Mystra's command of the Weave, Bane the Black Hand extends his grasp, each finger comprised of ten thousand fanatics, adjuncts of his evil will.
item:MAG_Banites_Gloves.name: Servitor of the Black Hand Gloves

item:MAG_BarbMonk_Cloth_A_1.description: A garment worn by one of three monks who fought together against Headless Serpent, Secret Venom, a gang in the port city of Nyanzaru. This was worn by Roahton Mobar, whose stances were broad and strong.
item:MAG_BarbMonk_Cloth_A_1.name: The Graceful Cloth

item:MAG_BarbMonk_Cloth_A_1_Late.description: A garment worn by one of three monks who fought together against Headless Serpent, Secret Venom, a gang in the port city of Nyanzaru. This was worn by Kimigha Poji, whose stances were narrow and swift.
item:MAG_BarbMonk_Cloth_A_1_Late.name: The Mighty Cloth

item:MAG_BarbMonk_Cloth_A_2_Late.description: A garment worn by one of three monks who fought together against Headless Serpent, Secret Venom, a gang in the port city of Nyanzaru. This was worn by Strigga Morkoscavich, whose stances moved fluidly, flawlessly, and who defanged the Serpent one blustery night.
item:MAG_BarbMonk_Cloth_A_2_Late.name: Vest of Soul Rejuvenation

item:MAG_BarbMonk_Cloth_B_1.description: Sharp juts and knobbly nodules of bone stud this armour, as if something ancient sank its teeth deep into the leather and they got stuck there.
item:MAG_BarbMonk_Cloth_B_1.name: Bonespike Garb

item:MAG_BarbMonk_Cloth_Hat_A_1_Late.description: 'If your foe rains down blows upon your head, turn not the other cheek, but let your pricking helm bleed the bastards dry.'
item:MAG_BarbMonk_Cloth_Hat_A_1_Late.name: Fistbreaker Helm

item:MAG_BarbMonk_Cloth_Hat_A_2_Late.description: Formerly worn by Autumnal Baskin, a professional meditator turned bare-knuckle champion, who gained enlightenment via two methods. The first was giving up her addictive reliance on secluded caves and lonely mountaintops, and getting a bit more sociable. This involved many new skirts. Most of them lavender.
item:MAG_BarbMonk_Cloth_Hat_A_2_Late.name: Mask of Soul Perception

item:MAG_BarbMonk_Leather_Circlet.description: Every adventuring party has at least one 'chaotic element'. In the case of one such party, this was the infamous Scabby, a barbarous goblin who was trained by monks.
item:MAG_BarbMonk_Leather_Circlet.name: Scabby Pugilist Circlet

item:MAG_Barbarian_BoneSpike_Gloves.description: These gloves were soaked in the marrow of a Dragon Turtle, its bones broken and their fluid drained in sloppy chunks into vats.
item:MAG_Barbarian_BoneSpike_Gloves.name: Bonespike Gloves

item:MAG_Barbarian_BoneSpike_Helmet.description: The tibia of a storm giant was ground and chiselled and reworked till it became this helm. The wearer can actually smell summer tempest clouds like maroon-dark dread while wearing the helm.
item:MAG_Barbarian_BoneSpike_Helmet.name: Bonespike Helmet

item:MAG_Barbarian_Magic_Armor_1.description: Created by a designer and an enchanter who were going through a messy divorce at the time. As such the armour is filled with passive-aggressive rage.
item:MAG_Barbarian_Magic_Armor_1.name: Enraging Heart Garb

item:MAG_Bard_HealingBardicInspiration_H.description: Putting on this hat is somehow enough to lift your spirits.
item:MAG_Bard_HealingBardicInspiration_H.name: Cap of Curing

item:MAG_Bard_RefreshBardicInspirationSl.description: Tiny bells are sewn into the boots' cuffs. They jingle subtly with every step.
item:MAG_Bard_RefreshBardicInspirationSl.name: Boots of Brilliance

item:MAG_Bard_TempHP_Armor.description: Even though the embroidered velvet won't help against a sharp blade, wearing it fills you with self-assuredness.
item:MAG_Bard_TempHP_Armor.name: Blazer of Benevolence

item:MAG_BasicEnchanted_Quarterstaff.description: In spite of (or perhaps because of) his suspiciously amusing name, the wizard Melf was actually quite a talented spellcaster and innovator in the field of the arcane. He even led an order called the Knights of Luna.
item:MAG_BasicEnchanted_Quarterstaff.name: Melf's First Staff

item:MAG_Bhaalist_Armor.description:
Bhaal, Lord of Murder, was forced to walk the world as a mortal man during a period of history called the Time of Troubles. He was more vulnerable than he had ever been.

But Bhaal was cunning. He had contingencies in case he died.
item:MAG_Bhaalist_Armor.name: Bhaalist Armour

item:MAG_Bhaalist_Gloves.description:
When the Lord of Murder, Bhaal, was rendered mortal, he knew his days were numbered. His vile machinations had gained him many enemies.

Those days ran out and Bhaal was indeed killed, not by a god, but by a man with hawkish features named Cyric.
item:MAG_Bhaalist_Gloves.name: Bhaalist Gloves

item:MAG_Bhaalist_Hat.description: When he was killed, Bhaal's blight upon the world was not destroyed. For the many people upon whom he had sired his spawn slithered out of tainted wombs, and with their arrival Bhaal's malcontent returned with force.
item:MAG_Bhaalist_Hat.name: Assassin of Bhaal Cowl

item:MAG_Bhaalist_Paralyzing_Dagger.description: The dagger's twisting blade is designed to nick the flesh as many times as possible, allowing its paralytic poison to flow effortlessly into any unfortunate target.
item:MAG_Bhaalist_Paralyzing_Dagger.name: Stillmaker

item:MAG_BlackTentacle_Amulet.description: Eldritch sigils seem to coarse through the metalwork on this amulet.
item:MAG_BlackTentacle_Amulet.name: Strange Tendril Amulet

item:MAG_Blindside_Shortsword.description: The best offence is a struck cognisance.
item:MAG_Blindside_Shortsword.name: Render of Mind and Body

item:MAG_Bonded_Baneful_Shortsword.description: The wizard Otiluke wrote about bound weapons and their propensity to coalesce with their wielder as the pair come together. He also wrote about their dangers, which are manifold, and their benefits, which make the danger worth it.
item:MAG_Bonded_Baneful_Shortsword.name: The Baneful

item:MAG_Bonded_Shocking_Warhammer.description: Energy crackles in weird and wonderful patterns across your hand as you wield this bound weapon, as if your very veins were marbled like a cloud of blue-white lightning.
item:MAG_Bonded_Shocking_Warhammer.name: Charge-Bound Warhammer

item:MAG_BonusAttack_AgainstMarked_Circl.description: Huntresses prowling in the least hospitable woods of Toril hold one rule as cardinal: kill quickly. This is not about suffering. It's about sound, and its necessary absence.
item:MAG_BonusAttack_AgainstMarked_Circl.name: Circlet of Hunting

item:MAG_CKM_SerpenScale_Armor.description: The snakefolk of Chult are not known for waste, so often forge lightweight and robust armour like this from their own shed skin.
item:MAG_CKM_SerpenScale_Armor.name: Yuan-ti Scale Mail

item:MAG_CQCaster_ArcaneChargeAfterDash_.description: Fizzling barbs of enchantment magic crackle from the laces of these boots.
item:MAG_CQCaster_ArcaneChargeAfterDash_.name: Boots of Arcane Bolstering

item:MAG_CQCaster_CloseRangedSpellMaster.description: The sting of fear at the encroachment of some hulking brute is lessened by these gloves. In fact, in such moments, they send rivulets of courage coursing through you.
item:MAG_CQCaster_CloseRangedSpellMaster.name: Daredevil Gloves

item:MAG_CQCaster_GainArcaneChargeOnDama.description: Revenge is best served. Hot or cold makes no difference.
item:MAG_CQCaster_GainArcaneChargeOnDama.name: Bided Time

item:MAG_CQCaster_SpellDCBonusWhileThrea.description: A cornered animal will, on occasion, feel a rush of exhilarating energy, and an urge to fight. The same is true of many arcane practitioners, who do not take kindly to being menaced.
item:MAG_CQCaster_SpellDCBonusWhileThrea.name: Browbeaten Circlet

item:MAG_CQCaster_TempHPAfterCast_Cloak.description: The sheer mortal terror of the low-vitality spellcaster (who can be blown over by a wafted spoon) can be partially offset by cloaks like this one.
item:MAG_CQCaster_TempHPAfterCast_Cloak.name: Vivacious Cloak

item:MAG_ChargedLightning_AbilityCheckBo.description: 'Sometimes I just want to feel that spark,' Yrre the Sparkstruck said. 'Feel the lightning course through me.'
item:MAG_ChargedLightning_AbilityCheckBo.name: The Sparkle Hands

item:MAG_ChargedLightning_BonusAC_Robe.description: Yrre the Sparkstruck was raised in the Underdark, so they weren't surprised that power begets envy, and envy begets violence. They were prepared.
item:MAG_ChargedLightning_BonusAC_Robe.name: The Protecty Sparkswall

item:MAG_ChargedLightning_Dash_Boots.description: It is said the Speedy Lightfeet were the first of many lightning inventions made by Yrre the Sparkstruck. The boots' old, frayed edges zap and crackle with even the slightest movement.
item:MAG_ChargedLightning_Dash_Boots.name: The Speedy Lightfeet

item:MAG_ChargedLightning_ElectricSurfac.description: An enormous storm was raging the first time Yrre the Sparkstruck left the Underdark. The deep gnome's interest in lightning became at once an all-consuming obsession, and they would spend the rest of their years striving to recreate that storm's power themselves.
item:MAG_ChargedLightning_ElectricSurfac.name: The Watersparkers

item:MAG_ChargedLightning_Electrocute_Ar.description: Yrre the Sparkstruck got their nickname for both their obsession with lightning and the inventions they created, which had the habit of electrocuting both Yrre and any poor observers that got too close.
item:MAG_ChargedLightning_Electrocute_Ar.name: The Jolty Vest

item:MAG_ChargedLightning_LightningBlast.description: Though they only worked together for a short time, it is hard to overstate the influence Lenore the cleric of Mystra had on Yrre the Sparkstruck, who often likened harnessing lightning to manipulating the Weave.
item:MAG_ChargedLightning_LightningBlast.name: The Blast Pendant

item:MAG_ChargedLightning_Longbow.description: Sleek and lightweight, it is said that the Joltshooter was Yrre the Sparkstruck's favourite weapon. They were indifferent towards bows, but the spikes jutting out of it?
item:MAG_ChargedLightning_Longbow.name: The Joltshooter

item:MAG_ChargedLightning_Quarterstaff.description: Yrre the Sparkstruck intended to give the Spellsparkler to Lenore, a cleric of Mystra and old lover. But when the gnome returned to the cleric's tower, they found it empty - inhabited only by dust and abandoned experiments.
item:MAG_ChargedLightning_Quarterstaff.name: The Spellsparkler

item:MAG_ChargedLightning_Resistance_Rin.description: When the inventor Yrre met the cleric Lenore, sparks flew. Apart, they were in a rut, but together, they inspired each other to push the boundaries of innovation and invention. This ring is just one of their many scientific triumphs.
item:MAG_ChargedLightning_Resistance_Rin.name: The Sparkswall

item:MAG_ChargedLightning_StaticDischarg.description: 'Is there anything as beautiful as lightning striking all around you?' Yrre the Sparkstruck said, letting lightning strike all around them.
item:MAG_ChargedLightning_StaticDischarg.name: The Real Sparky Sparkswall

item:MAG_ChargedLightning_TempHP_Circlet.description: 'Lightning is like magic,' Yrre the Sparkstruck once said. 'And what is magic but life itself?'
item:MAG_ChargedLightning_TempHP_Circlet.name: The Lifebringer

item:MAG_ChargedLightning_Trident.description: When Yrre the Sparkstruck was asked why they'd created a trident twice their size, they simply replied, 'The question is why not?'
item:MAG_ChargedLightning_Trident.name: The Sparky Points

item:MAG_CharismaCaster_Robe.description: This robe is a difficult look to pull off unless one is blessed with an otherworldly charisma.
item:MAG_CharismaCaster_Robe.name: Potent Robe

item:MAG_Cleric_Devotees_Mace.description: This weapon is favoured by celestial devas, the vanguards of the divine ranks of paradise.
item:MAG_Cleric_Devotees_Mace.name: Devotee's Mace

item:MAG_Cold_IncreaseColdDamageOnCast_S.description: The air around this staff crackles with a cold, frosty wind - a power that has been divided for too long, and is waiting to be released.
item:MAG_Cold_IncreaseColdDamageOnCast_S.name: Mourning Frost

item:MAG_Colossal_Greatsword.description: Strong castle-forged steel surmounts a grip of sturdy leather - this immense sword is capable of disembowelling giants in a single swipe.
item:MAG_Colossal_Greatsword.name: Jorgoral's Greatsword

item:MAG_Combat_Quarterstaff.description: Often mistaken for a relic of the wizard Bigby's creation, this staff was, ironically, made as a bite stick for Bigby's dog, Bigboy.
item:MAG_Combat_Quarterstaff.name: Bigboy's Chew Toy

item:MAG_Corrosive_Flail.description: Acid was long ago abandoned by assassins, who found poison much more reliable in spiking their targets' drinks. The acid kept melting the chalices.
item:MAG_Corrosive_Flail.name: Corrosive Flail

item:MAG_Critical_CriticalExecution_Ring.description: Though the ring is highly polished, darkened slivers of blood still cling to small scrapes and corners.
item:MAG_Critical_CriticalExecution_Ring.name: Killer's Sweetheart

item:MAG_Critical_Force_Gloves.description: Indents on the fingertips of these gloves are ringed with tiny meteorites, lined in a shimmering purple light rather than the rich red of astral flame.
item:MAG_Critical_Force_Gloves.name: Craterflesh Gloves

item:MAG_DarkJusticiar_HalfPlate.description: Shar's aspect winds its way through the patterns and pauldrons of this half plate, and any light cast nearby seems to almost quiver away from it, afraid. For even the light knows that the clank of this armour is swiftly followed by a Dark Justiciar's silent blade.
item:MAG_DarkJusticiar_HalfPlate.name: Dark Justiciar Half-Plate

item:MAG_DeadShot_Longbow.description: When the archer Frederik Durlusk died, his only request was to be buried with his favourite bow. This is that bow.
item:MAG_DeadShot_Longbow.name: The Dead Shot

item:MAG_Deathknight_Boots.description: Clad on the desiccated feet of a death knight, these boots have walked a long and terrible path. They strode through the tattered remains of their owner's oath. With every heavy footstep, they have sounded pure fear into the hearts of men.
item:MAG_Deathknight_Boots.name: Blackguard's Greaves

item:MAG_Deathknight_Gloves.description: For some paladins, the iron-clad grip that an oath holds can be too much to bear. When these champions fail and falter, their hands that would guide turn cold, hard, and piercing.
item:MAG_Deathknight_Gloves.name: Blackguard's Gauntlets

item:MAG_DevilsBlackmith_Gloves.description: These gauntlets spark with unfinished, yet still potent devillish magic - indicative of a cancelled blacksmith's commission.
item:MAG_DevilsBlackmith_Gloves.name: Unwanted Masterwork Gauntlets

item:MAG_Drowelf_SpiderSnare_Longsword.description: The trauma of becoming a drider is quickly set aside with a cold arachnid dispassion. This sword follows that disturbing trend - a replenishing poison gland is built within, deployed only against trapped opponents.
item:MAG_Drowelf_SpiderSnare_Longsword.name: Cruel Sting

item:MAG_Druid_IronWood_Club.description: Fashioned from the hard, unforgiving trunk of an oak, this club still retains the perfume of the forest.
item:MAG_Druid_IronWood_Club.name: Ironwood Club

item:MAG_Druid_Ironvine_Shield.description: Each whorl and groove and worm-curled twist of this shield evokes a tangle of bog-stuck trees in rain-swollen vines.
item:MAG_Druid_Ironvine_Shield.name: Ironvine Shield

item:MAG_Druid_Land_Magic_Leather_Armor.description: Smelling of long-abandoned gardens grown wild with thorny roses, moss and hibiscus, this armour was worn by a powerful druid who spent so long from people that she forgot to miss them.
item:MAG_Druid_Land_Magic_Leather_Armor.name: Armour of Landfall

item:MAG_Druid_Late_Hide_Armor_1.description: The bark motifs in this armour are like the boles of oak trees in a wood where the acorns slept long, and grew proud.
item:MAG_Druid_Late_Hide_Armor_1.name: Barkskin Armour

item:MAG_Druid_Late_Hide_Armor_2.description: This magnificent hide was harvested from a rare mythological creature of the Feywild, a cross between a unicorn and a stoat.
item:MAG_Druid_Late_Hide_Armor_2.name: Sharpened Snare Cuirass

item:MAG_Druid_Magic_Hide_Armor.description: This simple cured goat hide was enchanted by a travelling druid. A goatherd once helped her negotiate a strange maze of hedges, so she blessed all his goats in thanks.
item:MAG_Druid_Magic_Hide_Armor.name: Hedge Wanderer Armour

item:MAG_Druid_Moon_Magic_Leather_Armor.description: This armour was designed by lunar-obsessed Cuthbertina, a gnomish arcane smith who now lives peacefully on a mountain plateau with her magical forge.
item:MAG_Druid_Moon_Magic_Leather_Armor.name: Armour of Moonbasking

item:MAG_Druid_Spore_Magic_Leather_Armor.description: According to one story, this armour was enriched by the cascading spores of a myconid sovereign, its great fungal head shimmering and twinkling as it shook upon the material.
item:MAG_Druid_Spore_Magic_Leather_Armor.name: Armour of the Sporekeeper

item:MAG_Druid_Wildshape_Hat.description: 'Trust is the most fundamental part of wild-shaping. Not trusting others, but trusting yourself. Because the assumption of an animalistic form comes part and parcel with risk - that you'll like being a beast. Like it too much. You've got to trust yourself to the extent that you're comfortable courting that danger. Trust yourself the way you trust a marital partner with your heart.' - Mac Tíre, Moon Druid
item:MAG_Druid_Wildshape_Hat.name: Shapeshifter Hat

item:MAG_Drunken_Cloth.description: Long ago, Kushigo was a warrior. Bedecked in enormous, stag-antlered plate, his arrival spelled doom for the enemy. This flimsy cloth speaks nothing to that legacy.
item:MAG_Drunken_Cloth.name: Drunken Cloth

item:MAG_Duergar_Sword_KingsKnife.description: Snatched from the realm of the mad wizard Halaster Blackcloak, this knife became a prized keepsake of a duergar king.
item:MAG_Duergar_Sword_KingsKnife.name: Knife of the Undermountain King

item:MAG_EGW_OfTheDrunkard_Amulet.description: Donning this necklace causes the room to sway and tip - or maybe it was already swaying? Whatever, time for another pint.
item:MAG_EGW_OfTheDrunkard_Amulet.name: Amulet of the Drunkard

item:MAG_ElementalGish_AbsorbElements_Cl.description: A favourite among fleet-footed gish, this cloak allows the wearer to wield a foe's elemental mastery against them.
item:MAG_ElementalGish_AbsorbElements_Cl.name: Cloak of Elemental Absorption

item:MAG_ElementalGish_ArcaneAcuity_Helm.description: Subtle magics are woven into the helmet's leather panes - for a powerful offence is sometimes still the best defence.
item:MAG_ElementalGish_ArcaneAcuity_Helm.name: Helmet of Arcane Acuity

item:MAG_ElementalGish_BaneOnElementalWe.description: The slightest movement of leather makes a dark energy seep out of the gloves.
item:MAG_ElementalGish_BaneOnElementalWe.name: Gloves of Baneful Striking

item:MAG_ElementalGish_CantripBooster_Am.description: The tourmaline in this necklace is almost uncomfortably hot, warmed by a heat all its own.
item:MAG_ElementalGish_CantripBooster_Am.name: Necklace of Elemental Augmentation

item:MAG_ElementalGish_ElementalInfusion.description: The mysterious gem set in this ring seems to change hues whenever you aren't looking.
item:MAG_ElementalGish_ElementalInfusion.name: Ring of Elemental Infusion

item:MAG_ElementalGish_MomentumOnElement.description: Toughened metal boots, highly insulated with heavy leather and padding for use in any and all elements.
item:MAG_ElementalGish_MomentumOnElement.name: Boots of Elemental Momentum

item:MAG_EndGameCaster_Cape_A.description: Part of an outfit worn by the wizard Tenser when he was inducted into the organisation of eminent wizards called the Circle of Eight. Otiluke and Bigby, who were fellow wizards and absolute devils for amusing themselves, enchanted the medallion that was given to Tenser so that it would explode into flatulent terriers when he touched it to his brow.
item:MAG_EndGameCaster_Cape_A.name: Cloak of The Weave

item:MAG_EndGameCaster_Hood_A.description: Worn by the wizard Tenser when he was inducted into the Circle of Eight. After the ceremony in which his fellow wizards Otiluke and Bigby played a trick on Tenser, the two pranksters found their party vodkas spiked with a spell that transformed their earlobes into cynical pixies.
item:MAG_EndGameCaster_Hood_A.name: Hood of the Weave

item:MAG_EndGameCaster_Robe.description: Earnest little Edith Cluckle was a small girl when she asked to be the great wizard Otiluke's apprentice. He scoffed at her, but was quickly abashed when Mystra herself endowed Edith with this very cloak.
item:MAG_EndGameCaster_Robe.name: Robe of the Weave

item:MAG_EndGame_HalfPlate.description: Layered sheets of smelted, shaped, and smithed steel have been etched with a sweetly luminous gold. Its outward appearance is heavy. And yet it's so light when you lift it, like lifting a bag of shrunken dead leaves.
item:MAG_EndGame_HalfPlate.name: Armour of Agility

item:MAG_EndGame_Metal_Boots.description: ''If I had a copper for all the adventurin folk I seen gutted or cut up, or clawed like they was made of wet paper, just cause they couldn't move quick enough when speed might have saved em... well, I'd be suckin good brandy from crystal rather than this fuckin swill.'' - Overheard in a tavern in Baldur's Gate.
item:MAG_EndGame_Metal_Boots.name: Boots of Persistence

item:MAG_EndGame_Plate_Armor.description: Great sheets of steel were hammered and bashed into something like a carapace, thick and dense - you can almost feel the hammer blows, flooded with rich magic.
item:MAG_EndGame_Plate_Armor.name: Armour of Persistence

item:MAG_EndGame_StuddedLeather_Armor.description: After she returned from her confinement at the hands of the demon prince Graz'zt, the Goddess of prosperity, Waukeen, appointed a champion, who donned this studded leather and took up arms against those who had schismed and corrupted her church in the interim.
item:MAG_EndGame_StuddedLeather_Armor.name: Elegant Studded Leather

item:MAG_Evasive_Shoes.description: Rogues in Waterdeep prefer these spring-loaded boots that make evading the city watch a breeze.
item:MAG_Evasive_Shoes.name: Evasive Shoes

item:MAG_Fighter_ActionSurge_AttackBonus.description: Made from steel hammered thin, these gauntlets are a fine investment for any warrior.
item:MAG_Fighter_ActionSurge_AttackBonus.name: Gauntlets of Surging Accuracy

item:MAG_Finesse_Glaive.description: Tiny specks of blood are fused into the blade, as if the glaive is feeding on them.
item:MAG_Finesse_Glaive.name: The Dancing Breeze

item:MAG_Finesse_Longsword.description: Deceptively light, the blade rasps through castle-forged plate as easily as Corellon Larethian's own anarchic holy sword through the hearts of evil orcs.
item:MAG_Finesse_Longsword.name: Larethian's Wrath

item:MAG_Fire_AlwaysDippedInFire_Greatsw.description: Silent flames surge the length of the blade as soon as it clears the scabbard.
item:MAG_Fire_AlwaysDippedInFire_Greatsw.name: Everburn Blade

item:MAG_Fire_ArcaneAcuityOnFireDamage_H.description: It is said some wizard hats grant the power to keep your head cool - both literally and figuratively.
item:MAG_Fire_ArcaneAcuityOnFireDamage_H.name: Hat of Fire Acuity

item:MAG_Fire_BonusActionOnFireSpell_Cir.description: Merely holding the circlet makes your skin flush, filling you with determination and righteous fury.
item:MAG_Fire_BonusActionOnFireSpell_Cir.name: Pyroquickness Hat

item:MAG_Fire_BurningOnDamaged_Cloak.description: With every rustle of this cloak, small moths like windblown embers appear around you - they flutter for a moment, then fade into inconsequence.
item:MAG_Fire_BurningOnDamaged_Cloak.name: Cindermoth Cloak

item:MAG_Fire_FireDamage_Quarterstaff.description: The fire engulfing this staff seems to feed off thin air, never once burning the dark wood.
item:MAG_Fire_FireDamage_Quarterstaff.name: Gold Wyrmling Staff

item:MAG_Fire_HeatOnFireDamage_Gloves.description: Ash dusts the gloves' fingers, darkening their seams.
item:MAG_Fire_HeatOnFireDamage_Gloves.name: Thermoarcanic Gloves

item:MAG_Fire_HeatOnInflictBurning_Boots.description: Despite the many scorch marks, these leather boots are somehow still supple and intact.
item:MAG_Fire_HeatOnInflictBurning_Boots.name: Cinder Shoes

item:MAG_Fire_HeatOnTakingFireDamage_Amu.description: The ruby's red reflections look like eerie flames dancing across your skin.
item:MAG_Fire_HeatOnTakingFireDamage_Amu.name: Fireheart

item:MAG_Fire_HeatOnWeaponDamage_Battlea.description: Designed by gnomish innovation, this weapon has a dynamic core that swivels and tinkles into life whenever the axe is swung at a foe.
item:MAG_Fire_HeatOnWeaponDamage_Battlea.name: Thermodynamo Axe

item:MAG_Fire_IncreasePiercingDamageToBu.description: Though the crossbow's bolts look burning hot, they are pleasantly warm to the touch.
item:MAG_Fire_IncreasePiercingDamageToBu.name: Firestoker

item:MAG_Fire_IncreaseSlashingDamageToBu.description: Somehow, this axe perpetually feels warm to the touch.
item:MAG_Fire_IncreaseSlashingDamageToBu.name: Dragon's Grasp

item:MAG_Fire_SelfImmolation_Ring.description: Every one of the three gems in this ring is searing hot - enough to burn yourself with the slightest brush of your fingers.
item:MAG_Fire_SelfImmolation_Ring.name: Ring of Self Immolation

item:MAG_FlamingFist_BattleWizardGloves.description: 'What moves faster, a loosed crossbow bolt or a windblown cinder? Let's find out.' - Overheard during a Flaming Fist raid in Baldur's Gate.
item:MAG_FlamingFist_BattleWizardGloves.name: Cindersnap Gloves

item:MAG_FlamingFist_Flame_Armor.description: The air around this armour shimmers, oven-hot. From the seams of the armour you can hear a red-tinted rumble, like coals digesting in a furnace.
item:MAG_FlamingFist_Flame_Armor.name: Flame Enamelled Armour

item:MAG_FlamingFist_Flaming_Shield.description: Local rumour claims a devil's tear gives these city militia shields their fire - much to the chagrin of the barracks blacksmith.
item:MAG_FlamingFist_Flaming_Shield.name: Shield of Scorching Reprisal

item:MAG_FlamingFist_ScoutRing.description: A shiny, deceptively simple band, designed to look like those worn by battlefield scouts and city pickpockets alike.
item:MAG_FlamingFist_ScoutRing.name: Shifting Corpus Ring

item:MAG_FlamingFist_StaffOfFire.description: Etchings course red-hot through the length of this staff, the script of primordial fire writ in flame.
item:MAG_FlamingFist_StaffOfFire.name: Incandescent Staff

item:MAG_Frost_Frostbite_Amulet.description: Each sapphire feels like a tiny shard of sharpened ice.
item:MAG_Frost_Frostbite_Amulet.name: Frost Prince

item:MAG_Frost_GenerateFrostOnDamage_Glo.description: Likely these originated in Icewind Dale, where tempers run as hot as hearths, and frozen rivers trace the arm of the dale in a network of blue-white tributaries.
item:MAG_Frost_GenerateFrostOnDamage_Glo.name: Winter's Clutches

item:MAG_Frost_GenerateFrostOnDamage_Rob.description: Delicate ferns of frost glitter in the lining of this robe.
item:MAG_Frost_GenerateFrostOnDamage_Rob.name: Icebite Robe

item:MAG_Frost_GenerateFrostOnStatusAppl.description: Upturning the hat and gazing into it, you get this slightly vertiginous feeling, as if you were looking into a cold, abandoned well with no discernible end.
item:MAG_Frost_GenerateFrostOnStatusAppl.name: Coldbrim Hat

item:MAG_Frost_GenerateSurfaceOnColdDama.description: A series of names have been scratched out, one after the other, on the inside of the ring. The last word, untouched, is not a name. It simply reads: Mine.
item:MAG_Frost_GenerateSurfaceOnColdDama.name: Snowburst Ring

item:MAG_Frost_IceSurfaceProneImmunity_B.description: A smattering of tiny ice crystals have formed cleats on the soles of these hardy boots.
item:MAG_Frost_IceSurfaceProneImmunity_B.name: Hoarfrost Boots

item:MAG_Frost_Offhand_Dagger.description: In the steel, you can see small ice formations like bubbles in a bath, and even hear them pop with crickling crackles of frosted delight.
item:MAG_Frost_Offhand_Dagger.name: Cold Snap

item:MAG_Gandrel_UndeadSlayer_HeavyCross.description: When Gandrel was seven, he was frightened badly by a vampire spawn during a public burning. Seized by the flames, the creature didn't shrivel up. It swelled and burst like a squeezed leech. Brains splattered the boy's shoes, grey-pink and pulpy. He would never forget it.
item:MAG_Gandrel_UndeadSlayer_HeavyCross.name: Gandrel's Aspiration

item:MAG_Generic_01_Amulet_1.description: Imbued with a little luck after the item was pressed to the pursed lips of a saint of the goddess Tymora. Inscribed roughly and inexpertly on the underside: 'Lady Luck, don't you piss in my porridge oats!'
item:MAG_Generic_01_Amulet_1.name: Chancer's Carcanet

item:MAG_Generic_01_Amulet_2.description: The gem in this collar's centre is placed as a common courtesy: it allows the tressym's summoner to be identified and complained to in the case of bereaved pet owners or pigeon-masters. This one glows with a Waterdhavian name: Gale Dekarios.
item:MAG_Generic_01_Amulet_2.name: Tressym Collar

item:MAG_Generic_01_Pike_1.description: Concussive energy thumps like a mighty heartbeat from this pike.
item:MAG_Generic_01_Pike_1.name: Breaching Pikestaff

item:MAG_Generic_01_Ring_1.description: The ring's simplicity is a deceit. Its gold core is woven with iron-hard feathers from the wings of great black corvid birds, envoys of the Raven Queen.
item:MAG_Generic_01_Ring_1.name: Family Ring

item:MAG_Generic_01_Shortbow_1.description: This halfling bow requires a full draw for smaller folk, but serves as a quick off-hand for those of greater height.
item:MAG_Generic_01_Shortbow_1.name: Bow of Awareness

item:MAG_Generic_01_Shortsword_1.description: This blade is one of a few rare swords wielded by the Eucalyptus League, a group of fabulously wealthy courtesans who owned a great deal of Luskan's bazaars.
item:MAG_Generic_01_Shortsword_1.name: Ambusher

item:MAG_Generic_01_Wizard_Hat_E.description: Silvery wings spread over the stiff unyielding leather.
item:MAG_Generic_01_Wizard_Hat_E.name: Marksmanship Hat

item:MAG_Generic_02_HandCrossbow_2.description: Though the crossbow is small and light, a heavy power runs through its bowstring.
item:MAG_Generic_02_HandCrossbow_2.name: Magical Hand Crossbow

item:MAG_Generic_02_Pike_1.description: The base of this polearm's shaft is splintered, likely having borne the weight of a rider plucked from their mount.
item:MAG_Generic_02_Pike_1.name: Magical Pike

item:MAG_Generic_02_Ring_1.description: Fashioned by the wizard Bigby in honour of his faithful hound Bigboy, who could use teleportation to fetch, snare errant cats, and generally harass postmen.
item:MAG_Generic_02_Ring_1.name: Ring Of Blink

item:MAG_Generic_03_Ring_1.description: A paralysing eyestalk harvested from a beholder was boiled in a broth, and poured down the throat of a dwarven ringsmith. Not one fortnight thence, he crafted this ring.
item:MAG_Generic_03_Ring_1.name: Burnished Ring

item:MAG_Generic_04_Ring_1.description: Created by a conglomerate of druids one moonlit night when all the stirring violins of insect, elms, and whispering winds consorted, and when wild beasts in need of taming prowled unseen.
item:MAG_Generic_04_Ring_1.name: Keepsake Ring

item:MAG_Giantslayer_Greatsword.description: Wielded by Balduran, the founder of Baldur's Gate and friend to his guardian dragon, a great glittering wyrm called Ansur. Fellowship can be undone, though, as easily as you or I might unlace the strings of our shoes, and it was in a time of skullduggery and hardship that Balduran killed Ansur, carrying out the deed with this sword.
item:MAG_Giantslayer_Greatsword.name: Balduran's Giantslayer

item:MAG_Gish_ArcaneAcuity_Gloves.description: Bands of blue light snap and contract when the gloved fingertips are pressed together - evidence of the arcane polarity linking them.
item:MAG_Gish_ArcaneAcuity_Gloves.name: Gloves of Battlemage's Power

item:MAG_Gish_ArcaneSynergy_Circlet.description: This circlet shimmers with a hundred otherworldly metals.
item:MAG_Gish_ArcaneSynergy_Circlet.name: Diadem of Arcane Synergy

item:MAG_Gish_ArcaneSynergy_Ring.description: The sharp silver corners of this ring almost cut into the stone set in its centre - a gem of which you've never seen the like before.
item:MAG_Gish_ArcaneSynergy_Ring.name: Ring of Arcane Synergy

item:MAG_Gish_PsychicDamageBonusWhileCon.description: In his speculative writing on arcane displacement, the wizard Tenser notes the possibility for keenly focused minds to maintain spells, and even unlock hidden potential while doing so.
item:MAG_Gish_PsychicDamageBonusWhileCon.name: Strange Conduit Ring

item:MAG_Gish_TempHPWhileConcentrating_B.description: Tenser's notes on arcane displacement were not only read by wizards - other avid readers included enterprising smiths eager to break into the magic items market.
item:MAG_Gish_TempHPWhileConcentrating_B.name: Vital Conduit Boots

item:MAG_Gish_WeaknessBranding_Amulet.description: Though thin and delicate-looking, the amulet's pendant sits heavy against your chest.
item:MAG_Gish_WeaknessBranding_Amulet.name: Amulet of Branding

item:MAG_Githborn_MageHandSupport_Gloves.description: The planar silver cladding of these forearm bracers allows the wielder to channel the latent astral energies floating in the Weave.
item:MAG_Githborn_MageHandSupport_Gloves.name: Hr'a'cknir Bracers

item:MAG_Githborn_MagicEating_HalfPlate.description: After all that was done to them at the illithids' caprice, it is little wonder that the gith would construct armaments fit for combating their psionic might.
item:MAG_Githborn_MagicEating_HalfPlate.name: Psionic Ward Armour

item:MAG_Githborn_Mindcrusher_Greatsword.description: The sharp metal whispers to you. Pleading. Cursing... Echoes of slain foes.
item:MAG_Githborn_Mindcrusher_Greatsword.name: Soulbreaker Greatsword

item:MAG_Githborn_PsionicMovement_Boots.description: When not atop their dragons, gith are not particularly air-worthy. This is probably for the best. The imposition of downward gravity tends to put most people in a mood.
item:MAG_Githborn_PsionicMovement_Boots.name: Boots of Psionic Movement

item:MAG_Githborn_Telekinetic_HeavyCross.description: The soft hum of power emanates from the alien metal.
item:MAG_Githborn_Telekinetic_HeavyCross.name: Crossbow of Arcane Force

item:MAG_GleamingSorcery_Hat.description: 'The thing that you poor sods simply cannot grasp is how effortless all this magical hootie-wootie castie-spellsie business is for me!' - A very stupid sorcerer at a wizard academy ball.
item:MAG_GleamingSorcery_Hat.name: Birthright

item:MAG_Gortash_Boots.description: Each step taken in Gortash's shoes is a reflection of the man himself: quick, sharp, and terrible.
item:MAG_Gortash_Boots.name: Tyrannical Jackboots

item:MAG_Gortash_Cloth.description: One can hardly be called a lord if they aren't dressed as such. A cursory glance at Gortash's finery would reveal intricate garb - a closer look would reveal a maddening attention to even the most minute details of the filigree.
item:MAG_Gortash_Cloth.name: Cloth of Authority

item:MAG_Gortash_Gloves_WithoutNethersto.description: A tyrant's grip must be one of cool, unforgiving, and intricately realised steel. It cannot budge, cannot falter, no matter the pressure, and its fingertips must deeply pierce those who would struggle against it.
item:MAG_Gortash_Gloves_WithoutNethersto.name: Gauntlet of the Tyrant

item:MAG_Gortash_HeavyCrossbow.description: A perfect system must be ruled by a keen eye - and any error foolish enough to rear its head afore the eye must be quickly, precisely, and totally eliminated. This crossbow can help with that.
item:MAG_Gortash_HeavyCrossbow.name: Fabricated Arbalest

item:MAG_GreaterNecromancy_Staff.description: Unlike their father, Thibault, Cherish Hollow was not afraid of zombies. Cherish was afraid of sharks, liquorice, wallpaper, Netherese artefacts, hats (large), the outdoors, the indoors, hats (small), and milk pails. Zombies were a bloody picnic.
item:MAG_GreaterNecromancy_Staff.name: Staff of Cherished Necromancy

item:MAG_GreaterSilver_Greatsword.description: The fervour with which the githyanki express devotion to their queen is admirable to some, disquieting to others. When confronted with the fallibility of the divine (since no one is wholly perfect), who knows what reaction such folk might evince.
item:MAG_GreaterSilver_Greatsword.name: Silver Sword of the Astral Plane

item:MAG_Greenstone_Amulet.description: Originally the kidney stone of an archfey, this object has been, ahem, passed down through the centuries.
item:MAG_Greenstone_Amulet.name: Fey Semblance Amulet

item:MAG_HAV_Sylvan_Scimitar.description: Everything moves strangely in the Feywild, from rivers to behaviours. It's a mercurial place, where the magical and physical can pass permeably through one another.
item:MAG_HAV_Sylvan_Scimitar.name: Sylvan Scimitar

item:MAG_HAV_ThornBlade_Scimitar.description: This blade is sharp and slender as a serpent's fang - and just as likely to inflict a hideous sting.
item:MAG_HAV_ThornBlade_Scimitar.name: Thorn Blade

item:MAG_Harpers_ArmorOfShadows.description: Glutted with lone wolves and well-meaning scallywags, the Harpers are not averse to shadows - quite the contrary. For many such individuals, being swallowed in the dark throat of the night is the only method they know, or care to know.
item:MAG_Harpers_ArmorOfShadows.name: Shadeclinger Armour

item:MAG_Harpers_Harmonizing_Rapier.description: Unsheathed, the steel of this rapier shivers and thrums mellifluously in response to nearby surfaces - the motion brings to mind an actor struck with pre-show nerves.
item:MAG_Harpers_Harmonizing_Rapier.name: Harmonic Dueller

item:MAG_Harpers_HarpersAmulet.description: Nobility can be found in suffering the slings and arrows of outrageous fortune. So can dying. Best to be on guard.
item:MAG_Harpers_HarpersAmulet.name: Amulet of the Harpers

item:MAG_Harpers_JhannylGloves.description: Divine runes accentuate the finger pads. While not a religious sect, the Harpers do not demand the occlusion of religion in their members.
item:MAG_Harpers_JhannylGloves.name: Jhannyl's Gloves

item:MAG_Harpers_OfWeapons_Quarterstaff.description: This quarterstaff is as solid as the bond between each member of the Harpers - even working in anonymity, they do so with a common and righteous cause.
item:MAG_Harpers_OfWeapons_Quarterstaff.name: Harper Sacredstriker

item:MAG_Harpers_RingOfAttraction.description: Glibness is not only in the tongue, but in the body. Gesture is powerful. Think of how many words of comfort can be stored and saved, when a hug will do just as sweetly.
item:MAG_Harpers_RingOfAttraction.name: Ring of Geniality

item:MAG_Harpers_RingOfProjection.description: Organisations like the Harpers do not relegate their activities to head-to-head combat - many a moonlit chase with an evildoer has been resolved with a loose roof tile and a decent throwing arm.
item:MAG_Harpers_RingOfProjection.name: Ring of Flinging

item:MAG_Harpers_RingOfTwilight.description: Dark smoke swirls in the ring's onyx, protecting something within.
item:MAG_Harpers_RingOfTwilight.name: Ring of Twilight

item:MAG_Harpers_ShieldsOfShadows.description: Supposedly fashioned around a lock of hair stolen from the head of the Prince of Gloomwrought, shields of this ilk gladly welcome the dark.
item:MAG_Harpers_ShieldsOfShadows.name: Gloomstrand Shield

item:MAG_Hat_Barbarian_Hide.description: This was created by a designer and an enchanter who were going through a messy divorce at the time. As such, the armour is filled with active-aggressive rage. It also makes you feel like you've wasted the last ten years picking up after a complete tit.
item:MAG_Hat_Barbarian_Hide.name: Horns of the Berserker

item:MAG_Hat_Butler.description: Corroded by Sceleritas' insouciant perversion, this little gibus hat was worn by the Butler before he sank throat-deep into Bhaal's clutches. Once, it was beyond besmirchment. Once, it was lovely.
item:MAG_Hat_Butler.name: Gibus of the Worshipful Servant

item:MAG_Healer_DisengageOnHeal_ChainShi.description: Scored with slime and blood, it seems this chain mail shirt couldn't save its previous owner. Although it may help the next.
item:MAG_Healer_DisengageOnHeal_ChainShi.name: Slippery Chain Shirt

item:MAG_Healer_HPRestoration_Amulet.description: The gemstone centrepiece of the amulet was long ago mottled and dyed by the tears of a martyr.
item:MAG_Healer_HPRestoration_Amulet.name: Amulet of Restoration

item:MAG_Healer_HealSelfPoisonWeapon_Amu.description: Each of this amulet's jewels shines like a viper's eyes.
item:MAG_Healer_HealSelfPoisonWeapon_Amu.name: Broodmother's Revenge

item:MAG_Healer_HealSelf_Helmet.description: Legends say a giant elk and a druid once formed a powerful friendship. When the elk laid down his life for the druid, she crafted this helmet in honour of her beloved friend, so his beauty and compassion would live on forever.
item:MAG_Healer_HealSelf_Helmet.name: Wapira's Crown

item:MAG_Healer_TempHPOnHeal_Boots.description: Sturdy and well-worn, these boots make a snug fit on any wearer.
item:MAG_Healer_TempHPOnHeal_Boots.name: Boots of Aid and Comfort

item:MAG_Heat_Fire_Robe.description: The inside of this robe is dark and faceted like volcanic glass, yet the material is light and soft. Against the skin, it also produces a heat like a toasty fire on a day of snow.
item:MAG_Heat_Fire_Robe.name: Obsidian Laced Robe

item:MAG_Helmet_Watcher_A.description: 'When I found Carixim, he turned to me, with all those poor people's souls crammed into him, and he... he grinned at me. He said, "I been expecting you, boy."' - Overheard from the smith Dammon
item:MAG_Helmet_Watcher_A.name: Steel Watcher Helmet

item:MAG_HigherNecromancy_Staff.description: This staff was wielded by Thibault Hollow, a supremely talented necromancer notable for his overwhelming fear of zombies. Many was the time when his dread lair would echo with a high-pitched shriek when one of them surprised him in a corridor, or when he was taking a bath.
item:MAG_HigherNecromancy_Staff.name: Hollow's Staff

item:MAG_Hunting_Shortbow.description: Supple and strong, this shortbow has been imbued with a ranger's solemn magic - running your fingers along the smooth ash, you can feel that solemnity like a ghost in the shaped wood.
item:MAG_Hunting_Shortbow.name: Hunting Shortbow

item:MAG_Illithid_Carapace_Armor.description: The little tentacle engravings are a nice touch.
item:MAG_Illithid_Carapace_Armor.name: Cerebral Citadel Armour

item:MAG_Illithid_Carapace_Gloves.description: The taut violet leather is drier than snakeskin, and puckered at each knuckle with shallow mouth-shaped pits.
item:MAG_Illithid_Carapace_Gloves.name: Cerebral Citadel Gloves

item:MAG_Illithid_MindOverload_Weapon_Lo.description: Fragments of dead souls are imprisoned in the steel. Angry, powerful, hopeful, or scared - all of them rose up against their illithid masters, and all of them fell to this blade. Now, they are trapped forever, forced to aid their oppressors.
item:MAG_Illithid_MindOverload_Weapon_Lo.name: Blade of Oppressed Souls

item:MAG_Illithid_Regen_Circlet.description: Fell magic has seeped into this circlet, rejoicing at the slightest touch of despair.
item:MAG_Illithid_Regen_Circlet.name: Circlet of Mental Anguish

item:MAG_Infernal_Hellbeard_Halberd.description: Salvaged from the beard of a dead infernal leviathan, whose facial hair was formed from the weapons of an army it had once vanquished.
item:MAG_Infernal_Hellbeard_Halberd.name: Hellbeard Halberd

item:MAG_Infernal_Mace.description: Precise infernal runes are woven into this weapon's filigree, implying a creator well-versed in hellish arcana.
item:MAG_Infernal_Mace.name: Infernal Mace

item:MAG_Infernal_Mace_2.description: Precise infernal runes are woven into this weapon's filigree, implying a creator well-versed in hellish arcana.
item:MAG_Infernal_Mace_2.name: Infernal Mace

item:MAG_Infernal_Metal_Boots.description: No ore takes better to being forged than the infernal iron of Avernus, where the archdevil Zariel presides.
item:MAG_Infernal_Metal_Boots.name: Helldusk Boots

item:MAG_Infernal_Metal_Gloves.description: What precisely confers eternal punishment, reward, absolution? Perhaps it's not just belief in a god. Perhaps the deciding factor is whether the gods believe in you.
item:MAG_Infernal_Metal_Gloves.name: Helldusk Gloves

item:MAG_Infernal_Metal_Helmet.description: It is said that Carixim, the fiendish titan whose flesh squirms with twenty-thousand trapped souls, forged the pieces of this armour set.
item:MAG_Infernal_Metal_Helmet.name: Helldusk Helmet

item:MAG_Infernal_Plate_Armor.description: Carixim, soul-stuffed forgemaster of hellish Avernus, hammers away ceaselessly at new creations. Questions of morality and destiny do not concern him. Conscience is for his betters. He works with cheer, his swollen skin moaning soothingly.
item:MAG_Infernal_Plate_Armor.name: Helldusk Armour

item:MAG_Infernal_Spear.description: Precise infernal runes are woven into this weapon's filigree, implying a creator well-versed in hellish arcana.
item:MAG_Infernal_Spear.name: Infernal Spear

item:MAG_Invisible_Pike.description: Yes, but what exactly is hitting you?
item:MAG_Invisible_Pike.name: Unseen Menace

item:MAG_Jumping_Shoes.description: Likely fashioned in tribute to the extremely small, high-vaulting rascal who pillaged many a hen house - Lupperdiddle Swires.
item:MAG_Jumping_Shoes.name: Swiresy Shoes

item:MAG_JusticiarArmor_Gloves.description: The grip of darkness is a fear felt by many. The grip of a Dark Justiciar's gauntlets is a sacred fear reserved for an unfortunate few.
item:MAG_JusticiarArmor_Gloves.name: Dark Justiciar Gauntlets

item:MAG_Justiciar_Scimitar.description: This light, curved blade is as unusual and unforgiving as the darkness it strikes from.
item:MAG_Justiciar_Scimitar.name: Justiciar's Scimitar

item:MAG_Justiciar_Shield.description: It's never the shield that kills you - but hearing your frantic steel thudding uselessly against this reinforced oak in the darkness is a good sign the end is near.
item:MAG_Justiciar_Shield.name: Justiciar's Greatshield

item:MAG_Ketheric_Shield.description: In the theatre of dreams, Ketheric killed his wife every night. That wasn't how things happened... but always upon waking, he would glare into the dark, long-faced and solemn, and he would think: 'I keep you alive with my memories, beloved. I kill you with what I've become.'
item:MAG_Ketheric_Shield.name: Ketheric's Shield

item:MAG_Ketheric_Warhammer.description: This hammer's weight is centred on enchanted obsidian at the base of the head. Some nights before bed, Ketheric would sneak a whey-faced glance at the hammer, and think about the stone, and wonder what unknown facet of his heart bore his weight.
item:MAG_Ketheric_Warhammer.name: Ketheric's Warhammer

item:MAG_Kuotoa_Lightning_Spear.description: A makeshift spear fashioned from a giant crab's claw and the charged imagination of kuo-toa fishfolk.
item:MAG_Kuotoa_Lightning_Spear.name: Lightning Jabber

item:MAG_LC_BurnOnDamage_Scimitar.description: Mortician Kurwin was known to use his trusty Cauteriser on all sorts of interesting subjects. At first these were cadavers, then people who wouldn't be missed, and it was only after he targeted a well-liked tavern owner that he was ratted out to the law.
item:MAG_LC_BurnOnDamage_Scimitar.name: Kurwin's Cauteriser

item:MAG_LC_CazadorVampiric_Quarterstaff.description: The gentle tap-tap-tap of a staff on stone sparked terror for all in Cazador's palace. It signalled an approaching storm, and all they could do was shrink into the background and pray its wrath would not fall on them.
item:MAG_LC_CazadorVampiric_Quarterstaff.name: Woe

item:MAG_LC_Counterspell_Quarterstaff.description: This staff hums with a disruptive arcane energy that drives nearby spellcasters to distraction.
item:MAG_LC_Counterspell_Quarterstaff.name: Staff of Interruption

item:MAG_LC_Fleshrend_Shortsword.description: The previous owner was going to call this sword Barney, but he got such a bollocking from his friends that he named it Fleshrender instead, and sulked for a whole tenday afterward.
item:MAG_LC_Fleshrend_Shortsword.name: Fleshrender

item:MAG_LC_Lorroakan_Quarterstaff.description: Touching the adornments, it's clear that Lorroakan's short temper has flowed into his staff. It flows into your brain in shades of burgundy and carmine, bright as the storm-lanterns of Lorroakan's homeland.
item:MAG_LC_Lorroakan_Quarterstaff.name: Despair of Athkatla

item:MAG_LC_Lorroakan_Robe.description: Mantled in the sublime majesty of this cloak, you magically sense Lorroakan's complex feelings for his homeland. Merriment and comfort go hand in hand with a jilted sentiment around his lovers and his family. And the old friends he thought of, but would never see again.
item:MAG_LC_Lorroakan_Robe.name: Shelter of Athkatla

item:MAG_LC_PirateCommander_Scimitar.description: Shiver me timbers, this be a devilishly nasty blade.
item:MAG_LC_PirateCommander_Scimitar.name: Salty Scimitar(rrr)

item:MAG_LC_RadiantLight_Rapier.description: After the blade had sliced Kas the Bloody-Handed's throat, it was chosen by Pelor, God of the sun, to do righteous work against the undead.
item:MAG_LC_RadiantLight_Rapier.name: Pelorsun Blade

item:MAG_LC_TheAmplifier_Amulet.description: When on the wrong side of a few sherries, the powerful wizards Bigby and Tenser would sometimes see how many spells they could fit into amulets like this one before they burst.
item:MAG_LC_TheAmplifier_Amulet.name: Spell Savant Amulet

item:MAG_LC_Tinkerer_Gloves.description: Good for a winkle in cases of mechanisms, locks, or some bugger who needs killing.
item:MAG_LC_Tinkerer_Gloves.name: Winkling Gloves

item:MAG_LC_Umberlee_Cold_Sickle.description: The curve of this sickle evokes a pitiless crescent moon over turbulent seas.
item:MAG_LC_Umberlee_Cold_Sickle.name: Wavemother's Sickle

item:MAG_LC_Umberlee_Protection_Cape.description: Little jellyfish-shaped pockets line the inside of this cloak.
item:MAG_LC_Umberlee_Protection_Cape.name: Wavemother's Cloak

item:MAG_Long_Critical_HidingCritical_Cl.description: Rough and coarse, the cloak's materials soften to silk when immersed in shadow.
item:MAG_Long_Critical_HidingCritical_Cl.name: Shade-Slayer Cloak

item:MAG_LowHP_BonusAction_Helmet.description: At the barest touch, you feel a surge of exuberance and stamina - like you could take on anyone and anything.
item:MAG_LowHP_BonusAction_Helmet.name: Helmet of Grit

item:MAG_LowHP_IgnoreAttackOfOpportunity.description: The back bears an inscription under a delicate crescent moon. 'You're a novice no more, Robin. Only right you should carry a little of our Lady's light with you.'
item:MAG_LowHP_IgnoreAttackOfOpportunity.name: Moondrop Pendant

item:MAG_LowHP_IncreaseDamagePsychic_Git.description: Though heavily decorated and inlaid with rubies, the blade's sharp edge suggests its use isn't merely ornamental.
item:MAG_LowHP_IncreaseDamagePsychic_Git.name: Githyanki Greatsword

item:MAG_LowHP_IncreaseDamage_Greataxe.description: Stained brown and reeking of iron, this greataxe once belonged to a killer so deranged, his name was magically scrubbed from all histories.
item:MAG_LowHP_IncreaseDamage_Greataxe.name: Blooded Greataxe

item:MAG_LowHP_TemporaryHP_Shield.description: Soft, loving whispers emanate from this shield. Though barely audible and spoken in some long-forgotten language, they make you feel safe.
item:MAG_LowHP_TemporaryHP_Shield.name: Glowing Shield

item:MAG_LuckySeven_Amulet.description: 'Let your lips turn black as night/On this eve of frightful wights/Let your throat be filled with screams/Nearby looms the Raven Queen!' - A song of dark festivity
item:MAG_LuckySeven_Amulet.name: Corvid Token

item:MAG_MM_Sorcery_SeekingSpell_Gloves.description: Sorcerers operate on a first-come, first-blasted basis.
item:MAG_MM_Sorcery_SeekingSpell_Gloves.name: Spellseeking Gloves

item:MAG_MagicMissile_HandCrossbow.description: On the stock, the crafter of this crossbow etched in tiny print: 'Ifn yer gonna miss, why dontchyae stop being a wally, and hit instead!'
item:MAG_MagicMissile_HandCrossbow.name: Ne'er Misser
