item:MAG_Martial_Exertion_Gloves.description: 'You drop and give me thirty you sumbitch; you think a bugbear's gonna roll over and let you rub his tummy? One two three four - keep going maggot! Stronger, better, tougher!' - Any Sword Coast Drill Sergeant, Invariably
item:MAG_Martial_Exertion_Gloves.name: Martial Exertion Gloves

item:MAG_MeleeDebuff_AttackDebuff2_OnDam.description: Legends say the Giantbreaker earned its name when an elven ranger singlehandedly defeated a score of hill giants. While the ranger's name is long forgotten, Giantbreaker's lives on.
item:MAG_MeleeDebuff_AttackDebuff2_OnDam.name: Giantbreaker

item:MAG_MeleeDebuff_AttackDebuff2_OnDam.description: The adamantine plates lock and slide together perfectly - offering protection against even the deadliest of blades.
item:MAG_MeleeDebuff_AttackDebuff2_OnDam.name: Adamantine Splint Armour

item:MAG_MissileProtection_Shield.description: Attached to this shield is a faded note. 'G, I've found the best defence against an arrow is to be the one behind the bow - but this shield also does the trick in a pinch. Yours, AA'
item:MAG_MissileProtection_Shield.name: Abdel's Trusted Shield

item:MAG_Mobility_ExplosionOnJump_Maul.description: The Dwarven grammar is garbled, but the weapon's name suggests something about the importance of first impressions.
item:MAG_Mobility_ExplosionOnJump_Maul.name: Hamarhraft

item:MAG_Mobility_JumpOnDash_Gloves.description: Plain leather with a faint but unmistakable buzz - as if eager to put idle hands to work.
item:MAG_Mobility_JumpOnDash_Gloves.name: Fleetfingers

item:MAG_Mobility_LowHP_Momentum_Ring.description: Tiny barbs prick the wearer when they're injured, as if urging flight from danger.
item:MAG_Mobility_LowHP_Momentum_Ring.name: Spurred Band

item:MAG_Mobility_MomentumOnAttack_Scimi.description: A heavy haft and wide blade belie the speed of this weapon. It parts the air as swiftly as any duelling sabre.
item:MAG_Mobility_MomentumOnAttack_Scimi.name: Speedy Reply

item:MAG_Mobility_MomentumOnCombatStart_.description: The helm throbs when violence is near, filling the wearer with a compulsion to act.
item:MAG_Mobility_MomentumOnCombatStart_.name: Haste Helm

item:MAG_Mobility_MomentumOnDash_Boots.description: Supple leather rebounds with every step, as if urging the wearer on.
item:MAG_Mobility_MomentumOnDash_Boots.name: Springstep Boots

item:MAG_Monk_Cold_Gloves.description: Cracking your knuckles in these gloves dislodges puffy drifts of snow from your fingers.
item:MAG_Monk_Cold_Gloves.name: Snow-Dusted Monastery Gloves

item:MAG_Monk_Fire_Gloves.description: It was through scrying and observing blazing elementals that the monks of Plumgully Temple mastered the art of fighting fire with fists, and vice versa.
item:MAG_Monk_Fire_Gloves.name: Gloves of Cinder and Sizzle

item:MAG_Monk_Magic_Armor.description:
Long ago, Kushigo was a warrior. Bedecked in an enormous set of plate steel, its shoulder pauldrons fashioned like great antlered stags, his arrival on a battlefield spelled doom for the enemy.

Yet this armour - so light and fine - speaks nothing to that legacy.
item:MAG_Monk_Magic_Armor.name: Armour of Uninhibited Kushigo

item:MAG_Monk_Magic_Armor_1.description:
Long ago, Kushigo was a warrior. Bedecked in an enormous set of plate steel, its shoulder pauldrons fashioned like great antlered stags, his arrival on a battlefield spelled doom for the enemy.

Yet this armour - so light and fine - speaks nothing to that legacy.
item:MAG_Monk_Magic_Armor_1.name: Garb of The Land and Sky

item:MAG_Monk_Magic_Boots.description:
During a hilltop battle that soaked the slopes in gore, Kushigo's best friend Irishi was scalped before he could help her.

The enemy held up the bloody wig, and Kushigo fell upon one, and then another, until he had killed so many that they hung from his antlered shoulders like skewered effigies.
item:MAG_Monk_Magic_Boots.name: Boots of Uninhibited Kushigo

item:MAG_Monk_Magic_Gloves.description: Forsaking his infamous armour, Kushigo left Irishi's body and wandered naked, without thought or care, into the barren countryside. The land was flat and desolate under the red-gold sun, but compared to his lonely heart, it seemed alive with joy.
item:MAG_Monk_Magic_Gloves.name: Gloves of Uninhibited Kushigo

item:MAG_Monk_Magic_Hat.description:
Coming upon a wise woman, Kushigo got drunk and grew maudlin, and told her about Irishi's scalping. She gave him some clothes - light and fine - and encouraged him to take his time to grieve. He did.

And, when he was ready, he fought again, uninhibited by steel or fellowship - for they only weighed him down.
item:MAG_Monk_Magic_Hat.name: Hat of Uninhibited Kushigo

item:MAG_Monk_Thunder_Gloves.description: Each blow landed while wearing these gloves produces the rumbling boom of a thousand demons' ravenous stomachs.
item:MAG_Monk_Thunder_Gloves.name: Thunderpalm Strikers

item:MAG_MonsterSlayer_Glaive.description:
Monster-slaying is a rare calling, not for the faint of heart. It requires temperance, discipline, and usually a very big stick with something pointy at the end.
The best thing about spears is that the ugly parts of combat are happening at the other end.
item:MAG_MonsterSlayer_Glaive.name: Monster Slayer Glaive

item:MAG_Moonlight_Glaive.description: A gift from Dame Aylin and her radiant goddess, this weapon's contours hold a silver-white beauty akin to the nightly lantern that climbs the firmament each evening.
item:MAG_Moonlight_Glaive.name: Moonlight Glaive

item:MAG_Murderous_Dagger.description: Odd to think that dark gods like Bhaal were once mortal. One wonders if they ever thumbed a wagon ride, thought about the weather, or ate flavoured yoghurt.
item:MAG_Murderous_Dagger.name: Murderous Cut

item:MAG_Myrkulites_CircletOfMyrkul_Circ.description: A coldness clings to this macabre circlet, like the chill of a grave.
item:MAG_Myrkulites_CircletOfMyrkul_Circ.name: Circle of Bones

item:MAG_Myrkulites_RingofMyrkul_Ring.description: Gazing through this ring, you find that there is no other side, only a small sucking blackness that defies explanation.
item:MAG_Myrkulites_RingofMyrkul_Ring.name: Ring of Exalted Marrow

item:MAG_OB_Paladin_DeathKnight_Longswor.description: Formerly wielded by one who forsook all ties of friendship and kindness, this sword is rife with deranged energies. It seems to transmit feelings of contentment when carving through bones.
item:MAG_OB_Paladin_DeathKnight_Longswor.name: Blackguard's Sword

item:MAG_OB_Paladin_DeathKnight_Shield.description: Where once this shield would protect the rallying forces of good - now it pushes them back, crushing them against their allies until they pop.
item:MAG_OB_Paladin_DeathKnight_Shield.name: Shield of the Undevout

item:MAG_OfArcanicAssault_Robe.description: This robe once belonged to one of the great wizard Tenser's lecturers. While in university, Tenser used to practise spells on this robe, sometimes resulting in wonderful arcane discovery.
item:MAG_OfArcanicAssault_Robe.name: Robe of Exquisite Focus

item:MAG_OfArcanicDefense_Robe.description: Long ago, the young wizard Bigby noticed his friend Tenser spending a lot of time with his robe. One of nature's pranksters, Bigby sent his dog, Bigboy, to savage the garment. The ensuing struggle between canine and nude wizard was brutal, and eventually led to Tenser designing more durable robes like this one.
item:MAG_OfArcanicDefense_Robe.name: Robe of Supreme Defences

item:MAG_OfAutomaton_Gloves.description: Llena the Many-Times-Married would use these gloves to blend in with the statues in her courtyard. This would allow her to avoid her plethora of husbands. Anything for a moment's peace.
item:MAG_OfAutomaton_Gloves.name: Gloves of the Automaton

item:MAG_OfFeywildSparks_Ring.description: This otherwise unassuming ring ties a spellcaster indelibly to the sporadic arcana of the Faerie realm.
item:MAG_OfFeywildSparks_Ring.name: Ring of Feywild Sparks

item:MAG_OfRevivify_Gloves.description: Stitched into the lining is the phrase: 'Yes all right, all right, stop moaning and get up.'
item:MAG_OfRevivify_Gloves.name: The Reviving Hands

item:MAG_OfRupture_Rapier.description: The point of the rapier is capable of splitting into heated barbs, should the wielder decide to prick themselves to activate them - sacrifice for reward.
item:MAG_OfRupture_Rapier.name: Rupturing Blade

item:MAG_OfSharpCaster_Hat.description: All you need now is a holster for your wand, tobacco to chew, and some sort of pack animal to ride, and you'll look like a complete and utter bingus.
item:MAG_OfSharpCaster_Hat.name: Hat of the Sharp Caster

item:MAG_OfShielding_Shield.description: Named in the style of Extremely Unimaginative Jimmy, the geographer and interior decorator who named the 'waterfall' and the 'fireplace'.
item:MAG_OfShielding_Shield.name: Shield of Shielding

item:MAG_OfSpellPower_Quarterstaff.description: A near-perfect relic that is only blemished by the collected palm-sweat of various archmagi from across the Realms.
item:MAG_OfSpellPower_Quarterstaff.name: Staff of Spell Power

item:MAG_OfSwordmaster_Gloves.description: The famous drow with his heart of gold, Drizzt Do'Urden, is not the pioneer of the 'twin sword style' of fighting, though he was among the best practitioners.
item:MAG_OfSwordmaster_Gloves.name: Swordmaster Gloves

item:MAG_OfTheBalancedHands_Gloves.description: Formerly worn by Doubleway Douglas Fairbanks, who was so ambidextrous his tears ran down the back of his neck.
item:MAG_OfTheBalancedHands_Gloves.name: Gloves of the Balanced Hands

item:MAG_OfTheDevout_Amulet.description: Otto, a member of the powerful arcane organisation the Circle of Eight, had a penchant for amulets. So much so that they announced his arrival before he ever needed to.
item:MAG_OfTheDevout_Amulet.name: Amulet of The Devout

item:MAG_OfTheDuelist_Gloves.description: Ways of beginning a duel have varied over the years. Perhaps the most famous is the Bildumbacher Method, in which the instigator drips paint thinner onto the opponent's socks.
item:MAG_OfTheDuelist_Gloves.name: Gloves of The Duellist

item:MAG_OfTheShapeshifter_Mask.description: The magic of this mask comes from its gory provenance, and makes it perfect for the discerning actor, sleuth, or person with a mirror and time to kill.
item:MAG_OfTheShapeshifter_Mask.name: Mask of the Shapeshifter

item:MAG_OfUndeadServant_Ring.description: Slipping one's finger through this ring fills the senses with the waft of tombs, the urine-yellow smell of old bandages, images of dead spiders curled into husks, and the sensation of hot, slobbering breath at the nape of one's neck.
item:MAG_OfUndeadServant_Ring.name: Crypt Lord Ring

item:MAG_OfWarMaster_Gloves.description: Clothing doesn't tend to have much personality. That comes down to how it's worn. Yet these gloves exude a confidence, an intangible aura of expertise.
item:MAG_OfWarMaster_Gloves.name: Gauntlets of the Warmaster

item:MAG_OpenHand_Radiant_Gloves.description: Apparently this is what happens to your handwear when you clock an angel in the chops.
item:MAG_OpenHand_Radiant_Gloves.name: Seraphic Pugilist Gloves

item:MAG_Orin_Cloth.description: Hard, fleshy leather has been derived from a countless slew of victims to form this armour for Bhaal's fetid chosen.
item:MAG_Orin_Cloth.name: Mutilated Carapace

item:MAG_Orpheus_Ring.description: When light catches this ring at the right angle, it pulses with a dizzying, intoxicating glow befitting the jewellery of the Prince of the Comet.
item:MAG_Orpheus_Ring.name: Orphic Ring

item:MAG_Orthon_Hellfire_HandCrossbow.description: Rigged to draw on the skin-peeling hellfire of Avernus by a resourceful devil, this crossbow's size is no indication of its deadly potential.
item:MAG_Orthon_Hellfire_HandCrossbow.name: Hellfire Hand Crossbow

item:MAG_PHB_CloakOfDisplacement_Cloak.description: The fur is so blue as to be almost black. When mantled across your shoulders, the patterns on the cloak seem to shift and ripple.
item:MAG_PHB_CloakOfDisplacement_Cloak.name: Cloak of Displacement

item:MAG_PHB_CloakOfProtection_Cloak.description:
Wizards Otiluke and Bigby may be renowned as dignified members of the Circle of Eight, but on one occasion, as younger men, Bigby bet Otiluke that he couldn't suck thirteen litres of vodka out of a protection cloak like this one.

Bigby won.
item:MAG_PHB_CloakOfProtection_Cloak.name: Cloak of Protection

item:MAG_PHB_Defender_Greataxe.description: The power of this axe lies in a fluctuating arcane enchantment that flows between the beard and the edge of the axe, and the wielder themselves.
item:MAG_PHB_Defender_Greataxe.name: Defender Greataxe

item:MAG_PHB_DwarvenThrower_Warhammer.description: The first Dwarven Thrower was created unintentionally. The moment was transcribed in the annals of dwarfdom thusly: 'Ach, it doesn't work. Another design down the bloody drain. Now to... Does er... Does anyone else hear a sort of humming whistle? Growing louder?'
item:MAG_PHB_DwarvenThrower_Warhammer.name: Dwarven Thrower

item:MAG_PHB_ElvenChain_Armor.description: The weight of the interwoven steel rings is offset by clever elven craftsmanship - rustling against your undershirt, the mail feels like you're wearing a cloud.
item:MAG_PHB_ElvenChain_Armor.name: Elven Chain

item:MAG_PHB_OfEvasion_Ring.description: Decorated with a hummingbird wrought of jade and sapphire, this ring evokes the sheer wonderful quickness of that animal.
item:MAG_PHB_OfEvasion_Ring.name: Ring of Evasion

item:MAG_PHB_OfFreeAction_Ring.description: The heart of the gem seems to flow like liquid - yet it contains neither quicksilver nor mercury.
item:MAG_PHB_OfFreeAction_Ring.name: Ring of Free Action

item:MAG_PHB_OfJumping_Ring.description: The ring is scuffed and twisted out of shape, as if worn by big stony fingers. The owner of those fingers has carved 'Karthol' into the warped metal in a fit of affection or possessiveness.
item:MAG_PHB_OfJumping_Ring.name: Ring of Jumping

item:MAG_PHB_OfLifestealing_Shortsword.description: Folded into the steel of this menacing weapon is an alloy of enchanted metal. It waits like a leech in thick swamp water, awaiting a victim to taste, awaiting a chance to restore your heartiness and inflict suffering on your foes.
item:MAG_PHB_OfLifestealing_Shortsword.name: Sword of Life Stealing

item:MAG_PHB_OfRegeneration_Ring.description: This ring is, in effect, a tiny field medic that won't charge you 70 gold pieces for a fifteen-minute consultation.
item:MAG_PHB_OfRegeneration_Ring.name: Ring of Regeneration

item:MAG_PHB_OfSoulCatching_Gloves.description: Formerly worn by Autumnal Baskin, a professional meditator turned bare-knuckle champion, who gained enlightenment via two methods. The second was getting a lot of fighting acumen. Advanced cosmic harmony is a nose. Sometimes you've got to break it a few times to get the best of things.
item:MAG_PHB_OfSoulCatching_Gloves.name: Gloves of Soul Catching

item:MAG_PHB_OfSpeed_Scimitar.description: Faded but still legible, the mark of a Kara-Turan forgemaster adorns the pommel of this exquisite sword. Light as a robin's wing, quick as gnomish wit, this weapon has unseamed many foes - and will continue to, in the correct hands.
item:MAG_PHB_OfSpeed_Scimitar.name: Belm

item:MAG_PHB_OfThievery_Gloves.description: Useful for bank vaults, locked chests, and bolted barns.
item:MAG_PHB_OfThievery_Gloves.name: Gloves of Thievery

item:MAG_PHB_PactKeeper_Quarterstaff.description: The texture of magic granted by a warlock's patron is largely dependent upon the patron themselves - for example, your standard eldritch patron's probably going to work some eyeball-mottled tentacles in there somewhere.
item:MAG_PHB_PactKeeper_Quarterstaff.name: Caitiff Staff

item:MAG_PHB_PeriaptofWoundClosure_Amule.description: Sometimes the best thing you can do for your friends is to stop bleeding and give them a chance to sort everything out.
item:MAG_PHB_PeriaptofWoundClosure_Amule.name: Periapt of Wound Closure

item:MAG_PHB_Ring_Of_Protection.description: Elegant motifs of warding - shields, targes, bucklers, and buffers - are faintly impressed into the metal round of the ring.
item:MAG_PHB_Ring_Of_Protection.name: Ring of Protection

item:MAG_PHB_Sentinel_Shield.description: Clever enchantments dance between the grooves of this shield, which emanates a magic of heightened awareness.
item:MAG_PHB_Sentinel_Shield.name: Sentinel Shield

item:MAG_PHB_ofPower_Pearl_Amulet.description: There are no molluscs of power, alas.
item:MAG_PHB_ofPower_Pearl_Amulet.name: Pearl of Power Amulet

item:MAG_Paladin_LayOnHandsSupport_Glove.description: Suede covers the palms of these gloves - ensuring a soft, comforting touch for anyone in need of help.
item:MAG_Paladin_LayOnHandsSupport_Glove.name: Gloves of Heroism

item:MAG_Paladin_MomentumOnConcentration.description: The metal of these greaves is comfortably warm against your shins, as though heated by your mere presence.
item:MAG_Paladin_MomentumOnConcentration.name: Boots of Striding

item:MAG_Paladin_RestoreChannelDivinity_.description: The soft hum of a fervent prayer reverberates throughout the armoured plates.
item:MAG_Paladin_RestoreChannelDivinity_.name: Armour of Devotion

item:MAG_Paladin_SmiteSpellsSupport_Helm.description: A set of runes has been expertly worked into the helmet's filigree. Almost imperceptible - but powerful nonetheless.
item:MAG_Paladin_SmiteSpellsSupport_Helm.name: Helmet of Smiting

item:MAG_PassWithoutTrace_Ring.description: For some, darkness is wielded like a black opal stud embedded in a signet ring - fashioned to a sharp and unforgiving point.
item:MAG_PassWithoutTrace_Ring.name: Ring of Shadows

item:MAG_Plate_Deathknight_Armor.description: To break one's oath is a dangerous game - it marks you as a faithless cur, an exile without a cause. This armour is tempered by an age of rocks, blades, and persecution turned against it - and is buffed by the immutable, unbindable will of its wearer.
item:MAG_Plate_Deathknight_Armor.name: Blackguard's Plate

item:MAG_PoR_OfVigilance_Halberd.description: A variant of this halberd's design was thrown out in the early stages of development by its forgemaster. This was because the halberd kept expressing itself. 'ALARM!' it would shriek in peril. 'POTENCY FILLS ME LIKE A SONG OF HOPE!' it roared in triumph.
item:MAG_PoR_OfVigilance_Halberd.name: Halberd of Vigilance

item:MAG_Poison_Greatclub.description: Few things solve a disagreement faster than displaying a greatclub. And this one reeks, too.
item:MAG_Poison_Greatclub.name: Argument Solver

item:MAG_Poison_InflictPoisonHealSelf_Cl.description: Based on a mad alchemist's experiments to derive youth from his victims by poisoning them, this cloak relies on a much more reliable arcane formula.
item:MAG_Poison_InflictPoisonHealSelf_Cl.name: Derivation Cloak

item:MAG_Poison_PoisonExposure_Gloves.description: While the leather is clean and well-maintained, a cold, acrid smell permeates these gloves.
item:MAG_Poison_PoisonExposure_Gloves.name: Poisoner's Gloves

item:MAG_Poison_PoisonLethality_Ring.description: Strange, green fumes seep from the ring's emerald.
item:MAG_Poison_PoisonLethality_Ring.name: Poisoner's Ring

item:MAG_Primeval_Silver_Longsword.description: Heavy and grouted in the gore of countless centuries, this prototype for the contemporary githyanki silver sword was wielded during their rebellion against the mind flayers who enslaved them.
item:MAG_Primeval_Silver_Longsword.name: Voss' Silver Sword

item:MAG_Projectile_Shoes.description: These shoes were formerly enchanted to return to their owner's feet. This caused a great deal of trouble for owners, who, while wearing a slipper or a nice heeled number, kept being kicked in the ankles by jealous footwear.
item:MAG_Projectile_Shoes.name: Slinging Shoes

item:MAG_Psychic_MentalFatigue_Gloves.description: Somewhere deep in the spongy grey matter and little jiggly bits that comprise the brain, the memory of the slimy tadpole slithering over your eyeball lingers...
item:MAG_Psychic_MentalFatigue_Gloves.name: Braindrain Gloves

item:MAG_Psychic_MentalOverload_Ring.description: The patterns in the ring's swirling metal make your head spin whenever you look at them for too long.
item:MAG_Psychic_MentalOverload_Ring.name: Ring of Mental Inhibition

item:MAG_RadiantLight_Morningstar.description: The power of this item lies in belief, though not in any god. This item believes that it's very good at hitting things, so it is. Belief is quite powerful when it comes to violence.
item:MAG_RadiantLight_Morningstar.name: The Sacred Star

item:MAG_Radiant_CrusaderMantle_Cloak.description: This garment accidentally fell into the communal steambaths during the All Saints Morning Retreat And Candlelit Guided Meditation.
item:MAG_Radiant_CrusaderMantle_Cloak.name: Mantle of the Holy Warrior

item:MAG_Radiant_DamageBonusOnIlluminate.description: A grudging gleam emits from this ring - more an indictment of light than an endorsement.
item:MAG_Radiant_DamageBonusOnIlluminate.name: Callous Glow Ring

item:MAG_Radiant_RadiatingOrb_Armor.description: Many an adventurer has found themselves swallowed up by the dark throat of some nameless dungeon, aching for a glimpse of light.
item:MAG_Radiant_RadiatingOrb_Armor.name: Luminous Armour

item:MAG_Radiant_RadiatingOrb_Gloves.description: The pads of each fingertip shine from the fabric with a garish glow.
item:MAG_Radiant_RadiatingOrb_Gloves.name: Luminous Gloves

item:MAG_Radiant_RadiatingOrb_Ring.description: Provocative light blooms from the engraved contours of this ring.
item:MAG_Radiant_RadiatingOrb_Ring.name: Coruscation Ring

item:MAG_Radiant_Radiating_Hammer.description: Look no further than Scyllua Darkhope - fallen paladin and champion of Bane - to see how the tools of good can be turned to evil purpose.
item:MAG_Radiant_Radiating_Hammer.name: Shining Staver-of-Skulls

item:MAG_Radiant_Radiating_Helmet.description: Brief halos of divine light wrap your head when you don and doff this helmet.
item:MAG_Radiant_Radiating_Helmet.name: Holy Lance Helm

item:MAG_Raven_Gloves.description: Dark and suitably moody, these gloves are perfect for wearing while thinking about poetry.
item:MAG_Raven_Gloves.name: Raven Gloves

item:MAG_Restoration_SpellSlotRestoratio.description: Some scholars have speculated that spells have a mind of their own, suggesting that the spells get bored between being cast and restored.
item:MAG_Restoration_SpellSlotRestoratio.name: Spellcrux Amulet

item:MAG_Revitalizing_Warpick.description: Not the most elegant of weapons, the warpick's cumbersome weight certainly allows it to be deadly in combat, when wielded by a strong arm. Inexplicably, this one has a small rabbit carved into the handle.
item:MAG_Revitalizing_Warpick.name: Hoppy

item:MAG_RiskyAttack_Ring.description: Life is just a series of risks taken while blindfolded.
item:MAG_RiskyAttack_Ring.name: Risky Ring

item:MAG_SHA_SeluneBlessing_Spear.description: 'One of the goddess Selûne's titles, Moonmaiden, has often been debated among the ecclesiastical. Common symbology certainly rejects the assumption of virginity. More to the point, 'maiden' itself carries some dusty connotations. How about Lunar Lady? Keeps the alliteration, too.' - Margaery Henderplum
item:MAG_SHA_SeluneBlessing_Spear.name: Selûne's Spear of Night

item:MAG_SHA_SharBlessing_Spear.description: When visiting mortals in dreams, Shar's hair would curl and twist about her head like strands of inky midnight. If it tickled her nose, the goddess was careful not to show it.
item:MAG_SHA_SharBlessing_Spear.name: Shar's Spear of Evening

item:MAG_SWA_Roaring_Maul.description: Reliable and trustworthy, you could not hope for more respectable company than this maul whilst traversing the forlorn places of the world.
item:MAG_SWA_Roaring_Maul.name: Corpsegrinder

item:MAG_Safeguard_Shield.description: Magic got caught in this heirloom by being exposed to too many wizard family dinners.
item:MAG_Safeguard_Shield.name: Safeguard Shield

item:MAG_Selunite_Isobel_Robe.description: A memory from her childhood: a warm bed. Through the cracked window, she could see the moonlight cupping the plums in the tree as if in silver hands. The name of the goddess Selûne came to her, and never left.
item:MAG_Selunite_Isobel_Robe.name: Moon Devotion Robe

item:MAG_Shadow_BlindImmunity_Ring.description:
One of the relics of Deep Duerra's rebellious children. Paranoid by nature, Duerra had erected a vast array of biting, blasting, blinding traps and safeguards to keep her enemies from gaining her sanctum.

Of course, this also meant her children were sealed in with her by those same deadly measures.
item:MAG_Shadow_BlindImmunity_Ring.name: Eversight Ring

item:MAG_Shadow_Blinding_Bow.description:
One of the relics of Deep Duerra's rebellious children. It was to the tremendous surprise of all that Ludmilla, the quiet, the weepy, the daughter most under her mother's thumb, took up this bow and fired.

The arrow flashed, and while Duerra and her blinded court wailed impotently, the children escaped into an uncertain, yet sweetly free, future.
item:MAG_Shadow_Blinding_Bow.name: Least Expected

item:MAG_Shadow_CriticalBoostWhileObscur.description:
One of the relics of Deep Duerra's rebellious children. Keeping themselves and one another safe from the nasty surprises of their home, the siblings made good progress.

At the final hurdle, they were confronted by none other than Duerra herself, and her rage was great, and they felt the candles of hope in their hearts snuff out.
item:MAG_Shadow_CriticalBoostWhileObscur.name: Covert Cowl

item:MAG_Shadow_FogCloud_Amulet.description: One of the relics of Deep Duerra's rebellious children. Drugging the Keykeeper of Duerra's vaults, the children crept in under cover of night and plundered their mother's treasure - searching desperately for anything that would aid in their flight.
item:MAG_Shadow_FogCloud_Amulet.name: Hammergrim Mist Amulet

item:MAG_Shadow_FogOfCloudDisengage_Cloa.description:
One of the relics of Deep Duerra's rebellious children. The children found nothing of use in the vault and were discouraged.

But in the morning the Vault Keykeeper's son, who admired the children, sought them out - and in his arms he brought a wealth of things, forged in shadow.
item:MAG_Shadow_FogOfCloudDisengage_Cloa.name: Cloak of Cunning Brume

item:MAG_Shadow_ShadowBlade_Ring.description: One of the relics of Deep Duerra's rebellious children. Long ago in a foreboding realm called Hammergrim, Deep Duerra, daughter of the dour god Laduguer, sired a great many heirs to her twisted corundum throne.
item:MAG_Shadow_ShadowBlade_Ring.name: Shadow Blade Ring

item:MAG_Shadow_Shortsword.description: Fingers of shadow seem to beckon from the dark edge of the blade.
item:MAG_Shadow_Shortsword.name: Sword of Clutching Umbra

item:MAG_Shadow_SpellDCBonusWhileObscure.description: One of the relics of Deep Duerra's rebellious children. Flanked by her court, Duerra shook her head at her children. Had they really believed they could leave her?
item:MAG_Shadow_SpellDCBonusWhileObscure.name: The Shadespell Circlet

item:MAG_Shadow_StealthBonusWhileObscure.description:
One of the relics of Deep Duerra's rebellious children.

Kitted out though they were for escape, the older siblings had a horrible time encouraging their younger brothers and sisters, who at the crux were frightened of what their mother would do to them should they be caught.
item:MAG_Shadow_StealthBonusWhileObscure.name: Penumbral Armour

item:MAG_ShapeshiftersBurgeon_Ring.description: 'I'm a talented shapeshifter, too. I can shapeshift a thin body into a fat body. All I need is a steady supply of mince pies and mulled wine.' - Overheard in a tavern in Daggerford
item:MAG_ShapeshiftersBurgeon_Ring.name: Shapeshifter's Boon Ring

item:MAG_Shove_ACboost_Ring.description: A common ring, simple and unadorned. Though there is a certain heft to it...
item:MAG_Shove_ACboost_Ring.name: Bracing Band

item:MAG_Slicing_Shortsword.description: So sharp you can cut yourself just talking about it. For example, 'Saw this sword the other day, mate. Absolutely brilliant, it was. Why, I was told that just talking about it wouldowOWOW-BUGGER-BUGGER-BUGGER!'
item:MAG_Slicing_Shortsword.name: Slicing Shortsword

item:MAG_SpectatorEye_Amulet.description: Spectators are hideous aberrations that float above the ground, fiercely staring around and shooting beams at anything they don't appreciate.
item:MAG_SpectatorEye_Amulet.name: The Spectator Eyes

item:MAG_Spellbreaker_Battleaxe.description: Thou shalt not suffer a witch to... well, keep doing whatever she's doing. It's probably malefic, involving toads and... and things.
item:MAG_Spellbreaker_Battleaxe.name: Witchbreaker

item:MAG_SpiritualStand_Greataxe.description: When this axe careens through the air toward an unfortunate head - the whistle of its spiritual counterpart is never far behind.
item:MAG_SpiritualStand_Greataxe.name: Sethan

item:MAG_Stalker_Gloves.description: It's a difficult life being a modern rogue - everyone expects the surprise attack. These gloves assist in making sure that the surprisee doesn't live long enough to decide whether they were surprised.
item:MAG_Stalker_Gloves.name: Stalker Gloves

item:MAG_Steadfast_Shield.description: A gnomish adventurer once used this to outpace his enemies down a slope.
item:MAG_Steadfast_Shield.name: Swires' Sledboard

item:MAG_StrongString_Longbow.description: The commonly held belief that archers are rangey, thin-wristed people is completely false. It takes years of training to pull a bowstring all the way back to your cheekbone, and wrists like iron.
item:MAG_StrongString_Longbow.name: Titanstring Bow

item:MAG_Surgeon_Bonesaw.description: The saw's teeth are blunt and rusted, it's beautiful metalwork barely visible beneath a layer of black, coagulated blood.
item:MAG_Surgeon_Bonesaw.name: Bonesaw

item:MAG_Surgeon_Leech.description: Though blood and age have rusted the mechanism, a good twist can still make the blades on this bloodletting device spin.
item:MAG_Surgeon_Leech.name: Artificial Leech

item:MAG_Surgeon_Syringe.description: The yellowish-green ooze dried to the syringe's long needle gives you the distinct impression that this medical device was never used to heal anyone.
item:MAG_Surgeon_Syringe.name: Syringe

item:MAG_Surgeon_Trepan.description: The soothing jade handle stands in stark contrast to the trepan's gruesome tip - a reminder of its intended use.
item:MAG_Surgeon_Trepan.name: Trepan

item:MAG_TWN_Brewery_Greatclub.description: You see... *hic* the thing... the really, really important thing *hic*... about this item is *belches copiously*... oh sod it, it's a club. Enjoy.
item:MAG_TWN_Brewery_Greatclub.name: Punch-Drunk Bastard

item:MAG_TWN_Surgeon_ParalyzingCritical_.description: A surgeon is only as reliable as her tools. And, indeed, as depraved.
item:MAG_TWN_Surgeon_ParalyzingCritical_.name: Surgeon's Subjugation Amulet

item:MAG_TWN_Taxblade_Morningstar.description: They say rich folk are never truly happy: especially true when they're targeted with this morningstar.
item:MAG_TWN_Taxblade_Morningstar.name: Twist of Fortune

item:MAG_TerrainWalkers_Boots.description: The soles of these boots warp and shift like warm clay manipulated by an unseen sculptor's hands.
item:MAG_TerrainWalkers_Boots.name: Boots of Genial Striding

item:MAG_TheBulwark_Shield.description: 'Walking Fortress' is a defensive technique reliant on a shield of this calibre. It involves upsetting your opponent, who just wants to land a single blow.
item:MAG_TheBulwark_Shield.name: Viconia's Walking Fortress

item:MAG_TheChromatic_Staff.description: Kereska, draconic goddess of arcane knowledge, imbues many chromatic dragons with their magic. This includes their exquisite and terrible breath, which has wrenched giants from their tall thrones, and destroyed civilisations of smallfolk.
item:MAG_TheChromatic_Staff.name: Markoheshkir

item:MAG_TheCrimson_Shortsword.description: When she was a girl, she toyed with nastiness and sadism. Children often grow out of this; they get hobbies. For Orin, that taste for cruelty fermented, and in a way she did find hobbies. Ones that screamed.
item:MAG_TheCrimson_Shortsword.name: Crimson Mischief

item:MAG_TheDestroyer_Maul.description: As heavy and opposed to nonsense as the kitchen cook in most stories about some young adventurous girl going to become a knight or a hedge witch or something. You've got to have a big no nonsense cook. It's like rules.
item:MAG_TheDestroyer_Maul.name: Foebreaker

item:MAG_TheDueller_Rapier.description: A blade gifted to Lora by her own mother, Lenore the Fleet. When challenged to duels, Lenore's opponents assumed she had received this nickname from some naval exploit. They found out how wrong they were when her blade blurred faster than the eye could follow.
item:MAG_TheDueller_Rapier.name: Duellist's Prerogative

item:MAG_TheHunters_Dagger.description: Prey often thinks it has escaped the worst of the predator's bloodthirst and fury - but there are always further torments to be meted out.
item:MAG_TheHunters_Dagger.name: Hunter's Dagger

item:MAG_TheOptimist_Amulet.description: The interlocked bronze links of this necklace tinkle softly every time you move.
item:MAG_TheOptimist_Amulet.name: Absolute Confidence Amulet

item:MAG_TheOptimist_Ring.description: The garnet at the centrepiece of this ring is like an unblinking, malevolent eye.
item:MAG_TheOptimist_Ring.name: Seemingly Gleaming Ring

item:MAG_TheThorns_Trident.description: The forgemaster Lirrico designed this weapon for the champion of the wind goddess Akadi. A key component in the forging was his home city's wind, and for a year after the weapon was made, no wind blew there at all.
item:MAG_TheThorns_Trident.name: Nyrulna

item:MAG_TheVictory_Longbow.description: Gontr Mael blasted from the corpse of the Steel Watcher Titan: a bow formed from the boiling slag and weird whispering gyros inherent to the mechanical giant. It must have acted as the Titan's abdomen, exchanging muscle for immaculate steel.
item:MAG_TheVictory_Longbow.name: Gontr Mael

item:MAG_TheWoundSeeker_Greatsword.description: Wielded by Svartlebee The Custodian, so named because he had the following reputation: Have you got someone in your life causing a mess? Send Svartlebee a missive. He shall clean them up, and then clean up the crime scene.
item:MAG_TheWoundSeeker_Greatsword.name: Svartlebee's Woundseeker

item:MAG_Throwable_Pike.description: A 'Crazy Wilbur' is a technique invented by the dwarvish Ticklebeard Clan. It involves getting your larger enemies to swallow your weapon, then calling it back to you - as messily as possible.
item:MAG_Throwable_Pike.name: Returning Pike

item:MAG_Thunder_ArcaneAcuityOnThunderDa.description: Two sigils glow white where the hat brushes your temples - something is being tapped into; something distant and fearsome.
item:MAG_Thunder_ArcaneAcuityOnThunderDa.name: Hat of Storm Scion's Power

item:MAG_Thunder_InflictDazeOnReverberat.description: Through a gap in the long snarls of thread, you are sure you can glimpse a great black thunderhead swollen with purple lightning and spears of rain.
item:MAG_Thunder_InflictDazeOnReverberat.name: Thunderskin Cloak

item:MAG_Thunder_InflictDazeOnThunderDam.description: When you slip this ring on your hand and flex your fingers, a boom of discontented thunder grumbles in the air around you.
item:MAG_Thunder_InflictDazeOnThunderDam.name: Ring of Spiteful Thunder

item:MAG_Thunder_ReverberationOnRangeSpe.description: Quivers creep up your enemy's back - the slow, long-fingered hand of your magic.
item:MAG_Thunder_ReverberationOnRangeSpe.name: Spineshudder Amulet

item:MAG_Thunder_ReverberationOnStatusAp.description: Peals of thunder rumble at the back of your skull with every step taken in these boots.
item:MAG_Thunder_ReverberationOnStatusAp.name: Boots of Stormy Clamour

item:MAG_Thunder_Reverberation_Gloves.description: Balling your fingers into fists while wearing these gloves causes a sonorous chime, like the fusion of a tempest and a church bell, to resound inside your skull.
item:MAG_Thunder_Reverberation_Gloves.name: Gloves of Belligerent Skies

item:MAG_Thunder_ThunderClap_Quarterstaf.description: Carved in circles across the knob of the staff are different words for thunder. Gnomish, Sylvan, Elvish, Celestial, even the Primordial tongue - all of these and more fuse together to form the thunderword.
item:MAG_Thunder_ThunderClap_Quarterstaf.name: Cacophony

item:MAG_Tyrrant_Warhammer.description: Tyr is often known as the Maimed God - a descriptor he shares with most victims of this heavy warhammer.
item:MAG_Tyrrant_Warhammer.name: Hammer of the Just

item:MAG_Umberlee_Robe_A.description: Tales tell of a most wondrous fish, scales resplendent, an intricate jewel that shone beneath the sea. When it died, the Wavemother gifted its hide as a robe to her most devoted follower - and demanded she drown the sailors that killed her gem-bright fish.
item:MAG_Umberlee_Robe_A.name: Wavemother's Robe

item:MAG_Vicious_Battleaxe.description: A pulse of magic shoots through your hands whenever you touch this axe.
item:MAG_Vicious_Battleaxe.name: Vicious Battleaxe

item:MAG_Vicious_Dagger.description: Once wielded by a murderer, the weapon's handle retains an eerie, clammy warmth, as if Dolor's pre-slaughter sweat somehow crept into the leather - and lingers there still.
item:MAG_Vicious_Dagger.name: Dolor Amarus

item:MAG_Vicious_Shortbow.description: Pliable yew and a hearty bowstring ensure this shortbow fires straight and true.
item:MAG_Vicious_Shortbow.name: Vicious Shortbow

item:MAG_Viconia_Mace.description: This mace was designed by Lolth's assassins to fell heretics who dared turn their back on the Spider Queen. However, even the best-laid designs fall to nothingness when brought to bear against Shar's faithful.
item:MAG_Viconia_Mace.name: Handmaiden's Mace

item:MAG_Viconia_Robe.description: Listening to the magical hum this robe emits dulls your senses, thoughts, feelings - everything. Listen too long, and you can almost hear the screaming chitters of a thousand spiders devoured by encroaching, hungry darkness. Almost.
item:MAG_Viconia_Robe.name: Viconia's Priestess Robe

item:MAG_Violence_LowHP_Violence_Clothes.description: No sooner does blood speck the armour than it's absorbed, as if sustaining something within.
item:MAG_Violence_LowHP_Violence_Clothes.name: Bloodguzzler Garb

item:MAG_WATCHER_Human_Crossbow.description: 'Trundling, mashing, mincing, crushing, grinding, blasting, biting! Hear their peeling thunder, their roaring flames, their clicking, whirring, metallic melody, and know that the hellfire engines of Avernus are on the move!' - Edict in Elturel
item:MAG_WATCHER_Human_Crossbow.name: Hellfire Engine Crossbow

item:MAG_WATCHER_Human_Greataxe.description: Anything hit by this has the life expectancy of a glass hammer.
item:MAG_WATCHER_Human_Greataxe.name: Hellfire Greataxe

item:MAG_WYRM_Commander_Longsword.description: Cradling his newborn son awkwardly, the Duke's face pulled into a rictus of misery. His love Francesca smiled at him, briefly, and died. He stared at her until the boy cried, and he told the boy it would be all right, though he himself did not believe it.
item:MAG_WYRM_Commander_Longsword.name: Duke Ravengard's Longsword

item:MAG_WYRM_Farlin_Dagger.description: A pair of pixie wings were used to create this pretty blade - their delicate tracings can be seen all day and night, though they shine brightest by the light of a gibbous moon.
item:MAG_WYRM_Farlin_Dagger.name: Gleamdance Dagger

item:MAG_WYRM_OfBalduran_Helmet.description: This helm, worn atop the pate of Balduran the Brave, still gleams as if with the untarnished splendour of his legacy. Baldur's Gate itself bears his name, and tales of his exploits have turned the heads and hearts of many.
item:MAG_WYRM_OfBalduran_Helmet.name: Helm of Balduran

item:MAG_WYRM_OfTruthTelling_Ring.description: 'Fib now, and forever hold your teeth.' - Folk saying
item:MAG_WYRM_OfTruthTelling_Ring.name: Ring of Truthfulness

item:MAG_WYRM_UndeadBane_GreatAxe.description: Wielded by the indomitable Ser Lexia. Although her eagerness to destroy evil in all its forms was constant, she often took time to make little gifts for her friends.
item:MAG_WYRM_UndeadBane_GreatAxe.name: The Undead Bane

item:MAG_WYRM_UndeadProtector_Robe.description: Crafted from celestial feathers, bottled sunlight, and ink from the pages of sacred scripture, it's a wonder the maker didn't hang cloves of garlic from this robe, so anathema is it to the undead.
item:MAG_WYRM_UndeadProtector_Robe.name: Veil of the Morning

item:MAG_WYR_Hellrider_Longbow.description: This longbow was forged from the remnants of Stanislav the Silver's shield, found near the wreckage of Castle Ravenloft some years ago.
item:MAG_WYR_Hellrider_Longbow.name: Hellrider Longbow

item:MAG_WYR_Orin_Bhaalist_Dagger.description: The Lord of Murder wasn't always a lord. He was once just a petty killer. When Bhaal first drew blood in a Baldurian back-alley, it dropped to the ground and lingered. When he ascended, this dried blood-drop grew, warped - and became sharp.
item:MAG_WYR_Orin_Bhaalist_Dagger.name: Blade of the First Blood

item:MAG_Warlock_Quickened_Gloves.description: These gloves were worn by the wizard Bucknard, who always maintained that speed was most important in spellcasting. This, because even if you royally bugger up the spell, you've got enough time to leg it away afterward.
item:MAG_Warlock_Quickened_Gloves.name: Quickspell Gloves

item:MAG_Warlock_Twinned_Gloves.description: Designed by an arcane smith with half-vision. He made these gloves to make sure his spells hit their target.
item:MAG_Warlock_Twinned_Gloves.name: Gemini Gloves

item:MAG_Wizard_Pointy_Hat.description: Sages over the course of ages have dealt very constructive and useful advice - however, none so sagacious as that of the wizard Otiluke, who once advised one of his students thusly: 'Never cast Speak with Dead on a loved one if there's unresolved tension there. It's never worth it. Trust me.'
item:MAG_Wizard_Pointy_Hat.name: The Pointy Hat

item:MAG_WoodWoad_Nature_Shield.description: 'And with her arm the dryad linked a man who had once been her lover, and once of flesh and bone. Now his flesh was bark, and his bone heartwood. In his eyes a feverish love still blazed like a thousand fireflies in a spring meadow.'
item:MAG_WoodWoad_Nature_Shield.name: Wood Woad Shield

item:MAG_ZOC_AdvantageOnMeleeAttackWhile.description: Crowded taprooms. Packed feast halls. Bustling market bazaars. Chances to be social? Sure. Chances to be violent? Absolutely.
item:MAG_ZOC_AdvantageOnMeleeAttackWhile.name: Gloves of the Growling Underdog

item:MAG_ZOC_ForceConduit_ChainMail.description: Dents, notches, and nicks add character to each ring of this mail - yet each blemish also speaks to those who tasted magical vengeance on the armour's behalf.
item:MAG_ZOC_ForceConduit_ChainMail.name: Rippling Force Mail

item:MAG_ZOC_ForceConduit_Halberd.description: In mellow light, the halberd's curved steel head eerily resembles a grin.
item:MAG_ZOC_ForceConduit_Halberd.name: The Skinburster

item:MAG_Zhentarim_Demonspirit_Gloves.description: Demons will bite their masters, slaves, comrades, and, on occasion, themselves. They bite on principle, and are functionally piranha with extra steps.
item:MAG_Zhentarim_Demonspirit_Gloves.name: Abyss Beckoners

item:MAG_Zhentarim_SleeperDagger.description: A web of veins runs the length of the blade - it has become a slender iron mortuary for all the innocents it has tasted.
item:MAG_Zhentarim_SleeperDagger.name: Dread Iron Dagger

item:MAG_Zhentarim_Swap_Gloves.description: Rudimentary teleportation sigils mark the palms of these gloves, like coiled snakes in a bath of pitch.
item:MAG_Zhentarim_Swap_Gloves.name: Dark Displacement Gloves

item:MAG_ofGreaterHealth_Amulet.description: Worn by Lumi, a cleric beholden to twilight, who sheltered her fellow adventurers as a bantam shelters her chicks.
item:MAG_ofGreaterHealth_Amulet.name: Amulet of Greater Health

item:MOO_Kitchen_GnollCollar.description: Necklace the Gnoll Master gave Barnabus when she first met him.
item:MOO_Kitchen_GnollCollar.name: Barnabus' Collar

item:ORI_Wyll_Infernal_Rapier.description: Imagine the soul as a blade. A good one, carefully looked after. A bad one suited for rusting in the rain. Flame-chewed and narrow, this blade is Wyll's soul summarised in steel.
item:ORI_Wyll_Infernal_Rapier.name: Infernal Rapier

item:ORI_Wyll_Infernal_Robe.description: Presumably Mizora was not always a sensuous and manipulative benefactor of troubled souls like Wyll. Negotiating the hierarchies of hell result in changes of form - but was she ever less beautiful, less erudite, less willful?
item:ORI_Wyll_Infernal_Robe.name: Infernal Robe

item:QUEST_FOR_SussurDagger.description: Smoke-like whorls of sussur sap darken the metal of this dagger's blade and silence its victims.
item:QUEST_FOR_SussurDagger.name: Sussur Dagger

item:QUEST_FOR_SussurGreatsword.description: Sussur roots extend from this sword's hilt into the blade itself. It yearns to drink magic, silencing every creature it strikes.
item:QUEST_FOR_SussurGreatsword.name: Sussur Greatsword

item:QUEST_FOR_SussurSickle.description: The sheen of sussur sap forged into this sickle glows blue, silencing every creature it cuts.
item:QUEST_FOR_SussurSickle.name: Sussur Sickle

item:QUEST_FOR_Village_Blacksmith_FineWe.description: Though the grip's leather is old and crusty, it shows no signs of wear, and not a single scratch mars the slender blade.
item:QUEST_FOR_Village_Blacksmith_FineWe.name: Steelforged Sword

item:QUEST_HAV_InfernalReward_001.description: 'I learned so much from Carixim. All sorts of forgecraft that... S-sorry. Just when I think of him, and the whimpers those people inside him made... I don't know. Anyway, it was worth it. Worth it to be the best.' - Overheard from the smith Dammon
item:QUEST_HAV_InfernalReward_001.name: Flawed Helldusk Armour

item:QUEST_HAV_InfernalReward_002.description: 'When I found Carixim, he turned to me, all those poor people's souls crammed into him like too many bees in a rotten hive, and he... He grinned at me. And he said: I been expecting you, boy.' - Overheard from the smith Dammon
item:QUEST_HAV_InfernalReward_002.name: Flawed Helldusk Helmet

item:QUEST_HAV_InfernalReward_003.description: 'Beneath those horrible sounds of... well, let's call it what it was: torment, Beneath the tormented screams I heard this moaning sound like many people in pain, and I heard the ringing of a great hammer. Carixim's forge was close.' - Overheard from the smith Dammon
item:QUEST_HAV_InfernalReward_003.name: Flawed Helldusk Gloves

item:QUEST_LOW_SteelWatchFoundry_Destroy.description: Smells a bit rusty, but looks stylish nonetheless.
item:QUEST_LOW_SteelWatchFoundry_Destroy.name: Destroyed Kill Collar

item:QUEST_LOW_SteelWatchFoundry_Explodi.description: Smells a bit rusty, but looks stylish nonetheless.
item:QUEST_LOW_SteelWatchFoundry_Explodi.name: Kill Collar

item:Quest_GOB_DrunkGoblin_Ring.description: Though caked with mud and grime, the ring smells faintly of lavender. Remarkable, considering where it's been.
item:Quest_GOB_DrunkGoblin_Ring.name: Crusher's Ring

item:Quest_GOB_RoastingDwarf_SmellyPants.description: These pants, cinched at the waist, are stained with splotches of brown and crimson.
item:Quest_GOB_RoastingDwarf_SmellyPants.name: Klagga's Pants

item:Quest_GOB_WolfPens_AmuletOfBeastmas.description: The green jewel set into this necklace's pendant is carved to resemble a cat's slivered pupil.
item:Quest_GOB_WolfPens_AmuletOfBeastmas.name: Beastmaster's Chain

item:SCL_MastiffPoachers_Ring.description: Even in the brightest light, this ring never gleams, as if perpetually wrapped in shadow, hungry for the dark.
item:SCL_MastiffPoachers_Ring.name: Shadow-Cloaked Ring

item:TOOL_GEN_Mine_Pickaxe_A.description: A plain tool, covered almost entirely in coppery rust.
item:TOOL_GEN_Mine_Pickaxe_A.name: Pickaxe

item:TOOL_GEN_Music_Drum_Small_A.description: The skin and wood of this drum has been replaced countless times. Is it even the same instrument?
item:TOOL_GEN_Music_Drum_Small_A.name: Hand Drum

item:TOOL_GEN_Music_Drum_Small_B.description: Whether sounding war, celebration, or simple rhythm, the drum is a main-stay of any entertainer's arsenal.
item:TOOL_GEN_Music_Drum_Small_B.name: Hand Drum

item:TOOL_GEN_Music_Flute_A.description: It is said Diores the Charming once lured a nest of harpies to their deaths, using only a flute.
item:TOOL_GEN_Music_Flute_A.name: Flute

item:TOOL_GEN_Music_Guitar_Lute_A.description: Many a bard's first instrument, the lute is heard in taverns all across Faerûn.
item:TOOL_GEN_Music_Guitar_Lute_A.name: Lute

item:TOOL_GEN_Music_Guitar_Lute_B.description: Many a bard's first instrument, the lute is heard in taverns all across Faerûn.
item:TOOL_GEN_Music_Guitar_Lute_B.name: Lute

item:TOOL_GEN_Music_Lyre_A.description: Devotees of the goddess Sune hold that the lyre's seven strings represent the seven different forms of love.
item:TOOL_GEN_Music_Lyre_A.name: Lyre

item:TOOL_GEN_Music_Violin_A.description: A violin of cedar and burled walnut. The pegs are a little scuffed, the strings thin and worn, but the song from this instrument would still ring clear and true.
item:TOOL_GEN_Music_Violin_A.name: Violin

item:TOOL_GEN_Pitchfork_A.description: A farming tool crafted from mismatched branches, held together by fraying twine.
item:TOOL_GEN_Pitchfork_A.name: Pitchfork

item:TWN_NecklaceOfCharming.description: The inlaid jewels are so rich in colour, so deep in hue, you could lose yourself in them.
item:TWN_NecklaceOfCharming.name: Shar's Temptation

item:UND_FairyRings_AntiCharmHelmet.description: The metal bolted to the helmet's forehead is engraved with a faded script. Though the words have become unintelligible, their magic remains.
item:UND_FairyRings_AntiCharmHelmet.name: Helmet of Autonomy

item:UND_MushroomHunter_RingOfExploratio.description: A radiant and remarkably preserved ring, forged from arandur metal.
item:UND_MushroomHunter_RingOfExploratio.name: Explorer's Ring

item:UND_StrengthChair_Leg.description: Though this rotting chair leg doesn't look like much, every splinter vibrates with barely-contained power.
item:UND_StrengthChair_Leg.name: Club of Hill Giant Strength

item:UND_Tower_RingArcana.description: Though carefully stowed away in a bedside chest, this ring is covered in dust and cobwebs.
item:UND_Tower_RingArcana.name: Mage's Friend

item:UND_Tower_RingLight.description: Used by the previous owner to access both the Underdark's darkest corners and her own basement, this ring seems to reflect light where there should be none.
item:UND_Tower_RingLight.name: Guiding Light

item:UNI_ARM_Boots_Metal_DevilsBlacksmit.description: These boots are stamped with the marks of a cancelled commission. Despite their discarded fate, they still hum with complex infernal arcana.
item:UNI_ARM_Boots_Metal_DevilsBlacksmit.name: Unwanted Masterwork Greaves

item:UNI_ARM_DEN_Thieflings_Ring2.description: A glob of tree sap studded with dead ants occupies the space where this ring's stone once sat.
item:UNI_ARM_DEN_Thieflings_Ring2.name: Ring of Resistance to Ants

item:UNI_ARM_DEN_Thieflings_Ring4.description: A small pebble swings from a length of fishing line tied to this copper ring.
item:UNI_ARM_DEN_Thieflings_Ring4.name: Ring of the Lekinesus

item:UNI_ARM_Gloves_Jaheira.description: These supple gloves provide both flexibility and protection.
item:UNI_ARM_Gloves_Jaheira.name: Leather Gloves

item:UNI_ARM_MartyrAmulet.description: Each jewel gleams with the energy of the natural elements.
item:UNI_ARM_MartyrAmulet.name: Amulet of Elemental Torment

item:UNI_ARM_OfArchery_Gloves.description: Banded in dark iron, these gloves are embossed with the brass likeness of an elf against a trio of arrows in flight.
item:UNI_ARM_OfArchery_Gloves.name: Gloves of Archery

item:UNI_ARM_OfDefense_Gloves.description: Delicate twists of magical iron - painstakingly gilded - have been fashioned into these fortifying vambraces.
item:UNI_ARM_OfDefense_Gloves.name: Bracers of Defence

item:UNI_ARM_OfGiantHillStrength_Gloves.description: Your basic hill giant is just a landslide with a digestive system.
item:UNI_ARM_OfGiantHillStrength_Gloves.name: Gauntlets of Frost Giant Strength

item:UNI_ARM_OfMissileSnaring_Gloves.description: These gloves seem to meld to your skin - supple, snug and dextrous as one could hope for.
item:UNI_ARM_OfMissileSnaring_Gloves.name: Gloves of Missile Snaring

item:UNI_ARM_Sarevok_Horned_Helmet.description: The last sight Sarevok witnessed as a mortal was his sibling's knife. This duel, the first between Bhaalspawn, is worshipped still by the cult of Bhaal, who now believe that no act is more sacred than fratricide between spawn before the altar of their Dread Lord.
item:UNI_ARM_Sarevok_Horned_Helmet.name: Sarevok's Horned Helmet

item:UNI_ARM_ScaleMail_DevilsBlacksmith.description: Nothing stings the master blacksmith more than a cancelled commission - not even molten iron. This mail is engraved with the mark of a devillish forgemaster, as well as several curses stamped out in Infernal, and hums with diabolic magic.
item:UNI_ARM_ScaleMail_DevilsBlacksmith.name: Unwanted Masterwork Scalemail

item:UNI_Astarion_StarterArmor.description: Despite the careful stitches, the gold embroidery on this padded doublet is slowly unravelling.
item:UNI_Astarion_StarterArmor.name: Padded Armour

item:UNI_Barbarian_Karlach.description: A rough combination of furs, leathers, and supple fabrics, made for a life outside civilisation.
item:UNI_Barbarian_Karlach.name: Barbarian Clothes

item:UNI_Barbarian_Karlach_Shoes.description: Warmed by occasionally wiggling infernal toes.
item:UNI_Barbarian_Karlach_Shoes.name: Karlach's Boots

item:UNI_Boots_Daisy.description: Scratched in places, scorched in others, and worn thin at the heel, these boots bear the indelible marks of experience.
item:UNI_Boots_Daisy.name: Dreamsome Boots

item:UNI_Boots_Jaheira.description: As well travelled as any set of boots on Toril.
item:UNI_Boots_Jaheira.name: Jaheira's Boots

item:UNI_Bow_SpellslotRecharge.description: A shiver of magic flows from this bow into your hand - like a promise.
item:UNI_Bow_SpellslotRecharge.name: Spellthief

item:UNI_CHA_TalismanOfJergal.description: The dead hold no secrets from Jergal's Scriveners of Doom.
item:UNI_CHA_TalismanOfJergal.name: The Amulet of Lost Voices

item:UNI_CRE_HatcheryBoots.description: Though the leather is slick with acid, the corrosive liquid doesn't seem to damage the boots - nor does it penetrate.
item:UNI_CRE_HatcheryBoots.name: Varsh Ko'kuu's Boots

item:UNI_Camp_Refugee_EternalDebtors.description: This attire disguises you as a poor soul indebted to Raphael - other debtors in his thrall will not be hostile to you.
item:UNI_Camp_Refugee_EternalDebtors.name: Debtor's Attire

item:UNI_Cazador_RitualDagger.description: Cazador's love of poetry arose after he read one on the naked stomach of a dead child in his homeland. The child was hung from the lowest branch of a tree. Cazador read the poem, and looked at the child, and he knew that here was the artform for him.
item:UNI_Cazador_RitualDagger.name: Rhapsody

item:UNI_ClericPetCollar.description: An old, leather collar for a large dog. The name 'Myrna' is engraved on the tag, surrounded by a plethora of indecipherable runes.
item:UNI_ClericPetCollar.name: Dog Collar

item:UNI_DEN_Arabella_Locket.description: Worked carefully into the locket's metal back are the words, 'Never dark again.'
item:UNI_DEN_Arabella_Locket.name: Komira's Locket

item:UNI_DEN_HalsinBlade.description: For every drop of blood spilled, a piece of the soul perishes - until nothing remains but regret.
item:UNI_DEN_HalsinBlade.name: Sorrow

item:UNI_DEN_HarpyMeal_NestRing.description: When the light hits it just so, the centre jewel shimmers with every colour of the rainbow.
item:UNI_DEN_HarpyMeal_NestRing.name: Ring of Colour Spray

item:UNI_DEN_RaidingParty_GoblinCaptain_.description: Blessed by Priestess Gut, these gauntlets provide additional aid to any who bear the Absolute's mark upon their flesh.
item:UNI_DEN_RaidingParty_GoblinCaptain_.name: Gloves of Power

item:UNI_DEN_StaffOfRain.description: A pale staff inlaid with droplet-shaped topaz. It is cool to the touch.
item:UNI_DEN_StaffOfRain.name: Rain Dancer

item:UNI_Daisy_Plate.description: A battle-burnished armour tempered with otherworldly steel.
item:UNI_Daisy_Plate.name: Dreamwalker Plate

item:UNI_DarkJusticiar_Helmet.description: Adorned in a fanned coronet of speartip points, its mask fixed with stiff-lipped intent, this helmet evokes a frightful, almost alien aspect that gestures to Shar. For she is strange and terrible indeed.
item:UNI_DarkJusticiar_Helmet.name: Dark Justiciar Helmet

item:UNI_DarkUrge_Bhaal_Cloak.description:
Let hill and hollow be a door
To screams that last forevermore.
item:UNI_DarkUrge_Bhaal_Cloak.name: The Deathstalker Mantle

item:UNI_DoomHammer.description: Bringer of that which it is.
item:UNI_DoomHammer.name: Doom Hammer

item:UNI_FOR_OgresForHire_HeadbandOfInte.description: This particular circlet is covered in yellow slime and has pieces of half-digested mutton stuck behind the gems.
item:UNI_FOR_OgresForHire_HeadbandOfInte.name: Warped Headband of Intellect

item:UNI_FOR_SpiderQueen_Robe.description: Found in the Spider Queen's stomach, this robe emanates a sour smell and stings to the touch.
item:UNI_FOR_SpiderQueen_Robe.name: Poisoner's Robe

item:UNI_FOR_SpiderstepShoes.description: Slightly sticky to the touch, these boots have excellent grip.
item:UNI_FOR_SpiderstepShoes.name: Spiderstep Boots

item:UNI_GLO_Moonlantern.description: Each framed facet of the lantern glass is pierced by lances and long tendrils of eerily beautiful moonlight.
item:UNI_GLO_Moonlantern.name: Moonlantern

item:UNI_GLO_Moonlantern_Gale.description: Encased in a cocoon of shadow within the lantern, the mangled pixie lies like some deformed pupa, its mouth slack, and those same shadows crawling over its greying tongue.
item:UNI_GLO_Moonlantern_Gale.name: Shadow Lantern

item:UNI_GOB_DrowCommander_Amulet.description:
This necklace allows the wearer to cast Misty Step.

Made of blue gems unique to a privately-owned mine in Menzoberranzan, this necklace was likely a token of esteem - or perhaps a desperate attempt to win its recipient's mercy.
item:UNI_GOB_DrowCommander_Amulet.name: Amulet of Misty Step

item:UNI_GOB_Priest_Amulet.description: Stained by blood, and gifted to only the most faithful of True Souls to help preserve their lives.
item:UNI_GOB_Priest_Amulet.name: Absolute's Talisman

item:UNI_GOB_SeluneAmulet.description: The gems and pearls of this necklace have a brilliant shine to them, as if reflecting unseen moonlight.
item:UNI_GOB_SeluneAmulet.name: Amulet of Selûne's Chosen

item:UNI_GaleRobe.description: Crafted with care, this robe will protect you from the elements. It won't do much against a sword's thrust, though.
item:UNI_GaleRobe.name: Simple Robe

item:UNI_Gloves_Daisy.description: Made from steel hammered thin, these gauntlets are a fine investment for any warrior.
item:UNI_Gloves_Daisy.name: Metallic Gloves

item:UNI_Gloves_Minsc.description: These supple gloves provide both flexibility and protection.
item:UNI_Gloves_Minsc.name: Leather Gloves

item:UNI_Gob_Priest_Shield.description: Blood is smeared across the shield's face, exalting wielders who bear the Absolute's mark.
item:UNI_Gob_Priest_Shield.name: Absolute's Warboard

item:UNI_HAG_SwampedHero_OldFancyHelmet.description: Forged from an unfamiliar alloy. Uncommonly rugged.
item:UNI_HAG_SwampedHero_OldFancyHelmet.name: Reinforced Helmet

item:UNI_HUM_ShadowBlade.description: Umbral claws sweep through the long slender facets of the blade.
item:UNI_HUM_ShadowBlade.name: Shadow Blade

item:UNI_HUM_Torch_A_Blue.description: A deep oily smell wafts from this crude tree branch.
item:UNI_HUM_Torch_A_Blue.name: Cemetery-Blue Torch

item:UNI_HUM_Torch_A_Green.description: A deep oily smell wafts from this crude tree branch.
item:UNI_HUM_Torch_A_Green.name: Plague-Green Torch

item:UNI_HUM_Torch_A_Purple.description: A deep oily smell wafts from this crude tree branch.
item:UNI_HUM_Torch_A_Purple.name: Drunk-Purple Torch

item:UNI_LOW_Boots_DimensionalDoor.description: These boots are well-maintained and clean, though their soles are thin from wear.
item:UNI_LOW_Boots_DimensionalDoor.name: Spaceshunt Boots

item:UNI_LOW_GuildRing.description: Calishite emeralds are embedded in this heavy silver ring.
item:UNI_LOW_GuildRing.name: Guild Ring

item:UNI_LOW_SzarrRing.description: This ring carries the symbol of the Szarr family and has an inscription in some crusty old language.
item:UNI_LOW_SzarrRing.name: Szarr Family Ring

item:UNI_LOW_TorchOfRevocation.description: This staple of any worthwhile exorcist burns with a pale flame that destroys the anchors of troublesome ghosts in need of banishment.
item:UNI_LOW_TorchOfRevocation.name: Torch of Revocation

item:UNI_Leather_Halsin.description: Dark, messy stains line the armholes of the well-used leather breastplate.
item:UNI_Leather_Halsin.name: Druid Leather Armour

item:UNI_Leather_Jaheira.description: Dark, messy stains line the armholes of the well-used leather breastplate.
item:UNI_Leather_Jaheira.name: Leather Armour

item:UNI_Leather_Minsc.description: Dark, messy stains line the armholes of the well-used leather breastplate.
item:UNI_Leather_Minsc.name: Leather Armour

item:UNI_MassHealRing.description: A soft, soothing voice floats from this ring, reciting a prayer over and over.
item:UNI_MassHealRing.name: The Whispering Promise

item:UNI_NarrativeRoot_SilverDagger.description: The dagger's leather grip is stamped with a stag's head - the symbol of the Emerald Enclave.
item:UNI_NarrativeRoot_SilverDagger.name: Polished Dagger

item:UNI_Orpheus_Infernal_Mask.description: Power radiates from this like heat from the sun.
item:UNI_Orpheus_Infernal_Mask.name: Infernal Mask

item:UNI_PLA_ConflictedFlind_Flail_Broke.description: A bundle of bones and blood - and a soul-piercing demonic presence - is all that remains of the Flind's flail. It would make a decent mace with a particularly nasty bite.
item:UNI_PLA_ConflictedFlind_Flail_Broke.name: Shattered Flail

item:UNI_PLA_SmugglersRing.description: A subtle accessory prized by purveyors of the covert arts.
item:UNI_PLA_SmugglersRing.name: Smuggler's Ring

item:UNI_PLA_StuckHalfElf_Dowry.description: A simple gold ring with a simple inscription: 'From Miri and Benryn'.
item:UNI_PLA_StuckHalfElf_Dowry.name: Dowry Ring

item:UNI_PLA_WPN_SwordOfJustice.description: The words 'Deliverance. Justice. Vengeance.' are engraved on the base of this sword. They echo in your mind.
item:UNI_PLA_WPN_SwordOfJustice.name: Sword of Justice

item:UNI_PLA_ZhentCave_Gloves.description:
Grants wearer ability to cast Hail of Thorns.

Whoever previously owned these gloves marked each with a series of thirty superficial scrapes, six per finger. What they indicate is unclear.
item:UNI_PLA_ZhentCave_Gloves.name: Gloves of Hail of Thorns

item:UNI_Ravengard_Plate.description: The tabard adorning this perfectly kept plate denotes the status of its wearer - Marshal of the Flaming Fist and ultimate military authority in Baldur's Gate.
item:UNI_Ravengard_Plate.name: Emblazoned Plate of the Marshal

item:UNI_RepeatStaff.description: This light, flexible staff is of elven make, marked with mithral sigils that channel magic in the blink of an eye.
item:UNI_RepeatStaff.name: Corellon's Grace

item:UNI_RingOfPoisonResistance.description: The ring's emerald glows a deep, deadly green.
item:UNI_RingOfPoisonResistance.name: Ring of Poison Resistance

item:UNI_RobeOfSummer.description: This robe's thin fabric is pleasantly warm to the touch.
item:UNI_RobeOfSummer.name: Robe of Summer

item:UNI_SCE_KhalidsGift.description: A gift from Khalid for Jaheira.
item:UNI_SCE_KhalidsGift.name: Khalid's Gift

item:UNI_SCL_SpidersLyre.description: The strings of this lyre are as sharp as an assassin's blade. Pluck with care, or you may lose a fingertip.
item:UNI_SCL_SpidersLyre.name: Spider's Lyre

item:UNI_SHA_DarkJusticiar_Boots.description: Scratched in places, scorched in others, and worn thin at the heel, these boots bear the indelible marks of experience.
item:UNI_SHA_DarkJusticiar_Boots.name: Dark Justiciar Boots

item:UNI_SHA_JusticiarArmor_Gloves.description: The grip of darkness is a fear felt by many. The grip of a Dark Justiciar's gauntlets is a sacred fear reserved for an unfortunate few.
item:UNI_SHA_JusticiarArmor_Gloves.name: Dark Justiciar Gauntlets

item:UNI_SHA_Shadowheart_JusticiarArmor_.description: Shar's aspect winds its way through the patterns and pauldrons of this half plate, and any light cast nearby seems to almost quiver away from it, afraid. For even the light knows that the clank of this armour is swiftly followed by a Dark Justiciar's silent blade.
item:UNI_SHA_Shadowheart_JusticiarArmor_.name: Dark Justiciar Half-Plate

item:UNI_ShadowheartCirclet.description: Provides its wearer a touch of elegance but no additional protection.
item:UNI_ShadowheartCirclet.name: Circlet

item:UNI_SickleOfBOOOAL.description: Infused with the inconceivable might of the formidable BOOOAL!
item:UNI_SickleOfBOOOAL.name: Sickle of BOOOAL

item:UNI_TOOL_Music_Drum_KiamGodasKilatD.description: A Lulutiun hand drum covered in sealskin, like those played at koatulit peace festivals. Kiam Goda was famous for his finger-thumb taradiddles.
item:UNI_TOOL_Music_Drum_KiamGodasKilatD.name: Kiam Goda's Kilat Drum

item:UNI_TOOL_Music_Flute_DostrealtsPicc.description: This petite flute, engraved with drow sigils, is said to have belonged to Captain Dostrealt of the spelljammer flitter 'Erevan's Clutch'.
item:UNI_TOOL_Music_Flute_DostrealtsPicc.name: Dostrealt's Piccolo

item:UNI_TOOL_Music_Guitar_Lute_Stolyaro.description: This heavy, deep-voiced instrument is of the type called a 'table lute' due to its weight. Famously, the late Ahndri Stolyarof refused to let anyone else play it.
item:UNI_TOOL_Music_Guitar_Lute_Stolyaro.name: Stolyarof's Table Lute

item:UNI_TOOL_Music_Lyre_FalataericCliLy.description: This exquisite instrument is said to come from the shop of the legendary Moonshaean bard Falataer. Fewer than twenty of his handcrafted lyres still survive.
item:UNI_TOOL_Music_Lyre_FalataericCliLy.name: Falataeric Cli Lyre

item:UNI_TOOL_Music_Violin_GlimmergadSel.description: The notorious gnomish bard Fiddlesticks Glimmergad was said to play violin tunes so sad they made bank guards weep - while his accomplices robbed the bank's vaults.
item:UNI_TOOL_Music_Violin_GlimmergadSel.name: Glimmergad's Selgaunt Fiddle

item:UNI_TWN_BondedByLove_HusbandsRing.description: The scholar of love, Joel Firris Baldidims, writes that the next time he reads about a woman compared to a flower (or any feature of geography for that matter) he's going to start knocking on poets' doors with a sledgehammer.
item:UNI_TWN_BondedByLove_HusbandsRing.name: True Love's Embrace

item:UNI_TWN_BondedByLove_WifesRing.description: The most pragmatic and courageous lover ever known was, of course, Sorcha MacTire, for whom the popular hairstyle is named, and for whom many an extremely soppy poem has been written (most of them comparing her to geography).
item:UNI_TWN_BondedByLove_WifesRing.name: True Love's Caress

item:UNI_TWN_BootsOfApparentDeath.description: Practical jokes with these boots often involve all your stuff being stolen by opportunistic cousins.
item:UNI_TWN_BootsOfApparentDeath.name: Boots of Apparent Death

item:UNI_TWN_WPN_HUM_NailBat.description: A club with nails hammered through it. Classic.
item:UNI_TWN_WPN_HUM_NailBat.name: Rat Bat

item:UNI_TWN_WPN_HUM_ShieldOfWatcher_D_1.description: To hold this shield is to be vigilant in duty, wary of danger, and mindful in crisis.
item:UNI_TWN_WPN_HUM_ShieldOfWatcher_D_1.name: Watcher's Shield

item:UNI_TWN_WPN_HUM_ShortswordOfStealth.description: Quiet is the air around this sword, and quiet are the steps of the one who wields it.
item:UNI_TWN_WPN_HUM_ShortswordOfStealth.name: Assassin's Shortsword

item:UNI_UND_ARM_ShadowOfMenzoberranzan.description: You sense the shadows that envelop this drowcraft cowl, eagerly waiting to envelop you and shield you from view.
item:UNI_UND_ARM_ShadowOfMenzoberranzan.name: Shadow of Menzoberranzan

item:UNI_UND_DrowDisguiseCowl.description: A supple leather cowl. Its spider web embroidery is stained, and pieces of leather and thread are slowly disintegrating.
item:UNI_UND_DrowDisguiseCowl.name: Frayed Drow Hood

item:UNI_UND_DuergarBlacksmithHammer.description: And they shall have Celestia's light, even if we must crack wide the heavens to bring it."
item:UNI_UND_DuergarBlacksmithHammer.name: Skybreaker

item:UNI_UND_DuergarRaft_GruesomeHammer.description: The elegant design of this hammer belies its brutal, crushing power. This weapon does not give ground.
item:UNI_UND_DuergarRaft_GruesomeHammer.name: Intransigent Warhammer

item:UNI_UND_DuergarRaft_PestKillerAxe.description: The intricate engravings on this axe's blade and handle make plain the skill of its smith.
item:UNI_UND_DuergarRaft_PestKillerAxe.name: Exterminator's Axe

item:UNI_UND_Duergar_ShortswordOfFirstBl.description: A golden blade, exquisitely made and astonishingly sharp.
item:UNI_UND_Duergar_ShortswordOfFirstBl.name: Shortsword of First Blood

item:UNI_UND_KC_AdamantineGolem_Helmet.description: Once home to an inscrutable machine intelligence, Grym's skull now serves as a simple helm.
item:UNI_UND_KC_AdamantineGolem_Helmet.name: Grymskull Helm

item:UNI_UND_KC_Elder_Warpick.description: Countless hands have smoothened the haft and sharpened the blade. This is an ancestral weapon - perhaps dating back to the ancient digs that sundered the duergar from their dwarf-kin.
item:UNI_UND_KC_Elder_Warpick.name: Deep Delver

item:UNI_UND_KC_RingOfAbsolute.description: Darkness seems to blossom from this ring, heightened by the menacing glare of the Absolute's symbol, though for the Branded this symbol holds the promise of power.
item:UNI_UND_KC_RingOfAbsolute.name: Ring of Absolute Force

item:UNI_UND_Minotaur_BeltAmulet.description: Once part of the Girdle of Blades, this buckle was torn off and fashioned into an amulet that can be worn by creatures of all sizes.
item:UNI_UND_Minotaur_BeltAmulet.name: Amulet of the Unworthy

item:UNI_UND_MonkAmulet.description: Sun-graced warmth radiates from both the pendant and its chain. Somehow, even a brief glance of it brings a smile to your face.
item:UNI_UND_MonkAmulet.name: Sentient Amulet

item:UNI_UND_Myco_Alchemist_HealerGloves.description: The leather smells faintly of herbs, as if washed in a herbal bath.
item:UNI_UND_Myco_Alchemist_HealerGloves.name: Herbalist's Gloves

item:UNI_UND_MyconidAmulet_Evil.description: A plump mass torn from Sovereign Glut's own flesh. A marker of the colony's esteem - or perhaps its property.
item:UNI_UND_MyconidAmulet_Evil.name: Champion's Chain

item:UNI_UND_MyconidAmulet_Good.description: A fleshy amulet shaped by Sovereign Spaw's own hand. Wherever the bearer goes, so does the myconid circle.
item:UNI_UND_MyconidAmulet_Good.name: Envoy's Amulet

item:UNI_UND_SocietyOfBrilliance_Darkvis.description: The ring's arcane jewel parts all but the darkest of shadows.
item:UNI_UND_SocietyOfBrilliance_Darkvis.name: Sunwalker's Gift

item:UNI_UND_SocietyOfBrilliance_Element.description: This staff pulses with energy, swiftly attuning itself to the beat of your heart.
item:UNI_UND_SocietyOfBrilliance_Element.name: Creation's Echo

item:UNI_UND_SocietyOfBrilliance_MagicMi.description: Every gem hanging from this necklace is warm to the touch, as if waiting to ignite.
item:UNI_UND_SocietyOfBrilliance_MagicMi.name: Psychic Spark

item:UNI_UND_SocietyOfBrilliance_Pulling.description: A hymn to Eilistraee is inscribed along the inside of this ring, which is surprisingly heavy when worn.
item:UNI_UND_SocietyOfBrilliance_Pulling.name: Ring of Salving

item:UNI_UND_SocietyOfBrilliance_RingOfM.description: This ring is forged from a smooth, alien metal, capped with eyes of emerald that watch the world unblinking.
item:UNI_UND_SocietyOfBrilliance_RingOfM.name: Ring of Mind-Shielding

item:UNI_UND_Tower_AmuletDetectThoughts.description: Beneath the layers of dust covering this necklace, its inlaid gems still give off a blue sparkle - the colour of Mystra's clergy.
item:UNI_UND_Tower_AmuletDetectThoughts.name: Uncovered Mysteries

item:UNI_UND_Tower_BootsFeatherFall.description: Wearing these boots is like walking on cotton clouds.
item:UNI_UND_Tower_BootsFeatherFall.name: Mystra's Grace

item:UNI_UND_Tower_StaffBlessMystra.description: Though dust has settled into every nook and cranny of this staff, it still emanates a soothing aura. Its previous owner cast it aside - forgotten because there was nobody to bless.
item:UNI_UND_Tower_StaffBlessMystra.name: Staff of Arcane Blessing

item:UNI_UND_WPN_SwordOfScreams.description: A blade of flawless craft. As it parts the air, you fancy you can hear a faint, whispering shriek...
item:UNI_UND_WPN_SwordOfScreams.name: Sword of Screams

item:UNI_WPN_HUM_Scimitar_FlameBlade.description: An ethereal scimitar made of living fire.
item:UNI_WPN_HUM_Scimitar_FlameBlade.name: Flame Blade

item:UNI_WYR_Circus_ClownHammer.description: This hammer has a colourful history - it doesn't honk when you squeeze it, alas.
item:UNI_WYR_Circus_ClownHammer.name: Clown Hammer

item:UNI_WYR_Circus_HandaxeReturning.description: This loyal axe always returns to its owner after being thrown. However, it has no eyes and therefore dreadful aim, inevitably returning to its thrower blade-end-first.
item:UNI_WYR_Circus_HandaxeReturning.name: Comeback Handaxe

item:UNI_WYR_Circus_MumblingStaff.description: Because it was designed by a compulsive mumbler, this staff can't distinguish between its spells, and so can only cast - <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_Fireball">Fireball</LSTag> or <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Firebolt">Firebolt</LSTag> at random.
item:UNI_WYR_Circus_MumblingStaff.name: Staff of a Mumbling Wizard

item:UNI_WYR_Circus_TeleportBoots.description: You can cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_MistyStep">Misty Step</LSTag>, with the caveat that you will teleport leaving your clothes behind.
item:UNI_WYR_Circus_TeleportBoots.name: Boots of Very Fast Blinking

item:UNI_WYR_Circus_WheelRing.description: The ring from the djinni who worked in the circus. Its magic certainly explains how the djinni was able to cheat at the wheel.
item:UNI_WYR_Circus_WheelRing.name: Djinni Ring

item:UNI_WYR_MonkAmulet_AfterCombat.description: Sun-graced warmth radiates from both the pendant and its chain. Somehow, even a brief glance of it brings a smile to your face.
item:UNI_WYR_MonkAmulet_AfterCombat.name: Sentient Amulet

item:Underwear_Astarion.description: Embroidered into the cloth: 'If you're reading this, you managed to bed or behead me. Either way, you got lucky.'
item:Underwear_Astarion.name: Astarion's Underwear

item:Underwear_Gale.description: Energy crackles around these. Gale wouldn't... Surely he didn't enchant his...
item:Underwear_Gale.name: Netherese Briefs

item:Underwear_Halsin.description: Why does it smell like a herb garden?
item:Underwear_Halsin.name: Halsin's Underwear

item:Underwear_Karlach.description: How do these not burn off?
item:Underwear_Karlach.name: Karlach's Underwear

item:Underwear_Laezel.description: Built for function rather than fun.
item:Underwear_Laezel.name: Lae'zel's Underwear

item:Underwear_Minthara.description: Woven with as much toughened cobweb as cloth.
item:Underwear_Minthara.name: Minthara's Underwear

item:Underwear_Wyll.description: Long may these gird the Blade of Frontiers.
item:Underwear_Wyll.name: Wyll's Underwear

item:WPN_DUE_Whipping_Cane_A_0.description: A cane designed to inflict a sharp and agonising pain with every blow.
item:WPN_DUE_Whipping_Cane_A_0.name: Whipping Cane

item:WPN_Djinni_Scimitar_A.description: This human-made scimitar falls far short of replicating the quality of the drow style it clearly imitates.
item:WPN_Djinni_Scimitar_A.name: Scimitar

item:WPN_Drow_Shield_A_0.description: This thick oak shield is reinforced with a frame of rough-hammered iron.
item:WPN_Drow_Shield_A_0.name: Iron-Banded Shield

item:WPN_Duergar_Shield_B_0.description: Blood splatters this shield - both inside and out.
item:WPN_Duergar_Shield_B_0.name: Wooden Shield

item:WPN_Duergar_Sword_KingsKnife.description: Crudely forged with mismatched components, nearly rusted through, and plenty sharp.
item:WPN_Duergar_Sword_KingsKnife.name: King's Knife

item:WPN_Flail_REF.description: A browning piece of brain sticks stubbornly to one of the spikes.
item:WPN_Flail_REF.name: Flail

item:WPN_GOB_Club_BrandingTool_A.description: Wrought from a single piece of twisted iron. Bits of charred flesh cling to the strange symbol shaped at the end.
item:WPN_GOB_Club_BrandingTool_A.name: Cultist Brand

item:WPN_GOB_Mace_A.description: Rotten rags and mud are the only things keeping this mace together.
item:WPN_GOB_Mace_A.name: Crude Mace

item:WPN_GOB_PainPriest_Dagger.description: The leather handle is smooth with use, and slick with fresh blood.
item:WPN_GOB_PainPriest_Dagger.name: Ritual Dagger

item:WPN_GOB_PainPriest_Handaxe.description: Though shiny and recently polished, dried blood still fills the deepest crevices of this axe.
item:WPN_GOB_PainPriest_Handaxe.name: Ritual Axe

item:WPN_GOB_PainPriest_Scourge.description: More club than scourge, this weapon has a serrated edge made for drawing long, shallow cuts.
item:WPN_GOB_PainPriest_Scourge.name: Loviatar's Scourge

item:WPN_GOB_Scimitar_A.description: A cruel and crude blade forged en masse by goblin hordes.
item:WPN_GOB_Scimitar_A.name: Goblin Scimitar

item:WPN_GOB_Shield_A_0_NOT_APPROVED.description: This rough wooden shield is held together by strips of scrap metal, bolted together with obvious haste.
item:WPN_GOB_Shield_A_0_NOT_APPROVED.name: Scrapwood Shield

item:WPN_GOB_Shield_C_0_NOT_APPROVED.description: Thick spikes jut from this repurposed wooden tabletop.
item:WPN_GOB_Shield_C_0_NOT_APPROVED.name: Spiked Shield

item:WPN_GOB_Shield_D_0_NOT_APPROVED.description: A hand-like symbol is artlessly painted on the front of this wood shield.
item:WPN_GOB_Shield_D_0_NOT_APPROVED.name: Scrapwood Shield

item:WPN_GOB_Shield_E_0_NOT_APPROVED.description: A hand-like symbol is artlessly painted on the front of this wood shield.
item:WPN_GOB_Shield_E_0_NOT_APPROVED.name: Scrapwood Shield

item:WPN_GOB_Shortbow_A_0.description: Fashioned together from a rough-cut branch and stinking sinew.
item:WPN_GOB_Shortbow_A_0.name: Goblin Bow

item:WPN_GOB_Spear_A.description: Dirt and rust mar the edges of this spear, but it is deadly all the same.
item:WPN_GOB_Spear_A.name: Makeshift Spear

item:WPN_GOB_Staff_A.description: Streaks of tendon and sinew cling to the animal skull lashed atop of this wooden staff.
item:WPN_GOB_Staff_A.name: Ritual Staff

item:WPN_GTY_Greatsword_A.description: Though heavily decorated and inlaid with rubies, the blade's sharp edge suggests its use isn't merely ornamental.
item:WPN_GTY_Greatsword_A.name: Githyanki Greatsword

item:WPN_GTY_HeavyCrossbow_A.description: This heavy crossbow is fashioned from a curious, tensile metal that doesn't seem to be native to Faerûn.
