item:WPN_GTY_HeavyCrossbow_A.name: Githyanki Crossbow

item:WPN_GTY_Shortsword_A.description: Despite its engravings, this lightweight sword is perfectly balanced - a flawless killing implement.
item:WPN_GTY_Shortsword_A.name: Githyanki Shortsword

item:WPN_Greataxe.description: The rectangular engravings on this axe's wooden handle have been nearly scratched away by armoured hands.
item:WPN_Greataxe.name: Greataxe

item:WPN_Greataxe_1.description: A small prayer decorates the hilt of this axe. It resonates in your head when you touch it.
item:WPN_Greataxe_1.name: Greataxe +1

item:WPN_Greatsword.description: This sword's guard, held haphazardly in place by thin rope, wobbles slightly when swung.
item:WPN_Greatsword.name: Greatsword

item:WPN_Greatsword_1.description: The thick leather straps wrapped around the base of the blade creak under a solid grip.
item:WPN_Greatsword_1.name: Greatsword +1

item:WPN_Greatsword_Rusty.description: Large and crusted with rust, and about as useful as a drink of water to a drowning man.
item:WPN_Greatsword_Rusty.name: Rusty Greatsword

item:WPN_HUM_Battleaxe_A_0.description: Tiny scratches mar the metal - a testament of someone sharpening this axe over and over.
item:WPN_HUM_Battleaxe_A_0.name: Battleaxe

item:WPN_HUM_Battleaxe_A_1.description: The intricate engravings on this axe's blade and handle make plain the skill of its smith.
item:WPN_HUM_Battleaxe_A_1.name: Battleaxe +1

item:WPN_HUM_Battleaxe_Pact.description: A summonable battleaxe granted by a warlock's patron. Its surface crackles with interdimensional energy.
item:WPN_HUM_Battleaxe_Pact.name: Pactbound Battleaxe

item:WPN_HUM_BoneSaw_A.description: The saw's teeth are blunt and rusted, it's beautiful metalwork barely visible beneath a layer of black, coagulated blood.
item:WPN_HUM_BoneSaw_A.name: Bonesaw

item:WPN_HUM_CleaverAxe_A.description: Stained with blood and gore, the handle has almost rusted through.
item:WPN_HUM_CleaverAxe_A.name: Cleaver

item:WPN_HUM_Club_A_0.description: A long, deep crack runs through the side of the wood, filled with crusted blood.
item:WPN_HUM_Club_A_0.name: Club

item:WPN_HUM_Club_A_1.description: A long, deep crack runs through the side of the wood, filled with crusted blood.
item:WPN_HUM_Club_A_1.name: Club +1

item:WPN_HUM_Club_Broken_A.description: The tip of this club has snapped off, its wood rotten to the core.
item:WPN_HUM_Club_Broken_A.name: Broken Club

item:WPN_HUM_Dagger_A_0_Rusty_A.description: Useful for writing your name in damp slush and not much else.
item:WPN_HUM_Dagger_A_0_Rusty_A.name: Rusty Dagger

item:WPN_HUM_Dagger_A_1.description: This dagger's handle is smooth and light, its jagged blade sharpened into a thin, cruel edge.
item:WPN_HUM_Dagger_A_1.name: Dagger +1

item:WPN_HUM_Dagger_A_2.description: A light, slender blade, magically honed to stay razor-sharp.
item:WPN_HUM_Dagger_A_2.name: Dagger +2

item:WPN_HUM_Flail_A_0.description: The head of this flail is shiny and new, its wooden shaft still coarse and unmarked by blood.
item:WPN_HUM_Flail_A_0.name: Flail

item:WPN_HUM_Flail_A_0_Rusty_A.description: A pitiful excuse for a flail, pitted with rust.
item:WPN_HUM_Flail_A_0_Rusty_A.name: Rusty Flail

item:WPN_HUM_Flail_A_1.description: A browning piece of brain sticks stubbornly to one of the spikes.
item:WPN_HUM_Flail_A_1.name: Flail +1

item:WPN_HUM_Flail_A_2.description: The flail sits heavy in your hand - the weight of steel and magic.
item:WPN_HUM_Flail_A_2.name: Flail +2

item:WPN_HUM_Flail_A_Pact.description: A summonable flail granted by a warlock's patron. Its surface crackles with interdimensional energy.
item:WPN_HUM_Flail_A_Pact.name: Pactbound Flail

item:WPN_HUM_Flail_Myrkul_A_0.description: A browning piece of brain sticks stubbornly to one of the spikes.
item:WPN_HUM_Flail_Myrkul_A_0.name: Flail of Myrkul

item:WPN_HUM_Flail_Myrkul_A_1.description: A browning piece of brain sticks stubbornly to one of the spikes.
item:WPN_HUM_Flail_Myrkul_A_1.name: Myrkulite Scourge

item:WPN_HUM_Glaive_A_0.description: Simple but sharp. The shaft of this glaive is worn smooth with use.
item:WPN_HUM_Glaive_A_0.name: Glaive

item:WPN_HUM_Glaive_A_1.description: Fashioned by expert elven hands to be both deadly and beautiful.
item:WPN_HUM_Glaive_A_1.name: Glaive +1

item:WPN_HUM_Glaive_A_2.description: Tiny specks of blood are fused into the blade, as if the glaive is feeding on them.
item:WPN_HUM_Glaive_A_2.name: Glaive +2

item:WPN_HUM_Glaive_Pact.description: A summonable glaive granted by a warlock's patron. Its surface crackles with interdimensional energy.
item:WPN_HUM_Glaive_Pact.name: Pactbound Glaive

item:WPN_HUM_Greataxe_A_2_NOT_APPROVED.description: This heavy axe emits a barely audible hum when swung.
item:WPN_HUM_Greataxe_A_2_NOT_APPROVED.name: Greataxe +2

item:WPN_HUM_Greataxe_B_0.description: A relatively austere greataxe of rough-hewn wood and sharpened iron.
item:WPN_HUM_Greataxe_B_0.name: Greataxe

item:WPN_HUM_Greatclub_A_0.description: Traces of dried viscera ring many of the iron spikes embedded in this oak club.
item:WPN_HUM_Greatclub_A_0.name: Greatclub

item:WPN_HUM_Greatclub_A_1.description: Without the wrapped leather grip, the weight of the slab of iron at the end of this greatclub would send it flying with a single swing.
item:WPN_HUM_Greatclub_A_1.name: Greatclub +1

item:WPN_HUM_Greatsword_B_1.description: A rune etched into the base of this expertly-forged sword identifies its dwarven blacksmith.
item:WPN_HUM_Greatsword_B_1.name: Greatsword +1

item:WPN_HUM_Greatsword_Pact.description: A summonable greatsword granted by a warlock's patron. Its surface crackles with interdimensional energy.
item:WPN_HUM_Greatsword_Pact.name: Pactbound Greatsword

item:WPN_HUM_Halberd_A_0_Rusty_A.description: A dilapidated old shanker of a weapon.
item:WPN_HUM_Halberd_A_0_Rusty_A.name: Rusty Halberd

item:WPN_HUM_HandCrossbow_A_0.description: The spring locks back with the tiniest, most satisfying click.
item:WPN_HUM_HandCrossbow_A_0.name: Hand Crossbow

item:WPN_HUM_HandCrossbow_A_1.description: A subtle magic runs through both strings of this crossbow, keeping the bows even once the lock is released.
item:WPN_HUM_HandCrossbow_A_1.name: Hand Crossbow +1

item:WPN_HUM_Handaxe_A_0.description: A straightforward hatchet, dulled slightly from chopping wood - or bones.
item:WPN_HUM_Handaxe_A_0.name: Handaxe

item:WPN_HUM_Handaxe_A_0_Rusty_A.description: This handaxe is so banjaxed, it's only possible use could be as a kind of flaky backscratcher.
item:WPN_HUM_Handaxe_A_0_Rusty_A.name: Rusty Handaxe

item:WPN_HUM_Handaxe_A_1.description: This axe's hooked blade is crafted to cleave flesh and bone.
item:WPN_HUM_Handaxe_A_1.name: Handaxe +1

item:WPN_HUM_HeavyCrossbow_A_0.description: A standard-issue crossbow, used by many guardsmen.
item:WPN_HUM_HeavyCrossbow_A_0.name: Heavy Crossbow

item:WPN_HUM_HeavyCrossbow_A_0_Rusty_A.description: Try firing a bolt from this rust-encrusted stock, see if you keep all your fingers.
item:WPN_HUM_HeavyCrossbow_A_0_Rusty_A.name: Rusty Heavy Crossbow

item:WPN_HUM_HeavyCrossbow_A_1.description: Despite the heaviness of this crossbow, the latch pulls back with an effortless ease.
item:WPN_HUM_HeavyCrossbow_A_1.name: Heavy Crossbow +1

item:WPN_HUM_Javelin_A_0.description: A rusted fishing harpoon, repurposed as a weapon.
item:WPN_HUM_Javelin_A_0.name: Javelin

item:WPN_HUM_Javelin_A_1.description: The worn leather strap at the end of this javelin loops around the wrist to let it be thrown with devastating force.
item:WPN_HUM_Javelin_A_1.name: Javelin +1

item:WPN_HUM_Katana_A.description: The hilt of this slender sword is wrapped with soft, black silk - the dark colour hiding any possible stains.
item:WPN_HUM_Katana_A.name: Katana

item:WPN_HUM_Leech_A.description: Though blood and age have rusted the mechanism, a good twist can still make the blades on this bloodletting device spin.
item:WPN_HUM_Leech_A.name: Artificial Leech

item:WPN_HUM_LightCrossbow_A_0.description: This crossbow's cast iron latch is mottled with blooms of rust.
item:WPN_HUM_LightCrossbow_A_0.name: Light Crossbow

item:WPN_HUM_LightCrossbow_A_0_Rusty_A.description: The stock of this crossbow is devoured by decay.
item:WPN_HUM_LightCrossbow_A_0_Rusty_A.name: Rusty Light Crossbow

item:WPN_HUM_LightHammer_A_0.description: A blacksmith's pride and joy, repurposed for combat. Its steel head is tarnished from years in the forge.
item:WPN_HUM_LightHammer_A_0.name: Light Hammer

item:WPN_HUM_LightHammer_A_0_Rusty_A.description: Pockmarked in rust like flaking red tears, this light hammer is good as a doorstop, and not much else.
item:WPN_HUM_LightHammer_A_0_Rusty_A.name: Rusty Light Hammer

item:WPN_HUM_LightHammer_A_1.description: A skilful smith decorated the wooden handle with a fine golden filigree.
item:WPN_HUM_LightHammer_A_1.name: Light Hammer +1

item:WPN_HUM_LightHammer_B_0.description: Years of working hot iron have caused both of this hammer's faces to bulge slightly.
item:WPN_HUM_LightHammer_B_0.name: Light Hammer

item:WPN_HUM_Longbow_A_1.description: Carved enchantments span the length of this supple bow.
item:WPN_HUM_Longbow_A_1.name: Longbow +1

item:WPN_HUM_Longbow_A_2_NOT_APPROVED.description: A soothing hum drifts through your head whenever you draw this bow.
item:WPN_HUM_Longbow_A_2_NOT_APPROVED.name: Longbow +2

item:WPN_HUM_Longsword_A_0.description: A common sword, passed between hands both fresh and battle-scarred.
item:WPN_HUM_Longsword_A_0.name: Longsword

item:WPN_HUM_Longsword_A_0_Rusty_A.description: Mottled with rust, this longsword is a hideous excuse for a blade.
item:WPN_HUM_Longsword_A_0_Rusty_A.name: Rusty Longsword

item:WPN_HUM_Longsword_A_1.description: A complex filigree wraps around the base of this blade - the runes on the side suggesting it is not merely decorative.
item:WPN_HUM_Longsword_A_1.name: Longsword +1

item:WPN_HUM_Longsword_A_2.description: This longsword never dulls, although an observer may notice it quietly drinks the blood of slain enemies.
item:WPN_HUM_Longsword_A_2.name: Longsword +2

item:WPN_HUM_Longsword_Adamantine_A.description: Though heavy, this longsword swings effortlessly in your hand - ready to take down a hundred enemies.
item:WPN_HUM_Longsword_Adamantine_A.name: Adamantine Longsword

item:WPN_HUM_Longsword_Broken_A.description: A common sword, passed between hands both fresh and battle-scarred.
item:WPN_HUM_Longsword_Broken_A.name: Longsword

item:WPN_HUM_Mace_A_0.description: A simple but effective mace, cast en masse by human blacksmiths.
item:WPN_HUM_Mace_A_0.name: Mace

item:WPN_HUM_Mace_A_0_Rusty_A.description: The head of this mace is a scratchboard of peeling orange rust.
item:WPN_HUM_Mace_A_0_Rusty_A.name: Rusty Mace

item:WPN_HUM_Mace_A_1.description: The leather handle of this mace smells badly of rotting blood.
item:WPN_HUM_Mace_A_1.name: Mace +1

item:WPN_HUM_Mace_A_2.description: The shallow etchings along this mace's head seem to change shape, depending on the light.
item:WPN_HUM_Mace_A_2.name: Mace +2

item:WPN_HUM_Mace_Adamantine_A.description: A nimble mace, heavy with the promise of broken bones.
item:WPN_HUM_Mace_Adamantine_A.name: Adamantine Mace

item:WPN_HUM_Magicstaff_D_0.description: Gnarled, finger-like roots encase the gemstone at the top of this staff.
item:WPN_HUM_Magicstaff_D_0.name: Staff

item:WPN_HUM_Maul_A_0_Rusty_A.description: Rust has eaten clean-through the heavy head of this maul.
item:WPN_HUM_Maul_A_0_Rusty_A.name: Rusty Maul

item:WPN_HUM_Morningstar_A_0.description: More of this morningstar's iron spikes are bent than not.
item:WPN_HUM_Morningstar_A_0.name: Morningstar

item:WPN_HUM_Morningstar_A_0_Rusty_A.description: The heavy head of this steel star is malefic with rust.
item:WPN_HUM_Morningstar_A_0_Rusty_A.name: Rusty Morningstar

item:WPN_HUM_Morningstar_A_1.description: It's said that one warrior with a morningstar is worth seventeen with a sword - one for each of the weapon's spikes.
item:WPN_HUM_Morningstar_A_1.name: Morningstar +1

item:WPN_HUM_Pike_A_0.description: This pike's broad steel head has been repeatedly bent and hammered back into its original shape.
item:WPN_HUM_Pike_A_0.name: Pike

item:WPN_HUM_Pike_A_0_Rusty_A.description: Truly the amount of rust accumulated on this pike is a lesson in how not to keep your weapons.
item:WPN_HUM_Pike_A_0_Rusty_A.name: Rusty Pike

item:WPN_HUM_Pike_A_1.description: The base of this polearm's shaft is splintered, likely having borne the weight of a rider plucked from their mount.
item:WPN_HUM_Pike_A_1.name: Pike +1

item:WPN_HUM_Pike_Broken_A.description: The pike's tip is battered and bent, fit for neither soldier nor scoundrel.
item:WPN_HUM_Pike_Broken_A.name: Broken Pike

item:WPN_HUM_Quarterstaff_A_0.description: Someone has carved twenty-seven small lines into the hard wood.
item:WPN_HUM_Quarterstaff_A_0.name: Quarterstaff

item:WPN_HUM_Quarterstaff_A_1.description: A polished wooden staff, embellished with knobs and steel for both function and design.
item:WPN_HUM_Quarterstaff_A_1.name: Quarterstaff +1

item:WPN_HUM_Quarterstaff_A_2.description: Steel bands wrap around a wooden core, giving this staff extra momentum.
item:WPN_HUM_Quarterstaff_A_2.name: Quarterstaff +2

item:WPN_HUM_Quarterstaff_B_0.description: Part of this staff has taken on a deep red colour.
item:WPN_HUM_Quarterstaff_B_0.name: Quarterstaff

item:WPN_HUM_Quarterstaff_C_0.description: Someone has carved twenty-seven small lines into the hard wood.
item:WPN_HUM_Quarterstaff_C_0.name: Quarterstaff

item:WPN_HUM_Rapier_A_0.description: A slender but deadly sword, favoured by Waterdhavian nobility.
item:WPN_HUM_Rapier_A_0.name: Rapier

item:WPN_HUM_Rapier_A_1.description: A lightweight sword that turns the slightest flick of a wrist into a deadly attack.
item:WPN_HUM_Rapier_A_1.name: Rapier +1

item:WPN_HUM_Rapier_A_2.description: The thin edge of this sword seems to blur and become nigh imperceptible with even the slightest movement.
item:WPN_HUM_Rapier_A_2.name: Rapier +2

item:WPN_HUM_Rapier_Pact.description: A summonable rapier granted by a warlock's patron. Its surface crackles with interdimensional energy.
item:WPN_HUM_Rapier_Pact.name: Pactbound Rapier

item:WPN_HUM_Salami_A.description: A boon to any adventurer - delicious, long-lasting, and hard enough to smack an adversary.
item:WPN_HUM_Salami_A.name: Salami

item:WPN_HUM_Scimitar_A_0.description: This human-made scimitar falls far short of replicating the quality of the drow style it clearly imitates.
item:WPN_HUM_Scimitar_A_0.name: Scimitar

item:WPN_HUM_Scimitar_A_0_Rusty_A.description: Only an utter gibbon would consider swinging this in combat.
item:WPN_HUM_Scimitar_A_0_Rusty_A.name: Rusty Scimitar

item:WPN_HUM_Scimitar_A_1.description: The phases of the moon are carved into the hilt of this scimitar, betraying a druid's careful hand.
item:WPN_HUM_Scimitar_A_1.name: Scimitar +1

item:WPN_HUM_Scimitar_Adamantine_A.description: Each cut of this blade shines with the wicked glint of adamantine - a promise for a devastating blow.
item:WPN_HUM_Scimitar_Adamantine_A.name: Adamantine Scimitar

item:WPN_HUM_Shield_A_0.description: The side of this shield has a slightly lighter colour - as if part of it was cut away and replaced.
item:WPN_HUM_Shield_A_0.name: Studded Shield

item:WPN_HUM_Shield_A_1.description: Though dented in many places, this shield shines like new.
item:WPN_HUM_Shield_A_1.name: Shield +1

item:WPN_HUM_Shield_Adamantine_A.description: The dull shine of the adamantine promises this shield could take a thousand beatings - and still look as good as new.
item:WPN_HUM_Shield_Adamantine_A.name: Adamantine Shield

item:WPN_HUM_Shield_B_0.description: Blood splatters this shield - both inside and out.
item:WPN_HUM_Shield_B_0.name: Wooden Shield

item:WPN_HUM_Shield_B_1.description: Despite numerous small scratches on the shield's surface, not a single blade has been able to make an actual dent in the heavy wood.
item:WPN_HUM_Shield_B_1.name: Iron-Banded Shield +1

item:WPN_HUM_Shield_Broken_A.description: This old splintered shield is no stronger than a child's toy.
item:WPN_HUM_Shield_Broken_A.name: Broken Shield

item:WPN_HUM_Shield_C_0.description: Despite the chips and dents, you can still make out the faded painting of a flower on the face of this shield.
item:WPN_HUM_Shield_C_0.name: Wooden Shield

item:WPN_HUM_Shield_C_1.description: Small pockets of rust are starting to eat away at a few of the studs.
item:WPN_HUM_Shield_C_1.name: Studded Shield +1

item:WPN_HUM_Shield_D_0.description: Pristine and unmarred, this shield still smells faintly of varnish.
item:WPN_HUM_Shield_D_0.name: Shield

item:WPN_HUM_Shield_D_0_Rusty_A.description: Good for defending from stray flatulence, but that's about it.
item:WPN_HUM_Shield_D_0_Rusty_A.name: Rusty Studded Shield

item:WPN_HUM_Shield_D_1.description: This thick oak shield is reinforced with a frame of rough-hammered iron.
item:WPN_HUM_Shield_D_1.name: Iron-Banded Shield +1

item:WPN_HUM_Shield_E_2.description: This shield bears the crest of a long-forgotten house.
item:WPN_HUM_Shield_E_2.name: Shield

item:WPN_HUM_Shield_FlamingFist.description: Though the metal is only of moderate quality, a proud, flaming fist decorates the front of this shield.
item:WPN_HUM_Shield_FlamingFist.name: Metal Shield

item:WPN_HUM_Shortbow_A_0.description: This small, agile bow bears a beautiful elven string, easy to draw but tough as steel.
item:WPN_HUM_Shortbow_A_0.name: Shortbow

item:WPN_HUM_Shortbow_A_1.description: This halfling bow requires a full draw for smaller folk, but serves as a quick off-hand for those of greater height.
item:WPN_HUM_Shortbow_A_1.name: Shortbow +1

item:WPN_HUM_Shortsword_A_0.description: A common and effective sword, carried by adventurers, thieves, and watchmen alike.
item:WPN_HUM_Shortsword_A_0.name: Shortsword

item:WPN_HUM_Shortsword_A_0_Rusty_A.description: Leopardspots of rust mottle this sword.
item:WPN_HUM_Shortsword_A_0_Rusty_A.name: Rusty Shortsword

item:WPN_HUM_Shortsword_A_1.description: A standard, lightweight sword, suitable for both thrusting and slashing techniques.
item:WPN_HUM_Shortsword_A_1.name: Shortsword +1

item:WPN_HUM_Shortsword_A_2.description: A common and effective sword, carried by adventurers, thieves, and watchmen alike.
item:WPN_HUM_Shortsword_A_2.name: Shortsword +2

item:WPN_HUM_Sickle_A_0.description: A farming tool with a wicked edge, spilling blood and grain with equal ease.
item:WPN_HUM_Sickle_A_0.name: Sickle

item:WPN_HUM_Sickle_A_0_Rusty_A.description: Not even useful in the herbalist trade.
item:WPN_HUM_Sickle_A_0_Rusty_A.name: Rusty Sickle

item:WPN_HUM_Sickle_A_Pact.description: A summonable sickle granted by a warlock's patron. Its surface crackles with interdimensional energy.
item:WPN_HUM_Sickle_A_Pact.name: Pactbound Sickle

item:WPN_HUM_Spear_A_0.description: An aged spear, its steel head nicked by the blows of a dozen battles.
item:WPN_HUM_Spear_A_0.name: Spear

item:WPN_HUM_Spear_A_0_Rusty_A.description: While the handle is well made, the metal point is pitted with rust, and brittle as frozen underwear in the hands of a stone giant.
item:WPN_HUM_Spear_A_0_Rusty_A.name: Rusty Spear

item:WPN_HUM_Spear_A_1.description: Forged by dwarven hands, and prized by all warriors who wish to keep their foe at a distance.
item:WPN_HUM_Spear_A_1.name: Spear +1

item:WPN_HUM_Spear_A_2.description: Even the ornamentation at the base of this spear's head is honed to a razor edge.
item:WPN_HUM_Spear_A_2.name: Spear +2

item:WPN_HUM_Staff_Selune_A.description: This staff's blue inlays and moon-shaped ornamentation indicate its use among Selûne's clergy.
item:WPN_HUM_Staff_Selune_A.name: Staff of the Moonmaiden

item:WPN_HUM_Syringe_A.description: The yellowish-green ooze dried to the syringe's long needle gives you the distinct impression that this medical device was never used to heal anyone.
item:WPN_HUM_Syringe_A.name: Syringe

item:WPN_HUM_Torch_A.description: A deep oily smell wafts from this crude tree branch.
item:WPN_HUM_Torch_A.name: Torch

item:WPN_HUM_Torch_Lantern_A.description: A deep oily smell wafts from this crude tree branch.
item:WPN_HUM_Torch_Lantern_A.name: Lantern

item:WPN_HUM_Toy_Shield_A.description: A light, wooden shield, full of dents and cuts.
item:WPN_HUM_Toy_Shield_A.name: Training Shield

item:WPN_HUM_Toy_Sword_A.description: Though carefully coated in a thick layer of varnish, the edges of the wooden sword are already starting to chip away.
item:WPN_HUM_Toy_Sword_A.name: Practice Sword

item:WPN_HUM_Trepan_A.description: The soothing jade handle stands in stark contrast to the trepan's gruesome tip - a reminder of its intended use.
item:WPN_HUM_Trepan_A.name: Trepan

item:WPN_HUM_Trident_A_0.description: It is said tridents were brought to the surface when Umberlee threw a Triton prince who scorned her onto Faerûn's shores.
item:WPN_HUM_Trident_A_0.name: Trident

item:WPN_HUM_Trident_A_0_Rusty_A.description: Rust pits each of this trident's prongs.
item:WPN_HUM_Trident_A_0_Rusty_A.name: Rusty Trident

item:WPN_HUM_Trident_A_1.description: The brutal design of this weapon's trio of prongs forces pierced flesh apart.
item:WPN_HUM_Trident_A_1.name: Trident +1

item:WPN_HUM_Trident_A_2.description: An elegant, vicious weapon designed to eviscerate flesh and organs.
item:WPN_HUM_Trident_A_2.name: Trident +2

item:WPN_HUM_Trident_Pact.description: A summonable trident granted by a warlock's patron. Its surface crackles with interdimensional energy.
item:WPN_HUM_Trident_Pact.name: Pactbound Trident

item:WPN_HUM_Warhammer_A_0.description: This hammer's noticeable lack of upkeep hardly matters, given its heft.
item:WPN_HUM_Warhammer_A_0.name: Warhammer

item:WPN_HUM_Warhammer_A_1.description: Following tradition, this hammer's faces were forged with grooves that sealed in the blood of its first kill.
item:WPN_HUM_Warhammer_A_1.name: Warhammer +1

item:WPN_HUM_Warhammer_A_2.description: The segmented design of this gnome-forged hammer borrows elements of dragonborn weaponry.
item:WPN_HUM_Warhammer_A_2.name: Warhammer +2

item:WPN_HUM_Warhammer_Pact.description: A summonable warhammer granted by a warlock's patron. Its surface crackles with interdimensional energy.
item:WPN_HUM_Warhammer_Pact.name: Pactbound Warhammer

item:WPN_HUM_Warpick_A_0.description: A pickaxe modified to pierce flesh and armour rather than stone.
item:WPN_HUM_Warpick_A_0.name: War Pick

item:WPN_HUM_Warpick_A_1.description: When swung, the arc of this weapon perfectly matches the curve of its beak-like pick.
item:WPN_HUM_Warpick_A_1.name: War Pick +1

item:WPN_Halberd.description: Part of the spike affixed to the top of this halberd has snapped off, leaving a cruel barb.
item:WPN_Halberd.name: Halberd

item:WPN_Halberd_1.description: This halberd's spike is black with ash that cannot be washed away.
item:WPN_Halberd_1.name: Halberd +1

item:WPN_Kuotoa_Javelin_A_1.description: The cut-off pincer of some Underdark crustacean seems to magically adhere to a bone shaft, creating a make-shift javelin.
item:WPN_Kuotoa_Javelin_A_1.name: BOOOAL's Arms

item:WPN_Kuotoa_Shield_A_0.description: Sticky, rope-like seaweed is wrapped around this oversized shell, allowing it to be fashioned as a shield.
item:WPN_Kuotoa_Shield_A_0.name: Fossilised Shell

item:WPN_LightCrossbow_1.description: Though this crossbow's stock is hollowed out, its heavy trigger mechanism keeps it well-balanced.
item:WPN_LightCrossbow_1.name: Light Crossbow +1

item:WPN_Longsword_Gith.description: Every tip and edge on this elaborate sword is sharpened to a deadly perfection.
item:WPN_Longsword_Gith.name: Githyanki Longsword

item:WPN_Maul.description: Hammers like this are used in many dwarven competitions, testing who can throw them the farthest while enduring the most ale.
item:WPN_Maul.name: Maul

item:WPN_Maul_1.description: A weapon of dwarven make: elegant, but strong enough to last several human lifetimes.
item:WPN_Maul_1.name: Maul +1

item:WPN_Merregon_Halberd.description: Sharp teeth grow out of the halberd's dark metal - if it is indeed metal at all.
item:WPN_Merregon_Halberd.name: Merregon Halberd

item:WPN_SAHUAGIN_Longbow_A.description: Carved enchantments span the length of this supple bow.
item:WPN_SAHUAGIN_Longbow_A.name: Sahuagin Longbow

item:WPN_SAHUAGIN_Spear_B.description: Forged by dwarven hands, and prized by all warriors who wish to keep their foe at a distance.
item:WPN_SAHUAGIN_Spear_B.name: Sahuagin Spear

item:WPN_Scimitar_2.description: An arched electric-blue afterimage follows this blade's every move.
item:WPN_Scimitar_2.name: Scimitar +2

item:WPN_Tower_AutomatonHalberd.description: Small lodestones have been inserted along the halberd's shaft, a strange blue current running through them.
item:WPN_Tower_AutomatonHalberd.name: Light of Creation

item:WPN_Wood_Woad_Club.description: A thick, gnarled branch, grown into a club-like shape.
item:WPN_Wood_Woad_Club.name: Twisting Branch

item:WPN_Wood_Woad_Shield.description: These three small stumps make for a peculiar but effective shield.
item:WPN_Wood_Woad_Shield.name: Organic Shield

item:WYR_Circus_ThiefGloves.description: Whenever the wearer steals anything, a piece of coal appears in their pocket, like a tiny, dusty condemnation.
item:WYR_Circus_ThiefGloves.name: Unlucky Thief's Gloves

item:WYR_Circus_WetCloak.description: The wearer is perpetually just a little bit damp.
item:WYR_Circus_WetCloak.name: Reverse Rain Cloak

passive:AccursedSpecter.description: When you or an ally within [1] slay a creature that is afflicted with <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="HEXBLADES_CURSE">Hexblade's Curse</LSTag>, you can raise an Accursed Spectre that will fight alongside you for a short period of time.
passive:AccursedSpecter.name: Accursed Spectre

passive:AcolyteOfNature.description: You learn a druid <LSTag Tooltip="Cantrip">cantrip</LSTag>, and become <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficient</LSTag> in <LSTag Tooltip="AnimalHandling">Animal Handling</LSTag>, <LSTag Tooltip="Nature">Nature</LSTag>, or <LSTag Tooltip="Survival">Survival</LSTag>.
passive:AcolyteOfNature.name: Acolyte of Nature

passive:Actor.description: You have become a true thespian. Your <LSTag Tooltip="Charisma">Charisma</LSTag> increases by [1], to a maximum of [2]. Your <LSTag Tooltip="ProficiencyBonus">Proficiency Bonus</LSTag> is doubled for Deception and Performance <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Checks</LSTag>.
passive:Actor.name: Actor

passive:AgonizingBlast.description: When you cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_EldritchBlast">Eldritch Blast</LSTag>, add your <LSTag Tooltip="Charisma">Charisma</LSTag> <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">Modifier</LSTag> to the damage it deals, unless it is negative.
passive:AgonizingBlast.name: Agonising Blast

passive:Alert.description: You gain a +[1] bonus to Initiative and can't be <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SURPRISED">Surprised</LSTag>.
passive:Alert.name: Alert

passive:ArcaneWard.description: The residual magic of your spells forms a ward around you that protects you from harm.
passive:ArcaneWard.name: Arcane Ward

passive:ArmorOfHexes.description: When a creature you cursed with <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="HEXBLADES_CURSE">Hexblade's Curse</LSTag> attacks you, potentially nullify the attack as a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">reaction</LSTag>. This has a 50% chance of succeeding.
passive:ArmorOfHexes.name: Armour of Hexes

passive:ArmorOfShadows.description: You can cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_MageArmor">Mage Armour</LSTag> on yourself at will, without expending a <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">spell slot</LSTag>.
passive:ArmorOfShadows.name: Armour of Shadows

passive:AspectOfTheBeast_Bear.description:
The Aspect of the Bear infuses you with strength.

Your carrying capacity is doubled, and you have Advantage on Strength Checks.
passive:AspectOfTheBeast_Bear.name: Aspect of the Beast: Bear

passive:AspectOfTheBeast_Chimpanzee.description:
The Aspect of the Chimpanzee grants you a nimble mischievousness.

You gain Resistance to Falling damage, and throwing camp supplies Blinds targets.
passive:AspectOfTheBeast_Chimpanzee.name: Aspect of the Beast: Chimpanzee

passive:AspectOfTheBeast_Crocodile.description:
The Aspect of the Crocodile increases your agility in the water.

Your movement speed increases by [1] while standing in water-based surfaces.

On slippery surfaces, you also have Advantage on Saving Throws against being knocked Prone.
passive:AspectOfTheBeast_Crocodile.name: Aspect of the Beast: Crocodile

passive:AspectOfTheBeast_Eagle.description:
The Aspect of the Eagle enhances your eyesight.

You can see in the dark up to [1], and gain Advantage on Perception Checks.
passive:AspectOfTheBeast_Eagle.name: Aspect of the Beast: Eagle

passive:AspectOfTheBeast_Elk.description:
The Aspect of the Elk grants you astounding swiftness.

You can use Aspect of the Elk, giving yourself and nearby allies extra movement speed.
passive:AspectOfTheBeast_Elk.name: Aspect of the Beast: Elk

passive:AspectOfTheBeast_HoneyBadger.description: If you're <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="POISONED">Poisoned</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="FRIGHTENED">Frightened</LSTag>, or <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="CHARMED">Charmed</LSTag> at the start of your turn, you have a 50% chance to begin <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="RAGE">Raging</LSTag> without expending a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="Rage">Rage Charge</LSTag>.
passive:AspectOfTheBeast_HoneyBadger.name: Aspect of the Beast: Honey Badger

passive:AspectOfTheBeast_Stallion.description:
The Aspect of the Stallion creates safety in movement.

Dashing grants you temporary hit points equal to twice your Barbarian level.
passive:AspectOfTheBeast_Stallion.name: Aspect of the Beast: Stallion

passive:AspectOfTheBeast_Tiger.description:
The Aspect of the Tiger infuses you with an unrelenting ferocity.

You add an additional Strength Modifier to Attack Rolls against Bleeding or Poisoned targets, and gain Proficiency in Survival.
passive:AspectOfTheBeast_Tiger.name: Aspect of the Beast: Tiger

passive:AspectOfTheBeast_Wolf.description:
The Aspect of the Wolf boosts your stealthiness.

You gain Proficiency in Stealth, and can use Aspect of the Wolf.
passive:AspectOfTheBeast_Wolf.name: Aspect of the Beast: Wolf

passive:AspectOfTheBeast_Wolverine.description:
The Aspect of the Wolverine grants you the tools to relentlessly pursue your prey.

When you attack a Bleeding or Poisoned target, you also Maim it for 1 turn.
passive:AspectOfTheBeast_Wolverine.name: Aspect of the Beast: Wolverine

passive:Assassinate_Ambush.description: Any successful <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> against a <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SURPRISED">Surprised</LSTag> creature is a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag>.
passive:Assassinate_Ambush.name: Assassinate: Ambush

passive:Assassinate_Initiative.description: You are deadliest against unprepared enemies. In combat, you have <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> against creatures that haven't taken a turn yet.
passive:Assassinate_Initiative.name: Assassinate: Initiative

passive:Assassinate_Resource.description: Quick as an alley cat in a rain-dark city, you immediately restore your <LSTag Tooltip="Action">action</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Bonus_Action">bonus action</LSTag> at the start of combat.
passive:Assassinate_Resource.name: Assassin's Alacrity

passive:Athlete_StandUp.description: When you are <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="PRONE">Prone</LSTag>, standing up uses only [1] of your <LSTag Tooltip="MovementSpeed">movement speed</LSTag>.
passive:Athlete_StandUp.name: Athlete: Standing Up

passive:Background_Acolyte.description: You have <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> in <LSTag Tooltip="Insight">Insight</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Religion">Religion</LSTag> thanks to your studies of people and the things they believe in.
passive:Background_Acolyte.name: Acolyte

passive:Background_AstralZealot.description: You have <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> in <LSTag Tooltip="Athletics">Athletics</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Intimidation">Intimidation</LSTag> checks from your extensive training in githyanki war dogma.
passive:Background_AstralZealot.name: Astral Zealot

passive:Background_BladeOfFrontiers.description: You have <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> in <LSTag Tooltip="Athletics">Athletics</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Persuasion">Persuasion</LSTag> checks - perhaps the legends surrounding your name are true, after all.
passive:Background_BladeOfFrontiers.name: Blade of Frontiers

passive:Background_BloodWarVeteran.description: You have <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> in <LSTag Tooltip="Athletics">Athletics</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Survival">Survival</LSTag> checks, essential tools for any who fight the Blood War's most fevered frays.
passive:Background_BloodWarVeteran.name: Blood War Veteran

passive:Background_Charlatan.description: You have <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> in <LSTag Tooltip="Deception">Deception</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="SleightOfHand">Sleight Of Hand</LSTag>, for your nimble mind is matched only by your deft fingers.
passive:Background_Charlatan.name: Charlatan

passive:Background_CloisteredStray.description: You have <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> in <LSTag Tooltip="Religion">Religion</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Survival">Survival</LSTag> checks due to deeply ingrained doctrines.
passive:Background_CloisteredStray.name: Cloistered Stray

passive:Background_Criminal.description: You have <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> in <LSTag Tooltip="Deception">Deception</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Stealth">Stealth</LSTag>, hinting at your past of mischief and skullduggery.
passive:Background_Criminal.name: Criminal

passive:Background_Entertainer.description: You have <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> in <LSTag Tooltip="Acrobatics">Acrobatics</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Performance">Performance</LSTag> as the muse of artistic ability dallies in your heart.
passive:Background_Entertainer.name: Entertainer

passive:Background_FolkHero.description: You have <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> in <LSTag Tooltip="AnimalHandling">Animal Handling</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Survival">Survival</LSTag>, harkening back to your past as a fabled personality in the boondock towns of the world.
passive:Background_FolkHero.name: Folk Hero

passive:Background_GroveKeeper.description: You have <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> in <LSTag Tooltip="AnimalHandling">Animal Handling</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Nature">Nature</LSTag> checks, experienced garnered from your long stewardship of the Emerald Grove.
passive:Background_GroveKeeper.name: Grove Tender

passive:Background_GuildArtisan.description: You have <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> in <LSTag Tooltip="Insight">Insight</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Persuasion">Persuasion</LSTag>, for your guild has brought you into contact with lots of interesting folk.
passive:Background_GuildArtisan.name: Guild Artisan

passive:Background_HauntedOne.description: You have <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> in <LSTag Tooltip="Medicine">Medicine</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Intimidation">Intimidation</LSTag> checks thanks to the bloody and wretched path you've walked so long.
passive:Background_HauntedOne.name: Haunted One

passive:Background_LegendOfBaldur'sGate.description: You have <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> in <LSTag Tooltip="AnimalHandling">Animal Handling</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Perception">Perception</LSTag> checks - with a sword in your hand and Boo by your side, nothing can stand in your way.
passive:Background_LegendOfBaldur'sGate.name: Legend of Baldur's Gate

passive:Background_Noble.description: You have <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> in <LSTag Tooltip="History">History</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Persuasion">Persuasion</LSTag> as a result of your past, steeped in silken nobility.
passive:Background_Noble.name: Noble

passive:Background_Outlander.description: You have <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> in <LSTag Tooltip="Athletics">Athletics</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Survival">Survival</LSTag>, a consequence of being a stranger in strange lands.
passive:Background_Outlander.name: Outlander

passive:Background_Sage.description: You have <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> in <LSTag Tooltip="Arcana">Arcana</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="History">History</LSTag> thanks to your germane and extensive knowledge of ancient tomes.
passive:Background_Sage.name: Sage

passive:Background_Soldier.description: You have <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> in <LSTag Tooltip="Athletics">Athletics</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Intimidation">Intimidation</LSTag> from your impactful time as a pawn in the great games of war.
passive:Background_Soldier.name: Soldier

passive:Background_TricksterHedonist.description: You have <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> in <LSTag Tooltip="Deception">Deception</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Stealth">Stealth</LSTag> from your many years frolicking among courts and the shadows haunting them.
passive:Background_TricksterHedonist.name: Trickster Hedonist

passive:Background_UnderdarkExile.description: You have <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> in <LSTag Tooltip="Deception">Deception</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Intimidation">Intimidation</LSTag> checks, a mark of your long exile from a subterranean home.
passive:Background_UnderdarkExile.name: Underdark Exile

passive:Background_Urchin.description: You have <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> in <LSTag Tooltip="SleightOfHand">Sleight Of Hand</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Stealth">Stealth</LSTag> checks, the mark of a lonely but resourceful upbringing.
passive:Background_Urchin.name: Urchin

passive:Background_VeteranMentor.description: You have <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> in <LSTag Tooltip="Insight">Insight</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Intimidation">Intimidation</LSTag> checks - this is far from your first world-ending threat, after all.
passive:Background_VeteranMentor.name: World-Wise Heroine

passive:Background_WaterdavianMagus.description: You have <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> in <LSTag Tooltip="Arcana">Arcana</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="History">History</LSTag> after years of peerless arcane tutelage in Waterdeep.
passive:Background_WaterdavianMagus.name: Wizard of Waterdeep

passive:BardicInspiration_d10.description: The bonus gained from <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_BardicInspiration">Bardic Inspiration</LSTag> increases to +[1].
passive:BardicInspiration_d10.name: Improved Bardic Inspiration

passive:BardicInspiration_d8.description: The bonus gained from <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_BardicInspiration">Bardic Inspiration</LSTag> increases to +[1].
passive:BardicInspiration_d8.name: Improved Bardic Inspiration

passive:BeastSpeech.description: You can cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_SpeakWithAnimals">Speak with Animals</LSTag> at will, without expending a <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">spell slot</LSTag>.
passive:BeastSpeech.name: Beast Speech

passive:BeguilingDefenses.description: You have built stoic barriers in your heart and mind, and cannot be <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="CHARMED">Charmed</LSTag>.
passive:BeguilingDefenses.name: Beguiling Defences

passive:BeguilingInfluence.description: You invoke your patron's bewitching charm. You gain <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> in <LSTag Tooltip="Deception">Deception</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Persuasion">Persuasion</LSTag>.
passive:BeguilingInfluence.name: Beguiling Influence

passive:BendLuck.description: When a creature you can see makes an <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag>, <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Ability Check</LSTag>, or a <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag>, you can use your reaction and spend 2 <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="SorceryPoint">Sorcery Point</LSTag> to roll 1d4, applying the number rolled as a bonus or penalty (your choice) to the creature's roll.
passive:BendLuck.name: Bend Luck

passive:BestialFury.description: Your bond with your companion has deepened, unlocking their inner strength and giving them an <LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="ExtraAttack">Extra Attack</LSTag>.
passive:BestialFury.name: Bestial Fury

passive:BlessedHealer.description:
Healing others heals you as well.

When you cast a healing spell of Level 1 or higher on another creature, you regain hit points equal to 2 + the spell's level.
passive:BlessedHealer.name: Blessed Healer

passive:BookOfAncientSecrets.description:
You can inscribe magical rituals in your Book of Shadows.

Gain the Ray of Sickness, Chromatic Orb, and Silence spells. You can cast these spells once per Long Rest, and they don't expend any spell slots when cast.
passive:BookOfAncientSecrets.name: Book of Ancient Secrets

passive:BrutalCritical.description: You've trained to strike swift and true. When you land a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag>, you roll an extra damage die as well as the normal additional critical dice.
passive:BrutalCritical.name: Brutal Critical

passive:Charger.description: Let your speed intensify your onslaught. You can <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Rush_Charger_Push">Shove</LSTag> or deal additional <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Rush_Charger_Attack>Weapon Damage</LSTag> when you attack.
passive:Charger.name: Charger

passive:CheekyTipple.description: You are Immune to the negative effects of being <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DRUNK">Drunk</LSTag>. Once per day, when you drink alcohol, you regain half your <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="KiPoint">Ki Points</LSTag> (rounded down).
passive:CheekyTipple.name: Cheeky Tipple

passive:ClarifiedMortality.description: When you land a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag> against a creature, that creature and any nearby enemies must succeed a Wisdom <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throw</LSTag> or become <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="FRIGHTENED">Frightened</LSTag> until the end of their next turn.
passive:ClarifiedMortality.name: Mortal Reminder

passive:ColossusSlayer.description: Once per turn, your weapon attack deals an extra 1d8 damage if the target is below its hit point maximum.
passive:ColossusSlayer.name: Colossus Slayer

passive:CommanderStrike_Maneuver.description: Direct an ally to strike a foe. The ally uses a reaction on their next turn to make a weapon attack.
passive:CommanderStrike_Maneuver.name: Commander's Strike

passive:CompanionsBond.description: The bond between you and your animal companion grows stronger. Your <LSTag Tooltip="ProficiencyBonus">Proficiency Bonus</LSTag> is added to its <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourClass">Armour Class</LSTag> and damage rolls.
passive:CompanionsBond.name: Companion's Bond

passive:ControlledChaos.description: Foes may suffer a <LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="WildMagic">Wild Magic Surge</LSTag> while casting spells near your fluctuating magic.
passive:ControlledChaos.name: Controlled Chaos

passive:CosmicOmen.description: Whenever you <LSTag Tooltip="LongRest">Long Rest</LSTag>, you consult the stars for a Cosmic Omen of Weal or of Woe. The omen grants you the ability to increase (Weal) or decrease (Woe) <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> or <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag>, or (Weal only) to increase your allies' <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Ability Checks</LSTag>.
passive:CosmicOmen.name: Cosmic Omen

passive:CosmicOmen_Rest.description: Whenever you <LSTag Tooltip="LongRest">Long Rest</LSTag>, you consult the stars for a Cosmic Omen of Weal or of Woe. The omen grants you the ability to increase (Weal) or decrease (Woe) <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> or <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag>, or (Weal only) to increase your allies' <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Ability Checks</LSTag>.
passive:CosmicOmen_Rest.name: Cosmic Omen

passive:CrossbowExpert_PointBlank.description: When you make crossbow attacks within melee range, the <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> do not have <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag>.
passive:CrossbowExpert_PointBlank.name: Crossbow Expert: Point-Blank

passive:CrossbowExpert_Wounding.description: Your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_PiercingShot">Piercing Shot</LSTag> inflicts <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="GAPING_WOUND">Gaping Wounds</LSTag> for twice as long.
passive:CrossbowExpert_Wounding.name: Crossbow Expert: Wounding

passive:CurvingShot.description: When you miss with any magical ranged attack, use a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="BonusActionPoint">bonus action</LSTag> to attack the next closest target with the same attack.
passive:CurvingShot.name: Curving Shot

passive:CuttingWords.description: Use your wit to distract a creature and sap its confidence.
passive:CuttingWords.name: Cutting Words

passive:DampenElements.description: When you or an ally gets hit with Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage, you can use your reaction to halve the attack's damage.
passive:DampenElements.name: Dampen Elements

passive:DangerSense.description:
You sense when things aren't as they should be.

You have Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws against traps, spells, and surfaces.

To gain this benefit, you can't be Blinded or Incapacitated.
passive:DangerSense.name: Danger Sense

passive:DarkOnesBlessing.description: When you reduce a hostile creature to [1], this gift from your patron grants you [2].
passive:DarkOnesBlessing.name: Dark One's Blessing

passive:DarkOnesOwnLuck.description: Call on your patron to change your fate and add a 1d10 to an <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Ability Check</LSTag>.
passive:DarkOnesOwnLuck.name: Dark One's Own Luck

passive:Darkvision.description: You can see in the dark up to [1].
passive:Darkvision.name: Darkvision

passive:DeepGnome_StoneCamouflage.description: You have <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on Stealth <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Checks</LSTag>.
passive:DeepGnome_StoneCamouflage.name: Stone Camouflage

passive:DefensiveDuelist.description: When attacked while wielding a <LSTag Tooltip="Finesse">Finesse Weapon</LSTag> you're <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficient</LSTag> with, you can use a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">reaction</LSTag> to add your <LSTag Tooltip="ProficiencyBonus">Proficiency Bonus</LSTag> to your <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourClass">Armour Class</LSTag>, possibly causing the attack to miss.
passive:DefensiveDuelist.name: Defensive Duellist

passive:DeflectMissiles.description:
Use your reaction to reduce the damage from a ranged weapon attack by 1d10 + your Dexterity Modifier + your monk level.

If the damage is reduced to 0, you use a Ki Point to Deflect the Missile.
passive:DeflectMissiles.name: Deflect Missiles

passive:DestroyUndead.description: When you successfully <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_TurnUndead">Turn</LSTag> an undead creature, it also takes [1].
passive:DestroyUndead.name: Destroy Undead

passive:DestructiveWrath.description: When you roll Thunder or Lightning damage, you can use your <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ChannelDivinity">Channel Divinity</LSTag> to deal maximum damage instead.
passive:DestructiveWrath.name: Destructive Wrath

passive:DevilsSight.description: You can see normally in darkness, both magical and non-magical, to a distance of [1].
passive:DevilsSight.name: Devil's Sight

passive:DisarmingAttack.description: Spend a superiority die to make an attack that deals an additional [1] damage and possibly forces the target to drop the weapons they are holding.
passive:DisarmingAttack.name: Disarming Attack

passive:DiscipleOfLife.description: Your devotion empowers your healing spells. When casting a healing spell, the target regains additional <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">hit points</LSTag> equal to 2 + the spell's level.
passive:DiscipleOfLife.name: Disciple of Life

passive:DistractingStrike.description: <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DISTRACTED">Distract</LSTag> your target, giving your allies <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on their next <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> against the target.
passive:DistractingStrike.name: Distracting Strike

passive:DivineAllegiance.description: When an ally within [1] of you takes damage, you can use your reaction to magically substitute your own health for your ally's, taking the damage instead of them.
passive:DivineAllegiance.name: Divine Allegiance

passive:DivineHealth.description: The divine magic flowing within you prevents disease from affecting you.
passive:DivineHealth.name: Divine Health

passive:DivineIntervention.description: You can cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_DivineIntervention">Divine Intervention</LSTag> to invoke your God's aid. Once used, this can never be used again.
passive:DivineIntervention.name: Divine Intervention

passive:DomainSpells.description: You gain spells from your domain. They are <LSTag Tooltip="AlwaysPrepared">Always Prepared</LSTag>.
passive:DomainSpells.name: Domain Spells

passive:DraconicAncestry_Black.description: At Level 6, spells that deal Acid damage are more powerful, and you can become resistant to Acid damage.
passive:DraconicAncestry_Black.name: Draconic Ancestry: Black (Acid)

passive:DraconicAncestry_Blue.description: At Level 6, spells that deal Lightning damage are more powerful, and you can become resistant to Lightning damage.
passive:DraconicAncestry_Blue.name: Draconic Ancestry: Blue (Lightning)

passive:DraconicAncestry_Brass.description: At Level 6, spells that deal Fire damage are more powerful, and you can become resistant to Fire damage.
passive:DraconicAncestry_Brass.name: Draconic Ancestry: Brass (Fire)

passive:DraconicAncestry_Bronze.description: At Level 6, spells that deal Lightning damage are more powerful, and you can become resistant to Lightning damage.
passive:DraconicAncestry_Bronze.name: Draconic Ancestry: Bronze (Lightning)

passive:DraconicAncestry_Copper.description: At Level 6, spells that deal Acid damage are more powerful, and you can become resistant to Acid damage.
passive:DraconicAncestry_Copper.name: Draconic Ancestry: Copper (Acid)

passive:DraconicAncestry_Gold.description: At Level 6, spells that deal Fire damage are more powerful, and you can become resistant to Fire damage.
passive:DraconicAncestry_Gold.name: Draconic Ancestry: Gold (Fire)

passive:DraconicAncestry_Green.description: At Level 6, spells that deal Poison damage are more powerful, and you can become resistant to Poison damage.
passive:DraconicAncestry_Green.name: Draconic Ancestry: Green (Poison)

passive:DraconicAncestry_Red.description: At Level 6, spells that deal Fire damage are more powerful, and you can become resistant to Fire damage.
passive:DraconicAncestry_Red.name: Draconic Ancestry: Red (Fire)

passive:DraconicAncestry_Silver.description: At Level 6, spells that deal Cold damage are more powerful, and you can become resistant to Cold damage.
passive:DraconicAncestry_Silver.name: Draconic Ancestry: Silver (Cold)

passive:DraconicAncestry_White.description: At Level 6, spells that deal Cold damage are more powerful, and you can become resistant to Cold damage.
passive:DraconicAncestry_White.name: Draconic Ancestry: White (Cold)

passive:DraconicResilience.description: Dragon-like scales cover parts of your skin. When you aren't wearing armour, your base <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourClass">Armour Class</LSTag> is 13.
passive:DraconicResilience.name: Draconic Resilience

passive:Dragonborn_Resistance_Acid.description: The blood of ancient dragons flows through your veins. You are <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistant</LSTag> to Acid damage.
passive:Dragonborn_Resistance_Acid.name: Draconic Ancestry

passive:Dragonborn_Resistance_Cold.description: The blood of ancient dragons flows through your veins. You are <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistant</LSTag> to Cold damage.
passive:Dragonborn_Resistance_Cold.name: Draconic Ancestry

passive:Dragonborn_Resistance_Fire.description: The blood of ancient dragons flows through your veins. You are <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistant</LSTag> to Fire damage.
passive:Dragonborn_Resistance_Fire.name: Draconic Ancestry

passive:Dragonborn_Resistance_Lightning.description: The blood of ancient dragons flows through your veins. You are <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistant</LSTag> to Lightning damage.
passive:Dragonborn_Resistance_Lightning.name: Draconic Ancestry

passive:Dragonborn_Resistance_Poison.description: The blood of ancient dragons flows through your veins. You are <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistant</LSTag> to Poison damage.
passive:Dragonborn_Resistance_Poison.name: Draconic Ancestry

passive:DreadAmbusher.description:
You specialise in taking out foes swiftly and ruthlessly.

You gain a +[1] bonus to Initiative.

On the first turn of combat, your movement speed increases by [2], and you can make an attack that deals an additional [3] damage.
passive:DreadAmbusher.name: Dread Ambusher

passive:DreadfulWord.description: You can cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Confusion">Confusion</LSTag> with a <LSTag Tooltip="WarlockSpellSlot">Warlock spell slot</LSTag>.
passive:DreadfulWord.name: Dreadful Word

passive:Drow_DrowWeaponTraining.description: You have <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> with the Rapier, Shortsword, and Hand Crossbow.
passive:Drow_DrowWeaponTraining.name: Drow Weapon Training

passive:DrunkardsLuck.description: When you make an <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Ability Check</LSTag>, <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag>, or <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throw</LSTag> and have Disadvantage on the roll, you can spend 2 <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="KiPoint">Ki Points</LSTag> to negate the Disadvantage for that roll.
passive:DrunkardsLuck.name: Drunkard's Luck

passive:DualWielder_BonusAC.description: You have a +1 bonus to <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourClass">Armour Class</LSTag> while wielding a melee weapon in each hand.
passive:DualWielder_BonusAC.name: Dual Wielder: Bonus Armour Class

passive:DualWielder_PassiveBonuses.description: You can use Two-Weapon Fighting even if the weapons you are wielding aren't Light. You cannot dual-wield <LSTag Tooltip="TwoHanded">Two-Handed</LSTag> weapons.
passive:DualWielder_PassiveBonuses.name: Dual Wielder

passive:Duergar_DuergarResilience.description: You have <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag> against illusions and against being Charmed or Paralysed.
passive:Duergar_DuergarResilience.name: Duergar Resilience

passive:DungeonDelver_Perception.description: You have <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on Perception <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Checks</LSTag> made to detect hidden objects.
passive:DungeonDelver_Perception.name: Dungeon Delver: Perception

passive:DungeonDelver_ResistTraps.description: You have <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag> made to avoid traps and <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistance</LSTag> to trap damage.
passive:DungeonDelver_ResistTraps.name: Dungeon Delver: Resist Traps

passive:Durable.description: You regain full <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">hit points</LSTag> when you <LSTag Tooltip="ShortRest">Short Rest</LSTag>. Your <LSTag Tooltip="Constitution">Constitution</LSTag> score is increased by 1, to a maximum of 20.
passive:Durable.name: Durable

passive:Dwarf_DwarvenCombatTraining.description: You have <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> with the Battleaxe, Handaxe, Light Hammer, and Warhammer.
passive:Dwarf_DwarvenCombatTraining.name: Dwarven Combat Training

passive:Dwarf_DwarvenResilience.description: You have <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag> against Poison, and you have Resistance against Poison damage.
passive:Dwarf_DwarvenResilience.name: Dwarven Resilience

passive:EldritchStrike.description: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, it has <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag> on its next <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throw</LSTag> against a spell you cast before the end of your next turn.
passive:EldritchStrike.name: Eldritch Strike

passive:ElementalAdept_Acid.description: Spells you cast and attacks you make ignore <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistance</LSTag> to Acid damage. In addition, when you deal Acid damage with a spell, you cannot roll a [1].
passive:ElementalAdept_Acid.name: Elemental Adept: Acid

passive:ElementalAdept_Cold.description: Spells you cast and attacks you make ignore <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistance</LSTag> to Cold damage. In addition, when you deal Cold damage with a spell, you cannot roll a [1].
passive:ElementalAdept_Cold.name: Elemental Adept: Cold

passive:ElementalAdept_Fire.description: Spells you cast and attacks you make ignore <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistance</LSTag> to Fire damage. In addition, when you deal Fire damage with a spell, you cannot roll a [1].
passive:ElementalAdept_Fire.name: Elemental Adept: Fire

passive:ElementalAdept_Lightning.description: Spells you cast and attacks you make ignore <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistance</LSTag> to Lightning damage. In addition, when you deal Lightning damage with a spell, you cannot roll a [1].
passive:ElementalAdept_Lightning.name: Elemental Adept: Lightning

passive:ElementalAdept_Thunder.description: Spells you cast and attacks you make ignore <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistance</LSTag> to Thunder damage. In addition, when you deal Thunder damage with a spell, you cannot roll a [1].
passive:ElementalAdept_Thunder.name: Elemental Adept: Thunder

passive:ElementalAffinity_Damage.description: When you cast a spell that deals damage of the type associated with your draconic ancestry, you add your Charisma <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">Modifier</LSTag> to the damage.
passive:ElementalAffinity_Damage.name: Elemental Affinity: Damage

passive:ElementalAffinity_Resistance_Che.description: When you cast a spell that deals damage of the type associated with your draconic ancestry, you can spend 1 <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="SorceryPoint">Sorcery Point</LSTag> to gain <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistance</LSTag> to that damage type.
passive:ElementalAffinity_Resistance_Che.name: Elemental Affinity: Resistance

passive:Elf_WeaponTraining.description: You have <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> with the Longsword, Shortsword, Shortbow, and Longbow.
passive:Elf_WeaponTraining.name: Elven Weapon Training

passive:EmpoweredEvocation.description: Your grasp of Evocation magic has tightened, and you can add your Intelligence <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">Modifier</LSTag> to damage rolls with any Evocation spells.
passive:EmpoweredEvocation.name: Empowered Evocation

passive:EntropicWard.description:
As a reaction, you can impose Disadvantage on an Attack Roll against you.

If the attack misses, you gain Advantage on your next Attack Roll against your attacker for 1 turn.
passive:EntropicWard.name: Entropic Ward

passive:Evasion.description:
Your agility lets you dodge out of the way of certain spells.

When a spell or effect would deal half damage on a successful Dexterity Saving Throw, it deals no damage if you succeed, and only half damage if you fail.
passive:Evasion.name: Evasion

passive:EvasiveFootwork.description: You can evade attacks by imposing <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag> on melee attacks against you for a round.
passive:EvasiveFootwork.name: Evasive Footwork

passive:ExceptionalTraining.description: Your animal companion can <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_Dash">Dash</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_Disengage">Disengage</LSTag>, and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Help">Help</LSTag> as a bonus action.
passive:ExceptionalTraining.name: Exceptional Training

passive:ExperimentalAlchemy.description: You can brew two alchemical solutions instead of one when combining extracts, if you succeed a <LSTag Tooltip="DifficultyClass">DC</LSTag> [1] Medicine <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Check</LSTag>.
passive:ExperimentalAlchemy.name: Experimental Alchemy

passive:ExpertDivination.description: You may gain an additional <LSTag Tooltip="PortentDie">Portent Die</LSTag>: when taking a <LSTag Tooltip="ShortRest">Short Rest</LSTag> you receive a Prophecy. Complete it to regain a missing Portent Die.
passive:ExpertDivination.name: Expert Divination

passive:ExtraAttack.description: Can make an additional free attack after making an unarmed or weapon attack. If you gain the Extra Attack feature from more than one class, they don't add together.
passive:ExtraAttack.name: Extra Attack

passive:ExtraAttack_2.description: You can make two additional attacks after attacking with your main-hand weapon.
passive:ExtraAttack_2.name: Improved Extra Attack

passive:EyesOfTheDark.description: You can see in the dark up to [1].
passive:EyesOfTheDark.name: Eyes of the Dark

passive:FancyFootwork.description: If you make a melee attack against a target, that target can't make <LSTag Tooltip="OpportunityAttack">Opportunity Attacks</LSTag> against you for the rest of your turn.
passive:FancyFootwork.name: Fancy Footwork

passive:FastMovement.description: <LSTag Tooltip="MovementSpeed">Movement speed</LSTag> increased by [1] while not wearing Heavy Armour.
passive:FastMovement.name: Fast Movement

passive:FavoredEnemy_BountyHunter.description: You gain <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> in Investigation. Creatures you hit with Ensnaring Strike (either <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_EnsnaringStrike">ranged</LSTag> or <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_EnsnaringStrike">melee</LSTag>) have <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag> on their <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throw</LSTag>.
passive:FavoredEnemy_BountyHunter.name: Bounty Hunter

passive:FavoredEnemy_KeeperOfTheVeil.description: You specialise in hunting creatures from other planes of existence. You gain <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> in <LSTag Tooltip="Arcana">Arcana</LSTag>, and can cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_ProtectionFromEvilAndGood">Protection from Evil and Good</LSTag>.
passive:FavoredEnemy_KeeperOfTheVeil.name: Keeper of the Veil

passive:FavoredEnemy_MageBreaker.description: You have a history of battling spellcasters. You gain <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> in <LSTag Tooltip="Arcana">Arcana</LSTag> and can cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_TrueStrike">True Strike</LSTag>.
passive:FavoredEnemy_MageBreaker.name: Mage Breaker

passive:FavoredEnemy_RangerKnight.description: You have sworn to serve a crown or nation and seek to bring its foes to ruin. Gain <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Skill Proficiency</LSTag> in <LSTag Tooltip="History">History</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourProficiency">Armour Proficiency</LSTag> with Heavy Armour.
passive:FavoredEnemy_RangerKnight.name: Ranger Knight

passive:FavoredEnemy_SanctifiedStalker.description: You swore to hunt the enemies of a holy or druidic order. You gain <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> in <LSTag Tooltip="Religion">Religion</LSTag> and can cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_SacredFlame">Sacred Flame</LSTag>.
passive:FavoredEnemy_SanctifiedStalker.name: Sanctified Stalker

passive:FeintingAttack.description: You can use both your action and bonus action on a turn to attack a target with <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> and deal an additional [1] damage.
passive:FeintingAttack.name: Feinting Attack

passive:FeralInstinct.description: You have honed your instincts to the utmost degree. You gain a +[1] bonus to Initiative and can't be <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SURPRISED">Surprised</LSTag>.
passive:FeralInstinct.name: Feral Instinct

passive:FeyAncestry.description: You have <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag> against being Charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.
passive:FeyAncestry.name: Fey Ancestry

passive:FiendishResilience.description: Choose a damage type and become <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistant</LSTag> to it. You can pick a new damage type each <LSTag Tooltip="ShortRest">Short Rest</LSTag>.
passive:FiendishResilience.name: Fiendish Resilience

passive:FiendishVigor.description: You can cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_FalseLife">False Life</LSTag> on yourself at will as a Level 1 spell without expending a <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">spell slot</LSTag>.
passive:FiendishVigor.name: Fiendish Vigour

passive:FightingStyle_Archery.description: You gain a +2 bonus to <LSTag Tooltip="RangedWeaponAttack">ranged weapon attacks</LSTag>.
passive:FightingStyle_Archery.name: Archery

passive:FightingStyle_Defense.description: You gain a +1 bonus to <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourClass">Armour Class</LSTag> while wearing armour.
passive:FightingStyle_Defense.name: Defence

passive:FightingStyle_Dueling.description: When you are wielding a melee weapon that is not Two-Handed in one hand, and no weapon in the other, you deal an additional 2 damage with that weapon.
passive:FightingStyle_Dueling.name: Duelling

passive:FightingStyle_GreatWeaponFightin.description: When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die for an attack with a <LSTag Tooltip="TwoHanded">two-handed</LSTag> melee weapon, that die is rerolled once.
passive:FightingStyle_GreatWeaponFightin.name: Great Weapon Fighting

passive:FightingStyle_Protection.description: When you have a shield, impose <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag> on an attack against your allies when you are within [1]. You must be able to see the attacker.
passive:FightingStyle_Protection.name: Protection

passive:FightingStyle_TwoWeaponFighting.description: When you make an <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">attack</LSTag> with your off-hand weapon, you can add your <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">Ability Modifier</LSTag> to the damage of the attack.
passive:FightingStyle_TwoWeaponFighting.name: Two-Weapon Fighting

passive:FocusedConjuration.description: Damage taken while you are <LSTag Tooltip="Concentration">Concentrating</LSTag> on a Conjuration spell will not break your Concentration.
passive:FocusedConjuration.name: Focused Conjuration

passive:FontOfInspiration.description: You regain all your <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="BardicInspiration">Bardic Inspiration</LSTag> after a <LSTag Tooltip="LongRest">Long</LSTag> or <LSTag Tooltip="ShortRest">Short Rest</LSTag>.
passive:FontOfInspiration.name: Font of Inspiration

passive:GiantKiller.description: If a Large or bigger creature attacks you, you can use your reaction to make a melee attack.
passive:GiantKiller.name: Giant Killer

passive:Giants_CarryCapacity.description: Your <LSTag Tooltip="CarryWeight">carrying capacity</LSTag> is increased by a quarter.
passive:Giants_CarryCapacity.name: Vaprak's Greed

passive:Gith_MartialProdigy.description: A lifetime of relentless training gave you <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourProficiency">Armour Proficiency</LSTag> with Light and Medium Armour, as well as <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> with the Shortsword, Longsword, and Greatsword.
passive:Gith_MartialProdigy.name: Martial Prodigy

passive:Gnome_Cunning.description: You have <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag>.
passive:Gnome_Cunning.name: Gnome Cunning

passive:GoadingAttack.description: Deal an additional [1] and attempt to goad the target into attacking you. Target receives <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag> on attacking any other creature.
passive:GoadingAttack.name: Goading Attack

passive:GreatWeaponMaster_BonusAttack.description: When you land a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag> or kill a target with a <LSTag Tooltip="MeleeWeaponAttack">melee weapon attack</LSTag>, you can make another melee weapon attack as a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="BonusActionPoint">bonus action</LSTag> that turn.
passive:GreatWeaponMaster_BonusAttack.name: Great Weapon Master: Bonus Attack

passive:GreatWeaponMaster_BonusDamage.description: When attacking with a melee weapon you are <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficient</LSTag> with and are wielding in both hands, <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> take a -5 penalty, but their damage increases by 10.
passive:GreatWeaponMaster_BonusDamage.name: Great Weapon Master: All In

passive:GrimHarvest.description: Once per turn, if you kill a creature with a spell, you regain hit points equal to twice the spell slot level used - thrice if it's a Necromancy spell. Undead and constructs are unaffected.
passive:GrimHarvest.name: Grim Harvest

passive:Halfling_Brave.description: You have <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag> against being Frightened.
passive:Halfling_Brave.name: Brave

passive:Halfling_LightfootStealth.description: You have <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on Stealth <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Checks</LSTag>.
passive:Halfling_LightfootStealth.name: Naturally Stealthy

passive:Halfling_Lucky.description: When you roll a 1 on an <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag>, <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Ability Check</LSTag>, or <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throw</LSTag>, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.
passive:Halfling_Lucky.name: Halfling Luck

passive:Halfling_StoutResilience.description: You have <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag> against Poison and Resistance to Poison damage.
passive:Halfling_StoutResilience.name: Strongheart Resilience

passive:HeartOfTheStorm.description: When you cast a spell of Level 1 or higher that deals Lightning or Thunder damage, you cause a small, local storm. All enemies within [2] take [1] or [3].
passive:HeartOfTheStorm.name: Heart of the Storm

passive:HeartOfTheStorm_Resistance.description: You are <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistant</LSTag> to Lightning and Thunder damage.
passive:HeartOfTheStorm_Resistance.name: Heart of the Storm: Resistance

passive:HeavilyArmored.description: You have <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourProficiency">Armour Proficiency</LSTag> with Heavy Armour and your <LSTag Tooltip="Strength">Strength</LSTag> increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
passive:HeavilyArmored.name: Heavily Armoured

passive:HeavyArmorMaster.description: Increase your <LSTag Tooltip="Strength">Strength</LSTag> score by [1] (up to a maximum of [2]), and reduce incoming damage from non-magical attacks by [3].
passive:HeavyArmorMaster.name: Heavy Armour Master

passive:HexWarrior.description:
You gain proficiency with Medium Armour, Shields, and Martial Weapons.

You gain Bind Hexed Weapon, which lets you use your Charisma modifier instead of Strength or Dexterity when attacking with weapons that you are proficient with.
passive:HexWarrior.name: Hex Warrior

passive:HordeBreaker.description: Target two creatures standing close to each other, attacking them in quick succession.
passive:HordeBreaker.name: Horde Breaker

passive:HumanMilitia.description: You have <LSTag Tooltip="WeaponProficiency">Weapon Proficiency</LSTag> with spears, pikes, halberds, and glaives, and <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourProficiency">Armour Proficiency</LSTag> with Light Armour and Shields.
passive:HumanMilitia.name: Civil Militia

passive:HumanVersatility.description: Select an additional <LSTag Tooltip="Skill">Skill</LSTag> to be <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficient</LSTag> in. Your carrying capacity is increased by a quarter.
passive:HumanVersatility.name: Human Versatility

passive:HuntersMark_Swarmkeeper.description: Your swarm deals additional damage to creatures marked by your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_HuntersMark">Hunter's Mark</LSTag>.
passive:HuntersMark_Swarmkeeper.name: Prey's Scent

passive:IllusorySelf.description: You can magically fashion an illusory duplicate of yourself when attacked, causing your foe to automatically miss that attack.
passive:IllusorySelf.name: Illusory Self

passive:ImprovedAbjuration.description: Each time you take a <LSTag Tooltip="ShortRest">Short Rest</LSTag>, the intensity of your <LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="ArcaneWard">Arcane Ward</LSTag> increases by an amount equal to your wizard level.
passive:ImprovedAbjuration.name: Improved Abjuration

passive:ImprovedCombatSuperiority.description: The size of your <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="SuperiorityDie">Superiority Dice</LSTag> increases to 1d10.
passive:ImprovedCombatSuperiority.name: Improved Combat Superiority

passive:ImprovedCritical.description: The number you need to <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">roll</LSTag> a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag> while attacking is reduced by 1. This effect can stack.
passive:ImprovedCritical.name: Improved Critical Hit

passive:ImprovedDivineSmite.description:
Your attacks are suffused with divine might.

Melee weapon attacks deal an additional [1].
passive:ImprovedDivineSmite.name: Improved Divine Smite

passive:ImprovedElementalCasting.description: Your affinity with elemental ki deepens. Several of your offensive Four Elements features deal an additional dice of damage, your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_HoldPerson_Monk">Clench of the North Wind</LSTag> can hold an additional creature, and your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_ScorchingRay_Monk">Embrace of the Inferno</LSTag> fires an extra ray.
passive:ImprovedElementalCasting.name: Improved Elemental Casting

passive:ImprovedMinorIllusion.description: You can cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_ImprovedMinorIllusion">Minor Illusion</LSTag> as a bonus action.
passive:ImprovedMinorIllusion.name: Improved Minor Illusion

passive:Indomitable.description: You have become as durable as an iron golem. Whenever you fail a <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throw</LSTag>, you can roll again, using the new result instead.
passive:Indomitable.name: Indomitable

passive:InescapableDestruction.description: Spells you cast ignore <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistance</LSTag> to Necrotic damage.
passive:InescapableDestruction.name: Inescapable Destruction

passive:InstinctiveCharm.description: <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="CHARMED">Charm</LSTag> an enemy attacking you. They will attack a new target if possible as a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">reaction</LSTag>.
passive:InstinctiveCharm.name: Instinctive Charm

passive:InuredtoUndeath.description: You have steeped yourself so completely in death that you are <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistant</LSTag> to Necrotic damage, and moreover your <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">hit point</LSTag> maximum cannot be reduced.
passive:InuredtoUndeath.name: Inured to Undeath

passive:IronMind.description: You have honed your ability to resist the mind-altering powers of your prey. You gain <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> in Wisdom and Intelligence <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag>.
passive:IronMind.name: Iron Mind

passive:JackOfAllTrades.description: Your vast experiences make you more likely to succeed in any undertaking. Add half of your <LSTag Tooltip="ProficiencyBonus">Proficiency Bonus</LSTag> (rounded down) to <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Ability Checks</LSTag> that you are not <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficient</LSTag> in.
passive:JackOfAllTrades.name: Jack of All Trades

passive:KiEmpoweredStrikes.description: Your unarmed attacks count as magical for the purpose of overcoming enemies' <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistance</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immunity</LSTag> to non-magical damage.
passive:KiEmpoweredStrikes.name: Ki-Empowered Strikes

passive:Land_Arctic.description: Gain <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_HoldPerson">Hold Person</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_SpikeGrowth">Spike Growth</LSTag>.
passive:Land_Arctic.name: Arctic

passive:Land_Arctic_2.description: Gain <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_SleetStorm">Sleet Storm</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Haste">Haste</LSTag>.
passive:Land_Arctic_2.name: Arctic

passive:Land_Arctic_3.description: You can cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_ConjureElementals_Minor_Container">Conjure Minor Elemental</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_IceStorm">Ice Storm</LSTag>.
passive:Land_Arctic_3.name: Arctic

passive:Land_Arctic_4.description: You can cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Zone_ConeOfCold">Cone of Cold</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Contagion">Contagion</LSTag>.
passive:Land_Arctic_4.name: Arctic

passive:Land_Coast.description: Gain <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_MirrorImage">Mirror Image</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_MistyStep">Misty Step</LSTag>.
passive:Land_Coast.name: Coast

passive:Land_Coast_2.description: Gain <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_SleetStorm">Sleet Storm</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_CallLightning">Call Lightning</LSTag>.
passive:Land_Coast_2.name: Coast

passive:Land_Coast_3.description: You can cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_FreedomOfMovement">Freedom of Movement</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Confusion">Confusion</LSTag>.
passive:Land_Coast_3.name: Coast

passive:Land_Coast_4.description: You can cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_ConjureElemental_Container">Conjure Elemental</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_GreaterRestoration">Greater Restoration</LSTag>.
passive:Land_Coast_4.name: Coast

passive:Land_Desert.description: Gain <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_Blur">Blur</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Silence">Silence</LSTag>.
passive:Land_Desert.name: Desert

passive:Land_Desert_2.description: Gain <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_ProtectionFromEnergy">Protection from Energy</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_HypnoticPattern">Hypnotic Pattern</LSTag>.
passive:Land_Desert_2.name: Desert

passive:Land_Desert_3.description: You can cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Blight">Blight</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Wall_WallOfFire">Wall of Fire</LSTag>.
passive:Land_Desert_3.name: Desert

passive:Land_Desert_4.description: You can cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Wall_WallOfStone">Wall of Stone</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_InsectPlague">Insect Plague</LSTag>.
passive:Land_Desert_4.name: Desert

passive:Land_Forest.description: Gain <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Barkskin">Barkskin</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_HoldPerson">Hold Person</LSTag>.
passive:Land_Forest.name: Forest

passive:Land_Forest_2.description: Gain <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_CallLightning">Call Lighting</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_PlantGrowth">Plant Growth</LSTag>.
passive:Land_Forest_2.name: Forest

passive:Land_Forest_3.description: You can cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_ConjureElementals_Minor_Container">Conjure Minor Elemental</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_GraspingVine">Grasping Vine</LSTag>.
passive:Land_Forest_3.name: Forest

passive:Land_Forest_4.description: You can cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_CureWounds_Mass">Mass Cure Wounds</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Contagion">Contagion</LSTag>.
passive:Land_Forest_4.name: Forest
