passive:Land_Grassland.description: Gain <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Invisibility">Invisibility</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_PassWithoutTrace">Pass Without Trace</LSTag>.
passive:Land_Grassland.name: Grassland

passive:Land_Grassland_3.description: You can cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_FreedomOfMovement">Freedom of Movement</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Polymorph">Polymorph</LSTag>.
passive:Land_Grassland_3.name: Grassland

passive:Land_Grassland_4.description: You can cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_GreaterRestoration">Greater Restoration</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_InsectPlague">Insect Plague</LSTag>.
passive:Land_Grassland_4.name: Grassland

passive:Land_Mountain.description: Gain <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_MirrorImage">Mirror Image</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_SpikeGrowth">Spike Growth</LSTag>.
passive:Land_Mountain.name: Mountain

passive:Land_Mountain_2.description: Gain <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Zone_LightningBolt">Lightning Bolt</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Fly">Flight</LSTag>.
passive:Land_Mountain_2.name: Mountain

passive:Land_Mountain_3.description: You can cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Stoneskin">Stoneskin</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_DominateBeast">Dominate Beast</LSTag>.
passive:Land_Mountain_3.name: Mountain

passive:Land_Mountain_4.description: You can cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Wall_WallOfStone">Wall of Stone</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_ConjureElemental_Container">Conjure Elemental</LSTag>.
passive:Land_Mountain_4.name: Mountain

passive:Land_Swamp.description: Gain <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_AcidArrow">Melf's Acid Arrow</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Darkness">Darkness</LSTag>.
passive:Land_Swamp.name: Swamp

passive:Land_Swamp_2.description: Gain <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_StinkingCloud">Stinking Cloud</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_VampiricTouch">Vampiric Touch</LSTag>.
passive:Land_Swamp_2.name: Swamp

passive:Land_Swamp_3.description: You can cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Blight">Blight</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_GraspingVine">Grasping Vine</LSTag>.
passive:Land_Swamp_3.name: Swamp

passive:Land_Swamp_4.description: You can cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_InsectPlague">Insect Plague</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Cloudkill">Cloudkill</LSTag>.
passive:Land_Swamp_4.name: Swamp

passive:Land_Underdark.description: Gain <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Web">Web</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_MistyStep">Misty Step</LSTag>.
passive:Land_Underdark.name: Underdark

passive:Land_Underdark_2.description: Gain <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_GaseousForm">Gaseous Form</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_StinkingCloud">Stinking Cloud</LSTag>.
passive:Land_Underdark_2.name: Underdark

passive:Land_Underdark_3.description: You can cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Invisibility_Greater">Greater Invisibility</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_DominateBeast">Dominate Beast</LSTag>.
passive:Land_Underdark_3.name: Underdark

passive:Land_Underdark_4.description: You can cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Contagion">Contagion</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Cloudkill">Cloudkill</LSTag>.
passive:Land_Underdark_4.name: Underdark

passive:LandsStride_Advantage.description:
You have become an expert at moving through the wilderness.

You have Advantage on Saving Throws against plants that are magically created to impede your movement.
passive:LandsStride_Advantage.name: Land's Stride: Advantage

passive:LandsStride_DifficultTerrain.description: You have become an expert at moving through the wilderness. <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DIFFICULT_TERRAIN">Difficult Terrain</LSTag> no longer slows you down.
passive:LandsStride_DifficultTerrain.name: Land's Stride: Difficult Terrain

passive:LandsStride_Surfaces.description:
You have become an expert at moving through the wilderness.

Plant-based surfaces with thorns, spines, or similar hazards no longer harm you.
passive:LandsStride_Surfaces.name: Land's Stride: Plants

passive:LeapToYourFeet.description: When you are <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="PRONE">Prone</LSTag>, standing up uses only [1] of your <LSTag Tooltip="MovementSpeed">movement speed</LSTag>.
passive:LeapToYourFeet.name: Leap to Your Feet

passive:LifeOfTheParty.description: Every time <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_IntoxicatingStrike">Intoxicating Strike</LSTag> hits, the monk gains <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="LIFE_OF_THE_PARTY">Life of the Party</LSTag>, which increases <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourClass">Armour Class</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> against <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DRUNK">Drunk</LSTag> targets.
passive:LifeOfTheParty.name: Life of the Party

passive:Lifedrinker.description: Attacks made with your weapon deal additional Necrotic damage equal to your <LSTag Tooltip="Charisma">Charisma</LSTag> modifier.
passive:Lifedrinker.name: Lifedrinker

passive:LightlyArmored.description: You have <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourProficiency">Armour Proficiency</LSTag> with Light Armour.
passive:LightlyArmored.name: Lightly Armoured

passive:Lucky.description: You can use a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="LuckPoint">Luck Point</LSTag> to gain <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on your next <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Ability Check</LSTag>.
passive:Lucky.name: Lucky

passive:Lucky_Unlock.description: You can use a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="LuckPoint">Luck Point</LSTag> to gain <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on your next <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> or <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throw</LSTag>, or to make an enemy reroll their Attack Roll.
passive:Lucky_Unlock.name: Lucky

passive:MageHandLegerdemain.description: When you cast Mage Hand, the spectral hand is invisible and permanent.
passive:MageHandLegerdemain.name: Mage Hand Legerdemain

passive:MageSlayer_Advantage.description: You have <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag> against spells cast by creatures within [1] of you.
passive:MageSlayer_Advantage.name: Mage Slayer: Saving Throw Advantage

passive:MageSlayer_AttackCaster.description: You can use a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">reaction</LSTag> to make an attack against an enemy after it casts a spell within [1] of you.
passive:MageSlayer_AttackCaster.name: Mage Slayer: Attack Caster

passive:MageSlayer_BreakConcentration.description: Enemies you hit have <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag> when making <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag> to maintain their <LSTag Tooltip="Concentration">Concentration</LSTag>.
passive:MageSlayer_BreakConcentration.name: Mage Slayer: Break Concentration

passive:MagicArrow.description: All of your ranged attacks are considered magical to overcome <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistance</LSTag>.
passive:MagicArrow.name: Magic Arrow

passive:MagicInitiate_Bard.description: You have learnt 2 <LSTag Tooltip="Cantrip">cantrips</LSTag> and a Level 1 spell from the bard spell list.
passive:MagicInitiate_Bard.name: Magic Initiate: Bard

passive:MagicInitiate_Cleric.description: You have learnt 2 <LSTag Tooltip="Cantrip">cantrips</LSTag> and a Level 1 spell from the cleric spell list.
passive:MagicInitiate_Cleric.name: Magic Initiate: Cleric

passive:MagicInitiate_Druid.description: You have learnt 2 <LSTag Tooltip="Cantrip">cantrips</LSTag> and a Level 1 spell from the druid spell list.
passive:MagicInitiate_Druid.name: Magic Initiate: Druid

passive:MagicInitiate_Sorcerer.description: You have learnt 2 <LSTag Tooltip="Cantrip">cantrips</LSTag> and a Level 1 spell from the sorcerer spell list.
passive:MagicInitiate_Sorcerer.name: Magic Initiate: Sorcerer

passive:MagicInitiate_Warlock.description: You have learnt 2 <LSTag Tooltip="Cantrip">cantrips</LSTag> and a Level 1 spell from the warlock spell list.
passive:MagicInitiate_Warlock.name: Magic Initiate: Warlock

passive:MagicInitiate_Wizard.description: You have learnt 2 <LSTag Tooltip="Cantrip">cantrips</LSTag> and a Level 1 spell from the wizard spell list.
passive:MagicInitiate_Wizard.name: Magic Initiate: Wizard

passive:MagicalAmbush.description: While you are <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SNEAKING">Hidden</LSTag>, your targets have <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag> against your spells.
passive:MagicalAmbush.name: Magical Ambush

passive:ManeuveringAttack.description: Spend a superiority die to make an attack that deals an additional [1] damage. On hit, select which friendly creature will gain half its movement speed. It will not provoke attacks of opportunity.
passive:ManeuveringAttack.name: Manoeuvring Attack

passive:Manifestation_of_Body.description: Your hands sap the ki from your enemies' bodies. Your unarmed attacks deal an additional [1].
passive:Manifestation_of_Body.name: Manifestation of Body

passive:Manifestation_of_Mind.description: Your strikes interrupt the ki flow to your enemies' minds. Your unarmed attacks deal an additional [1].
passive:Manifestation_of_Mind.name: Manifestation of Mind

passive:Manifestation_of_Soul.description: Infuse your strikes with ki from outside your body. Your unarmed attacks deal an additional [1].
passive:Manifestation_of_Soul.name: Manifestation of Soul

passive:MantleOfInspiration_Unlock.description: Imbue [1] allies with your vigour and grant them [2]. If they're hit with a melee attack, the attacker becomes <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="CHARMED">Charmed</LSTag>.
passive:MantleOfInspiration_Unlock.name: Mantle of Inspiration

passive:MartialArts_BonusUnarmedStrike.description: After making an attack with a <LSTag Tooltip="MonkWeapon">Monk Weapon</LSTag> or while unarmed, you can make another unarmed attack as a bonus action.
passive:MartialArts_BonusUnarmedStrike.name: Martial Arts: Bonus Unarmed Strike

passive:MartialArts_DextrousUnarmedAttac.description: Attacks with <LSTag Tooltip="MonkWeapon">Monk Weapons</LSTag> and unarmed attacks scale with your <LSTag Tooltip="Dexterity">Dexterity</LSTag> instead of your <LSTag Tooltip="Strength">Strength</LSTag> if your Dexterity is higher.
passive:MartialArts_DextrousUnarmedAttac.name: Martial Arts: Dextrous Attacks

passive:MartialArts_UnarmedDamage.description: Attacks with <LSTag Tooltip="MonkWeapon">Monk Weapons</LSTag> and unarmed attacks deal [1], unless their normal damage is higher.
passive:MartialArts_UnarmedDamage.name: Martial Arts: Deft Strikes

passive:MaskOfManyFaces.description: You can cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_DisguiseSelf">Disguise Self</LSTag> at will, without expending a <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">spell slot</LSTag>.
passive:MaskOfManyFaces.name: Mask of Many Faces

passive:MediumArmorMaster.description: When you wear Medium Armour, it doesn't impose <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag> on Stealth <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Checks</LSTag>. The bonus to <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourClass">Armour Class</LSTag> you can gain from your Dexterity <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">Modifier</LSTag> also becomes +[1] instead of +[2].
passive:MediumArmorMaster.name: Medium Armour Master

passive:MenacingAttack.description: Spend a superiority die to make an attack that deals an additional [1] damage and possibly <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="FRIGHTENED">Frightens</LSTag> the target.
passive:MenacingAttack.name: Menacing Attack

passive:Metamagic_Careful.description:
Allies automatically succeed Saving Throws against spells that require them.

Costs [1] Sorcery Point per spell.
passive:Metamagic_Careful.name: Metamagic: Careful Spell

passive:Metamagic_Distant.description:
Increase the range of spells by 50%. Melee spells get a range of [3].

Costs [1] Sorcery Point per spell.
passive:Metamagic_Distant.name: Metamagic: Distant Spell

passive:Metamagic_Extended.description:
Double the duration of conditions, summons, and surfaces caused by spells.

Costs [1] Sorcery Point per spell.
passive:Metamagic_Extended.name: Metamagic: Extended Spell

passive:Metamagic_Heightened.description:
Targets of spells that require Saving Throws have Disadvantage on their first Saving Throw.

Costs [1] Sorcery Points per spell.
passive:Metamagic_Heightened.name: Metamagic: Heightened Spell

passive:Metamagic_Quickened.description:
Spells that cost an action cost a bonus action instead.

Costs [1] Sorcery Points per spell.
passive:Metamagic_Quickened.name: Metamagic: Quickened Spell

passive:Metamagic_Subtle.description:
You can cast spells while Silenced.

Costs [1] Sorcery Point per spell.
passive:Metamagic_Subtle.name: Metamagic: Subtle Spell

passive:Metamagic_Twinned.description:
Spells that only target 1 creature can target an additional creature.

Costs 1 Sorcery Point per spell slot level used. Cantrips also cost 1 Sorcery Point.
passive:Metamagic_Twinned.name: Metamagic: Twinned Spell

passive:MightySwarm.description: Your swarm has grown stronger. The swarm's regular attack now deals 1d8 damage, its special attack has one additional feature, and teleporting with your swarm now also increases your <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourClass">Armour Class</LSTag> for the rest of the round.
passive:MightySwarm.name: Mighty Swarm

passive:MindlessRage.description:
Your rage becomes all-consuming, repelling outside influence.

While Frenzied, you can't be Charmed or Frightened, and Calm Emotions no longer ends your rage.
passive:MindlessRage.name: Mindless Rage

passive:MinionsOfChaos.description: You can cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_ConjureElemental_Container">Conjure Elemental</LSTag> with a <LSTag Tooltip="WarlockSpellSlot">Warlock spell slot</LSTag>.
passive:MinionsOfChaos.name: Minions of Chaos

passive:MireTheMind.description: You can cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Slow">Slow</LSTag> with a <LSTag Tooltip="WarlockSpellSlot">Warlock spell slot</LSTag>.
passive:MireTheMind.name: Mire the Mind

passive:MistyEscape.description: Upon taking damage, become <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="INVISIBLE">Invisible</LSTag>. On your next turn, you can cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_MistyStep">Misty Step</LSTag>, though this will break your invisibility.
passive:MistyEscape.name: Misty Escape

passive:Mobile_CounterAttackOfOpportunit.description: If you move after making a melee attack, you don't provoke <LSTag Tooltip="OpportunityAttack">Opportunity Attacks</LSTag> from your target.
passive:Mobile_CounterAttackOfOpportunit.name: Mobile: Evade Opportunity Attack

passive:Mobile_DashAcrossDifficultTerrai.description: When you <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_Dash">Dash</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DIFFICULT_TERRAIN">Difficult Terrain</LSTag> doesn't slow you down.
passive:Mobile_DashAcrossDifficultTerrai.name: Mobile: Evade Difficult Terrain

passive:ModeratelyArmored.description: You have <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourProficiency">Armour Proficiency</LSTag> with Medium Armour and shields.
passive:ModeratelyArmored.name: Moderately Armoured

passive:MountainDwarf_DwarvenArmorTraini.description: You have <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourProficiency">Armour Proficiency</LSTag> with Light and Medium Armour.
passive:MountainDwarf_DwarvenArmorTraini.name: Dwarven Armour Training

passive:MultiattackDefense.description: When an enemy attacks you, they have a -[1] penalty to additional <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> against you until the start of their next turn.
passive:MultiattackDefense.name: Multiattack Defence

passive:NaturalExplorer_BeastTamer.description: You have cultivated a strong bond with animals. You can cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_FindFamiliar">Find Familiar</LSTag> without expending a <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">spell slot</LSTag>.
passive:NaturalExplorer_BeastTamer.name: Beast Tamer

passive:NaturalExplorer_UrbanTracker.description: An expert at navigating the wild within the city, you gain <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> in <LSTag Tooltip="SleightOfHand">Sleight of Hand</LSTag>.
passive:NaturalExplorer_UrbanTracker.name: Urban Tracker

passive:NaturalExplorer_WastelandWander_.description: You have spent endless days surviving desolate tundras. You gain <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistance</LSTag> to Cold damage.
passive:NaturalExplorer_WastelandWander_.name: Wasteland Wanderer: Cold

passive:NaturalExplorer_WastelandWander_.description: You have spent endless days surviving forbidding deserts. You gain <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistance</LSTag> to Fire damage.
passive:NaturalExplorer_WastelandWander_.name: Wasteland Wanderer: Fire

passive:NaturalExplorer_WastelandWander_.description: You have spent endless days surviving fetid swamps. You gain <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistance</LSTag> to Poison damage.
passive:NaturalExplorer_WastelandWander_.name: Wasteland Wanderer: Poison

passive:NaturesWard.description: You can't be <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="CHARMED">Charmed</LSTag> or <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="FRIGHTENED">Frightened</LSTag> by elementals and fey. Disease and poison also no longer affect you.
passive:NaturesWard.name: Nature's Ward

passive:Oath_Ancients_Tenents.description:
Oath of the Ancients paladins abide by the following tenets:

Kindle the Light. Through acts of kindness, enkindle the light of hope in the bleakest hollows of despair.

Shelter the Light. Where love blooms, stand against the devilry that would snip its stem.

Preserve Your Own Light. Delight in culture and small joys to preserve the light in your own heart.
passive:Oath_Ancients_Tenents.name: Oath of the Ancients Tenets

passive:Oath_Crown_Tenents.description:
Oath of the Crown paladins abide by the following tenets:

Law. Uphold civilisation and order.

Loyalty. Your word is your bond; without loyalty, oaths and laws are meaningless.

Responsibility. Deal with the consequences of your actions, and fulfill your duties and obligations.
passive:Oath_Crown_Tenents.name: Oath of the Crown Tenets

passive:Oath_Devotion_Tenents.description:
Oath of Devotion paladins abide by the following tenets:

Courage. Stride dauntlessly into action.

Compassion. Show clemency when prudent, and lend your arm to those in need.

Duty. Tend your responsibilities, obey just laws, and support those entrusted to your care.
passive:Oath_Devotion_Tenents.name: Oath of Devotion Tenets

passive:Oath_Vengeance_Tenents.description:
Oath of Vengeance paladins abide by the following tenets:

Fight the Greater Evil. Exerting your wisdom, identify the higher morality in any given instance, and fight for it.

No Mercy for the Wicked. Chasten those who dole out their villainy by wiping their blight from the world forever.
passive:Oath_Vengeance_Tenents.name: Oath of Vengeance Tenets

passive:OneWithShadows.description: You learn how to cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_OneWithShadows">One with Shadows</LSTag>.
passive:OneWithShadows.name: One with Shadows

passive:OtherworldlyLeap.description: You can cast the <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Jump">Enhance Leap</LSTag> spell without expending a <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">spell slot</LSTag>.
passive:OtherworldlyLeap.name: Otherworldly Leap

passive:PactOfTheBlade_Hex.description: You can <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_PactOfTheBlade">Summon</LSTag> a pact weapon, or <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_PactOfTheBlade_Bind">Bind</LSTag> the one you are wielding, making it magical.
passive:PactOfTheBlade_Hex.name: Pact of the Blade

passive:PactOfTheChain.description: Gain the service of a familiar, a fey spirit that takes a form of your choosing. This can be an animal, imp, or quasit.
passive:PactOfTheChain.name: Pact of the Chain

passive:PactOfTheTome.description: Your patron grants you a grimoire called 'The Book of Shadows', which allows you to cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Guidance">Guidance</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_ViciousMockery">Vicious Mockery</LSTag>, and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_ThornWhip">Thorn Whip</LSTag>.
passive:PactOfTheTome.name: Pact of the Tome

passive:Performer.description: You know how to play musical instruments.
passive:Performer.name: Performer

passive:PolearmMaster_AttackOfOpportunit.description: When wielding a glaive, halberd, quarterstaff, or spear, you can make an <LSTag Tooltip="OpportunityAttack">Opportunity Attack</LSTag> when a target comes within range.
passive:PolearmMaster_AttackOfOpportunit.name: Polearm Master: Opportunity Attack

passive:PolearmMaster_BonusAttack.description: When attacking with a glaive, halberd, quarterstaff, or spear, you can use a bonus action to attack with the butt of your weapon and deal [1].
passive:PolearmMaster_BonusAttack.name: Polearm Master: Bonus Attack

passive:Portent.description:
Your dreams grant you glimpses that let you influence the future.

After each Long Rest, you gain two random Portent Dice. During the day, you can use your reaction to change the die of any Attack Roll or Saving Throw rolled near you to one of your Portent Dice.

Each Portent Die can only be used once, and you lose your unused Portent Dice at the end of the day.
passive:Portent.name: Portent

passive:PotentCantrip.description:
Your cantrips become harder to evade entirely.

When a creature succeeds its Saving Throw against one of your cantrips, it still takes half the cantrip's damage, but suffers no additional effects.
passive:PotentCantrip.name: Potent Cantrip

passive:PotentSpellcasting.description: Your god grants you even more intense power. You can add your Wisdom <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">Modifier</LSTag> to the damage you deal with Cleric cantrips.
passive:PotentSpellcasting.name: Potent Spellcasting

passive:PrecisionAttack.description: You can spend a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="SuperiorityDie">Superiority Die</LSTag> to add it to the result to an <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag>.
passive:PrecisionAttack.name: Precision Attack

passive:PrimalStrike.description: While in beast form, your attacks count as magical for the purpose of overcoming <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistance</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immunity</LSTag> to non-magical damage.
passive:PrimalStrike.name: Primal Strike

passive:Proficiency_Battleaxes.description: You add your <LSTag Tooltip="ProficiencyBonus">Proficiency Bonus</LSTag> to <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> with Battleaxes.
passive:Proficiency_Battleaxes.name: Battleaxe Proficiency

passive:Proficiency_Clubs.description: You add your <LSTag Tooltip="ProficiencyBonus">Proficiency Bonus</LSTag> to <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> with Clubs.
passive:Proficiency_Clubs.name: Club Proficiency

passive:Proficiency_Daggers.name: Dagger Proficiency

passive:Proficiency_Glaives.name: Glaive Proficiency

passive:Proficiency_Greataxe.name: Greataxe Proficiency

passive:Proficiency_Greatclub.name: Greatclub Proficiency

passive:Proficiency_Greatswords.name: Greatsword Proficiency

passive:Proficiency_Halberds.name: Halberd Proficiency

passive:Proficiency_HandCrossbows.name: Hand Crossbow Proficiency

passive:Proficiency_HeavyCrossbows.name: Heavy Crossbow Proficiency

passive:Proficiency_Javelins.name: Javelin Proficiency

passive:Proficiency_LightCrossbows.name: Light Crossbow Proficiency

passive:Proficiency_LightHammers.name: Light Hammer Proficiency

passive:UncannyDodge.name: Uncanny Dodge

passive:UndeadThrall_BetterSummon.description: Creatures created with <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_AnimateDead">Animate Dead</LSTag> have additional hit points equal to your wizard level, and your <LSTag Tooltip="ProficiencyBonus">Proficiency Bonus</LSTag> is added to their damage.
passive:UndeadThrall_BetterSummon.name: Undead Thralls: Better Summons

passive:UndeadThrall_ExtraSummon.description: When you use <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_AnimateDead">Animate Dead</LSTag>, you can raise an additional corpse.
passive:UndeadThrall_ExtraSummon.name: Undead Thralls: Additional Undead

passive:UndeadThrall_FreeSpell.description: You gain the <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_AnimateDead">Animate Dead</LSTag> spell, if you didn't have it already.
passive:UndeadThrall_FreeSpell.name: Undead Thralls: Animate Dead

passive:UnlockedSpellSlotLevel1.name: first level Spell Slots, or spell slots are full.

passive:UnlockedSpellSlotLevel2.name: second level Spell Slots, or spell slots are full.

passive:UnlockedSpellSlotLevel3.name: third level Spell Slots, or spell slots are full.

passive:UnlockedWarlockSpellSlotLevel1.name: first level Spell Slots, or spell slots are full.

passive:UnlockedWarlockSpellSlotLevel2.name: second level Spell Slots, or spell slots are full.

passive:UnlockedWarlockSpellSlotLevel3.name: third level Spell Slots, or spell slots are full.

passive:Unstable_Backlash.description: While enraged, when you take damage or fail a <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throw</LSTag>, you trigger another Wild Magic effect that replaces the current one.
passive:Unstable_Backlash.name: Unstable Backlash

passive:WarCaster_Bonuses.description: You have <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag> to maintain <LSTag Tooltip="Concentration">Concentration</LSTag> on a spell.
passive:WarCaster_Bonuses.name: War Caster: Concentration

passive:WarCaster_OpportunitySpell.description: You can use a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">reaction</LSTag> to cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_ShockingGrasp">Shocking Grasp</LSTag> at a target moving out of melee range.
passive:WarCaster_OpportunitySpell.name: War Caster: Opportunity Spell

passive:WarGodsBlessing.description: Endow a nearby ally with the glory of your god to grant them a +[1] bonus to their <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag>.
passive:WarGodsBlessing.name: Channel Divinity: War God's Blessing

passive:WarMagic.description: You have honed your body and magic for war. After you cast a <LSTag Tooltip="Cantrip">cantrip</LSTag>, you can make a weapon attack using a bonus action.
passive:WarMagic.name: War Magic

passive:WarPriest.description: When you make an unarmed or weapon attack, you can spend a War Priest Charge to make an additional attack as a bonus action.
passive:WarPriest.name: War Priest

passive:WardingFlare.description: Shield yourself with divine light. Use your reaction to impose <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag> on an attacker, possibly causing their attack to miss.
passive:WardingFlare.name: Warding Flare

passive:WardingFlare_Improved.description: When an enemy attacks an ally, you can use your reaction to impose <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag> on the <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag>, possibly causing their attack to miss.
passive:WardingFlare_Improved.name: Improved Warding Flare

passive:WeaponMaster.description: You have gained <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> with four weapons of your choice.
passive:WeaponMaster.name: Weapon Master

passive:WhispersOfTheGrave.description: You can cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_SpeakWithDead">Speak with Dead</LSTag> without expending a <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">spell slot</LSTag>.
passive:WhispersOfTheGrave.name: Whispers of the Grave

passive:WildMagic.description:
Unruly magic sparks and fizzes through your veins.

For sorcerers, each time you cast a spell of Level 1 or higher, your magic might surge and trigger a random magical effect.

For barbarians, each time you rage a random magical effect will trigger.
passive:WildMagic.name: Wild Magic

passive:WildMagicRage.description: A magical energy roils inside of you, ready to erupt. When you enter a <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="RAGE">Rage</LSTag>, you trigger a random magical effect.
passive:WildMagicRage.name: Wild Magic Surge

passive:WildShape_Combat.description: As a bonus action in animal form, you can expend <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">spell slots</LSTag> to heal yourself. You regain [1] per spell slot level.
passive:WildShape_Combat.name: Lunar Mend

passive:WildStrike.description: You can make an additional <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> after making an Unarmed Strike while in an animal Wild Shape.
passive:WildStrike.name: Wild Strike

passive:WildStrike_2.description: You can make [1] additional <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> after making an Unarmed Strike while in an animal Wild Shape.
passive:WildStrike_2.name: Improved Wild Strike

passive:WrathOfTheStorm.description: As a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">reaction</LSTag> strike back at an attacking creature, dealing [1] or [2]. The target takes half damage on a successful <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throw</LSTag>.
passive:WrathOfTheStorm.name: Wrath of the Storm

passive:WrithingTide.description: You can condense part of your swarm into a focused mass that lifts you up, granting you a flying speed of [1] and protecting you from surface effects.
passive:WrithingTide.name: Writhing Tide

race:Dragonborn.description: A proud race that values clan and skills above all else. Once enslaved by dragons, they strive to be self-sufficient, not wanting to be beholden to anyone, not even the gods.
race:Dragonborn.name: Dragonborn

race:Dragonborn_Black.description: Despite no ancestral links to the mighty creatures, these dragonborn share the charcoal colouration and fizzling, acrid breath of black dragons.
race:Dragonborn_Black.name: Black Dragonborn

race:Dragonborn_Blue.description: Despite no ancestral links to the mighty creatures, these dragonborn share the deep sapphire scales and charged, crackling breath of blue dragons.
race:Dragonborn_Blue.name: Blue Dragonborn

race:Dragonborn_Brass.description: Despite no ancestral links to the mighty creatures, these dragonborn share the burnished ochre hue and flickering, fiery breath of brass dragons.
race:Dragonborn_Brass.name: Brass Dragonborn

race:Dragonborn_Bronze.description: Despite no ancestral links to the mighty creatures, these dragonborn share the shining sepia scales and sparking breath of bronze dragons.
race:Dragonborn_Bronze.name: Bronze Dragonborn

race:Dragonborn_Copper.description: Despite no ancestral links to the mighty creatures, these dragonborn share the pink-gold colouration and corrosive breath of copper dragons.
race:Dragonborn_Copper.name: Copper Dragonborn

race:Dragonborn_Gold.description: Despite no ancestral links to the mighty creatures, these dragonborn share the resplendent shine and roiling, blazing breath of gold dragons.
race:Dragonborn_Gold.name: Gold Dragonborn

race:Dragonborn_Green.description: Despite no ancestral links to the mighty creatures, these dragonborn share the brilliant emerald aspect and stinking, putrid breath of green dragons.
race:Dragonborn_Green.name: Green Dragonborn

race:Dragonborn_Red.description: Despite no ancestral links to the mighty creatures, these dragonborn share the bright scarlet likeness and roiling, burning breath of red dragons.
race:Dragonborn_Red.name: Red Dragonborn

race:Dragonborn_Silver.description: Despite no ancestral links to the mighty creatures, these dragonborn share the glinting shine and scorching cold breath of silver dragons.
race:Dragonborn_Silver.name: Silver Dragonborn

race:Dragonborn_White.description: Despite no ancestral links to the mighty creatures, these dragonborn share the snowy aspect and frosty breath of white dragons.
race:Dragonborn_White.name: White Dragonborn

race:Drow.description: Driven to the Underdark, most drow have adopted a ruthless pragmatism. While the Lolth-sworn delight in the goddess' evil tenets, the Seldarine reject Her attempt to overthrow the leader of the elven pantheon.
race:Drow.name: Drow

race:Drow_LolthSworn.description: Raised by Lolth's cult in the city of Menzoberranzan, these drow embody the virtues of their corrupt and merciless goddess. Lolth marks Her followers with bright red eyes so those in the Underdark will learn to fear them on sight.
race:Drow_LolthSworn.name: Lolth-Sworn Drow

race:Drow_Seldarine.description: Seldarine drow can be found seeking allies from all over Faerûn, aiming to settle their conflict with Lolth - and each other - by any means necessary.
race:Drow_Seldarine.name: Seldarine Drow

race:Duergar.description: Once enslaved by the eldritch mind flayers, duergar adapted to freedom with harsh practicality. Their cold demeanours and gift of stealth are well-known throughout the Underdark.
race:Duergar.name: Duergar

race:Dwarf.description: As durable and unyielding as their homes of stone, dwarves are some of the finest warriors, miners, and smiths of Faerûn.
race:Dwarf.name: Dwarf

race:Dwarf_GoldHill.description: These dwarves are known for their confidence and keen intuition. The culture of their Deep Kingdom values family, ritual, and fine craftsmanship.
race:Dwarf_GoldHill.name: Gold Dwarf

race:Dwarf_ShieldMountain.description: Great losses in ancient wars against goblins and orcs have led these dwarves to adopt a cynical mindset, but they will endure anything to restore their ancestral homelands.
race:Dwarf_ShieldMountain.name: Shield Dwarf

race:Elf.description: With ethereal countenances and long lifespans, elves are at home with nature's power, flourishing in light and dark alike.
race:Elf.name: Elf

race:Elf_HighElf.description: Heirs of the mystical Feywild, high elves value magic in all its forms, and even those who do not study spellcraft can manipulate the Weave.
race:Elf_HighElf.name: High Elf

race:Elf_WoodElf.description: These elves spend their reclusive lives in Faerûn's forests. Decades of training in archery and camouflage are enhanced by an otherworldly swiftness.
race:Elf_WoodElf.name: Wood Elf

race:Githyanki.description: With a ruthlessness borne from mind flayer enslavement, githyanki ride the Astral Sea atop red dragons, bringing their silver swords and psionic might to bear against any trace of the illithid menace.
race:Githyanki.name: Githyanki

race:Gnome.description: Small, clever, and energetic, gnomes use their long lives to explore Faerûn's brightest corners and darkest depths.
race:Gnome.name: Gnome

race:Gnome_Deep.description: More guarded than their surface cousins, deep gnomes survive in the Underdark with darkvision and skilful stealth.
race:Gnome_Deep.name: Deep Gnome

race:Gnome_Forest.description: Even smaller than their cousins and twice as reclusive, forest gnomes are a rare sight in Faerûn. They master magic and craftsmanship in their distant, idyllic groves.
race:Gnome_Forest.name: Forest Gnome

race:Gnome_Rock.description: The most commonly seen gnomes on Faerûn's surface, rock gnomes are named as such for their hardiness and affinity for metal.
race:Gnome_Rock.name: Rock Gnome

race:HalfElf.description: Curious, ambitious, and versatile, half-elves are welcome everywhere, but struggle without a community to call their own.
race:HalfElf.name: Half-Elf

race:HalfElf_Drow.description: Most half-drow result from liaisons between Seldarine drow and surfacers. While half-drow inherited a few magical gifts, they aren't usually raised in the Underdark.
race:HalfElf_Drow.name: Drow Half-Elf

race:HalfElf_High.description: A touch of the Feywild remains in half-elves with this bloodline, and even those untrained in magic possess a hint of wild power.
race:HalfElf_High.name: High Half-Elf

race:HalfElf_Wood.description: Like their wood elf parent, these half-elves have a quickened stride and an eye for stealth. Yet many break away from isolation in Faerûn's forests to explore the rest of the Realms.
race:HalfElf_Wood.name: Wood Half-Elf

race:HalfOrc.description: Creatures of intense emotion, half-orcs are more inclined to act than contemplate - whether the rage burning their bodies compels them to fight, or the love filling their hearts inspires acts of incredible kindness.
race:HalfOrc.name: Half-Orc

race:Halfling.description: Small yet capable, halflings prefer the comforts of home and hearth - but their natural luck and dexterity makes them fine adventurers.
race:Halfling.name: Halfling

race:Halfling_Lightfoot.description: Stealthy but social, these halflings travel all over Faerûn to make names for themselves.
race:Halfling_Lightfoot.name: Lightfoot Halfling

race:Halfling_Strongheart.description: Legend has it that dwarven blood gave stronghearts their hardiness. Resistant to poison and wellsprings of endurance, these halflings easily hold their own.
race:Halfling_Strongheart.name: Strongheart Halfling

race:Human.description: The most common face in Faerûn, humans are known for their tenacity, creativity, and endless capacity for growth.
race:Human.name: Human

race:Tiefling.description: Descended from devils of the Nine Hells, tieflings face constant suspicion in Faerûn. Thankfully, their arcane abilities make them natural survivors.
race:Tiefling.name: Tiefling

race:Tiefling_Asmodeus.description: Bound to Nessus, the deepest layer of the Hells, these tieflings inherited the ability to wield fire and darkness from the archdevil Asmodeus' infernal bloodline.
race:Tiefling_Asmodeus.name: Asmodeus Tiefling

race:Tiefling_Mephistopeles.description: Descended from the archdevil Mephistopheles, these tieflings are gifted with a particular affinity for arcane magic.
race:Tiefling_Mephistopeles.name: Mephistopheles Tiefling

race:Tiefling_Zariel.description: Tieflings from Zariel's bloodline are empowered with martial strength, and can channel searing flame to punish their enemies.
race:Tiefling_Zariel.name: Zariel Tiefling

spell:Projectile_AcidArrow.description: Shoot a green arrow that covers the target and the ground with acid. Deals [1] immediately and [2] at the end of the target's turn.
spell:Projectile_AcidArrow.name: Melf's Acid Arrow

spell:Projectile_AcidSplash.description: Throw a bubble of acid that damages each creature it hits.
spell:Projectile_AcidSplash.name: Acid Splash

spell:Projectile_ArcaneShot_BanishingArr.description: Use Abjuration magic to potentially <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BANISHED">Banish</LSTag> your target to the Feywild.
spell:Projectile_ArcaneShot_BanishingArr.name: Arcane Shot: Banishing Arrow

spell:Projectile_ArcaneShot_BeguilingArr.description: Use Enchantment magic to deal an additional [1]. Target must succeed a <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throw</LSTag> or become <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="CHARMED">Charmed</LSTag>.
spell:Projectile_ArcaneShot_BeguilingArr.name: Arcane Shot: Beguiling Arrow

spell:Projectile_ArcaneShot_BurstingArro.description: Use Evocation magic to make your arrow explode on impact and deal an additional [1] to targets within [2].
spell:Projectile_ArcaneShot_BurstingArro.name: Arcane Shot: Bursting Arrow

spell:Projectile_ArcaneShot_EnfeeblingAr.description: Use Necromantic magic to deal an additional [1]. Target must succeed a <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throw</LSTag> or become <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="ENFEEBLINGARROW">Feeble</LSTag>.
spell:Projectile_ArcaneShot_EnfeeblingAr.name: Arcane Shot: Enfeebling Arrow

spell:Projectile_ArcaneShot_GraspingArro.description: Deal an additional [1]. Affected entity's <LSTag Tooltip="MovementSpeed">Movement Speed</LSTag> is reduced by [3] and it will take [2] when it moves.
spell:Projectile_ArcaneShot_GraspingArro.name: Arcane Shot: Grasping Arrow

spell:Projectile_ArcaneShot_SeekingArrow.description: Use Divination magic to make your arrow seek a target. The arrow deals an additional [1] and possibly applies <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="FAERIE_FIRE">Faerie Fire</LSTag>.
spell:Projectile_ArcaneShot_SeekingArrow.name: Arcane Shot: Seeking Arrow

spell:Projectile_ArcaneShot_ShadowArrow.description: Use Illusion magic to deal an additional [1]. Target must succeed a <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throw</LSTag> or become <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BLINDED">Blinded</LSTag>.
spell:Projectile_ArcaneShot_ShadowArrow.name: Arcane Shot: Shadow Arrow

spell:Projectile_BladeFlourish_Defensive.description: Attack defensively, increasing your <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourClass">Armour Class</LSTag> by [1] if you hit.
spell:Projectile_BladeFlourish_Defensive.name: Defensive Flourish (Ranged)

spell:Projectile_BladeFlourish_Mobile.description: Shoot a target with enough force to push it back [2]. Afterwards, you can <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_BladeFlourish_Mobile_FollowUp">Teleport</LSTag> to the target.
spell:Projectile_BladeFlourish_Mobile.name: Mobile Flourish (Ranged)

spell:Projectile_BladeFlourish_Slashing.description: Attack up to [1] enemies at once.
spell:Projectile_BladeFlourish_Slashing.name: Slashing Flourish (Ranged)

spell:Projectile_BladeOfTheRime.description: Throw a shard of ice that deals [1]. It explodes and deals [2] to anyone nearby. It leaves an ice surface.
spell:Projectile_BladeOfTheRime.name: Blade of Rime

spell:Projectile_ChainLightning.description: Strike an enemy with lightning. Three more bolts will leap from the target, electrifying as many as three other enemies within [1].
spell:Projectile_ChainLightning.name: Chain Lightning

spell:Projectile_ChromaticOrb.description: Hurl a sphere that deals [1] and possibly creates a surface on impact. Alternatively, choose a different type of damage.
spell:Projectile_ChromaticOrb.name: Chromatic Orb

spell:Projectile_ChromaticOrb_Monk.description: Hurl a sphere that deals [1] and possibly creates a surface on impact.
spell:Projectile_ChromaticOrb_Monk.name: Sphere of Elemental Balance

spell:Projectile_Disintegrate.description: If the target fails a Dexterity <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throw</LSTag>, and the [1] reduces it to 0 <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">hit points</LSTag>, it disintegrates into a crumbly ash.
spell:Projectile_Disintegrate.name: Disintegrate

spell:Projectile_EnsnaringStrike_Contain.description: Your attack summons thorny vines that possibly <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="ENSNARING_STRIKE">Ensnare</LSTag> your target.
spell:Projectile_EnsnaringStrike_Contain.name: Ensnaring Strike

spell:Projectile_FangsOfTheFireSnake.description: Hit your foe from afar. Your next melee attacks deal an additional [1].
spell:Projectile_FangsOfTheFireSnake.name: Fangs of the Fire Snake

spell:Projectile_Fireball.description: Shoot a bright flame from your fingers that explodes upon contact, torching everything in the vicinity.
spell:Projectile_Fireball.name: Fireball

spell:Projectile_Fireball_Monk.description: Shoot a bright flame from your fingers that explodes upon contact, torching everything in the vicinity.
spell:Projectile_Fireball_Monk.name: Flames of the Phoenix

spell:Projectile_GuidingBolt.description: The next <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> against this target has <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag>.
spell:Projectile_GuidingBolt.name: Guiding Bolt

spell:Projectile_GuidingBolt_StarMap.description: The next <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> against this target has <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag>.
spell:Projectile_GuidingBolt_StarMap.name: Star Map: Guiding Bolt

spell:Projectile_HailOfThorns.description: The thorns deal [1] to the target and then explode. The explosion deals an additional [2] to the target and surrounding creatures.
spell:Projectile_HailOfThorns.name: Hail of Thorns

spell:Projectile_IceKnife.description: Throw a shard of ice that deals [1]. It explodes and deals [2] to anyone nearby. It leaves an ice surface.
spell:Projectile_IceKnife.name: Ice Knife

spell:Projectile_LightningArrow.description: After the arrow hits, smaller bolts snake out from the target toward nearby creatures.
spell:Projectile_LightningArrow.name: Lightning Arrow

spell:Projectile_MagicMissile.description: Shoot [2] magical darts, each dealing [1]. They always hit their target.
spell:Projectile_MagicMissile.name: Magic Missile

spell:Projectile_PoisonSpray.description: Project a puff of noxious gas.
spell:Projectile_PoisonSpray.name: Poison Spray

spell:Projectile_RayOfEnfeeblement.description: Weaken a foe: they deal half damage with weapon attacks using <LSTag Tooltip="Strength">Strength</LSTag>.
spell:Projectile_RayOfEnfeeblement.name: Ray of Enfeeblement

spell:Projectile_RayOfFrost.description: Reduces the target's <LSTag Tooltip="MovementSpeed">movement speed</LSTag> by [1].
spell:Projectile_RayOfFrost.name: Ray of Frost

spell:Projectile_RayOfFrost_Monk.description: Call forth the cold mountain winds and reduce the target's <LSTag Tooltip="MovementSpeed">movement speed</LSTag> by [1].
spell:Projectile_RayOfFrost_Monk.name: Chill of the Mountain

spell:Projectile_ScorchingRay.description: Hurl [2] rays of fire. Each ray deals [1].
spell:Projectile_ScorchingRay.name: Scorching Ray

spell:Projectile_ScorchingRay_Monk.description: Expel the fire burning through your veins as [1] flaming rays. Each ray deals [2].
spell:Projectile_ScorchingRay_Monk.name: Embrace of the Inferno

spell:Projectile_Smite_Banishing_Contain.description: Possibly <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BANISHED">Banish</LSTag> your target to another plane of existence.
spell:Projectile_Smite_Banishing_Contain.name: Banishing Smite

spell:Projectile_WitchBolt.description: Link yourself to a target with a bolt of lightning. Deal an additional [1] each turn by activating it.
spell:Projectile_WitchBolt.name: Witch Bolt

spell:Shout_ActionSurge.description: Immediately gain an extra <LSTag Tooltip="Action">action</LSTag> to use this turn.
spell:Shout_ActionSurge.name: Action Surge

spell:Shout_Aid.description: Heal your allies and increase their hit point maximum by [1].
spell:Shout_Aid.name: Aid

spell:Shout_ArcaneRecovery.description: Replenish <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">spell slots</LSTag> while out of combat. You cannot restore spell slots above 5th level.
spell:Shout_ArcaneRecovery.name: Arcane Recovery

spell:Shout_ArmorOfAgathys.description: Gain [1] and deal [2] to any creature that hits you with a melee attack.
spell:Shout_ArmorOfAgathys.name: Armour of Agathys

spell:Shout_AstralKnowledge.description: Gain <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> in all <LSTag Tooltip="Skill">Skills</LSTag> of a chosen <LSTag Tooltip="Abilities">Ability</LSTag>.
spell:Shout_AstralKnowledge.name: Astral Knowledge

spell:Shout_AuraOfVitality.description: While this aura lasts, you can cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_AuraOfVitality_Activate">Restore Vitality</LSTag> as a bonus action to heal yourself or nearby allies.
spell:Shout_AuraOfVitality.name: Warden of Vitality

spell:Shout_AuraOf_Courage.description: You and any nearby allies can't be <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="FRIGHTENED">Frightened</LSTag>. The aura disappears if you fall Unconscious.
spell:Shout_AuraOf_Courage.name: Aura of Courage

spell:Shout_AuraOf_Devotion.description: You and any nearby allies can't be <LSTag Tooltip="CharmedGroup">Charmed</LSTag>. The aura disappears if you fall Unconscious.
spell:Shout_AuraOf_Devotion.name: Aura of Devotion

spell:Shout_AuraOf_Hate.description: You and any nearby fiends and undead gain an additional [1] to damage dealt with melee weapons.
spell:Shout_AuraOf_Hate.name: Aura of Hate

spell:Shout_AuraOf_Protection.description: You and any nearby allies gain a +[1] bonus to <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag>. The aura disappears if you fall Unconscious.
spell:Shout_AuraOf_Protection.name: Aura of Protection

spell:Shout_AuraOf_Warding.description: You and any nearby allies take only <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">half the damage</LSTag> from spells. The aura disappears if you fall Unconscious.
spell:Shout_AuraOf_Warding.name: Aura of Warding

spell:Shout_BeaconOfHope.description: Your allies will regain the maximum <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">hit points</LSTag> possible when healed. They also gain <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on Wisdom <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag> and Death Saving Throws.
spell:Shout_BeaconOfHope.name: Beacon of Hope

spell:Shout_BladeWard.description: Take only half the damage from Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing attacks.
spell:Shout_BladeWard.name: Blade Ward

spell:Shout_Bladesong.description: Invoke the Bladesong. You gain a +[1] bonus to <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourClass">Armour Class</LSTag> and your <LSTag Tooltip="MovementSpeed">movement speed</LSTag> increases by [2]. You also gain <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> in Acrobatics and a +[1] bonus to Constitution <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag>.
spell:Shout_Bladesong.name: Bladesong

spell:Shout_Blink.description: At the end of your turn, roll a d20. On 11 or higher, you vanish into the Ethereal Plane. While there, you can't be harmed or seen in this world.
spell:Shout_Blink.name: Blink

spell:Shout_Blur.description: Attackers have <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> against you.
spell:Shout_Blur.name: Blur

spell:Shout_Champion_Challenge.description: Challenge the enemies around you, compelling them to attack only you. Any attacks they might make against other targets have <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag>.
spell:Shout_Champion_Challenge.name: Champion Challenge

spell:Shout_CharmAnimalsAndPlants.description: Channel fey magic to <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="CHARMED">Charm</LSTag> nearby beasts and plants.
spell:Shout_CharmAnimalsAndPlants.name: Charm Animals and Plants
